5101330.name: Touhou Meishuugeki (東方明秋劇) ~ Cursed Sweeper and Bewildering Parallel

4798670.name: Get Through The Entire Deck To Win

4080860.name: HIROYU's Murder Mystery：マーダーミステリー セッションツール

4857310.name: Pearl - Meeting on an Autumn Day -

5021380.name: MoooooN - The cow jumps over the moon

5230380.name: Block Brave ~ブロックブレイブ~

5257930.name: Heartfall — A Tale in Three Lives

5183540.name: Music and Melody - Numbers and Letters

2617870.name: PSYCHOFINGER
2617870.short_description: PSYCHOFINGER – it's a game where pointing fingers isn't just rude... It's essential! Become an agent at the Department of Metaphysical Investigations, survive hordes of enemies, and upgrade your character.

5222620.name: EchoNet
5222620.short_description: A short psychological horror game, where you and your team attempt to prevent a global economic crash.

4217150.name: Lotyas
4217150.short_description: Experience single-player or multiplayer battles in Lotyas, a turn-based tactical strategy game with a medieval theme.

5145440.name: Flow Water 3D Puzzle
5145440.short_description: Move blocks, channels and pipes to guide colorful streams of water to their fountains in 1,350 handcrafted 3D logic puzzles. Relax, think and solve increasingly challenging levels.

2434310.name: Maximum Apocalypse
2434310.short_description: Scavenge, battle, survive! Choose your survivor and face diverse apocalyptic scenarios in this cooperative digital adaptation of the hit board game Maximum Apocalypse. Grab your friends or make new ones with 1-6 player apocalyptic roguelike gameplay.

4457270.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling
4457270.short_description: Manage heavy machinery, load cargo, operate cranes and tugboats, and keep the harbor running smoothly in Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling. Experience realistic port operations across dynamic day and night conditions ⚓

4272020.name: WOIM
4272020.short_description: WOIM is a puzzle game where you play as a worm! Push blocks, flip switches, eat apples and... cut yourself in half! WOIM will push you to keep digging downwards, solving tricky puzzles, finding secrets, and making new friends (that were once part of you).

5089730.name: Maid To END 迈向终焉的女仆 Playtest

2781660.name: Dawn of Defense
2781660.short_description:
Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: 
Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

3913820.name: Vegelypse
3913820.short_description: Vegelypse is a hand-painted 2.5D beat 'em up with roguelite twists. Join the Hard Rock Cacti Band, master brutal combos, and crush hordes of vicious mutant fruits and vegetables in a chaotic fight to save the city! The Vegelypse has begun!

2223480.name: Infinicity
2223480.short_description: In a moddable procedurally generated open world, humanity’s reign is crumbling. Once subservient machines have awakened, uniting in rebellion against their creators. As the android uprising spreads cities fall...

4613790.name: Spooky Ride
4613790.short_description: Team up in 1–4 player co-op, hop on your bikes, and ride into a supernatural forest in search of BIGFOOT. Follow strange clues, survive ghostly encounters, solve co-op puzzles, and try to make it back before your crew becomes another forest legend.

4691750.name: Bottled by Bears Demo
4691750.short_description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

4707730.name: Little Warrior
4707730.short_description: Little Warrior is a cute pixel-art twin-stick action roguelite. Choose staff, greatsword, bow, sword & shield, or dual blades. Build skills on a 6-slot grid, then play as a Gardener, Lumberjack, or Chef. Gear rarity and stat rerolls shape each run. Victory depends on your choices.

5065360.name: Night Portable Demo
5065360.short_description: A free demo of Night Portable, a night-shift survival horror set in a 2000s secondhand game store. Clean, restock, and survive until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games to earn items for the 3D store. The threat keeps moving while you play.

5272240.name: Everfront Demo
5272240.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

4468710.name: One More Tower Demo
4468710.short_description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

5084600.name: Rally Point Demo
5084600.short_description: A real-time auto-battler with a roguelite campaign. Draft a squad of hero, mech and support cards, then push through a galaxy of hour-long runs. Deploy down open lanes, take the control points, break the enemy base - and never micro a single unit.

4855970.name: Highway Station Simulator
4855970.short_description: Run a highway station with up to four players. Somebody has to work the pumps, somebody has to stock the shelves, and somebody has to answer for the mess. A first-person co-op management sim about a very long shift.

4861170.name: Peagle XP
4861170.short_description:
A pachinko roguelite where eagles shoot their own eggs. They smash pegs, chain combos, buy passives at the shop, and grab overpowered power-ups to conquer each world.

Eagles love to play. Too bad for their offspring.
Eagles love to play. Too bad for their offspring.

4816500.name: Plunder Bay
4816500.short_description: An online pirate board game for 2–6 players. Sail scattered islands, blast rivals with cannons and rockets, and STEAL their treasure when you sink them. Spin the helm, claim islands, and win wild minigames — first to 4 treasures wins. Grab your crew and plunder the bay!

4498520.name: Rescue Drone Simulator: Second Chance
4498520.short_description: Pilot drones into burning buildings, frozen landmarks, and collapsing tunnels. Rescue survivors, build and customize your fleet, and lead a team of specialists who never got a second chance - until now.

2519170.name: Bunraku
2519170.short_description: Bunraku is a fast-paced multiplayer brawler where you clash with friends in frantic ninja fights. Up to 8 players can join the Bunraku Theater arenas, online (P2P) or local, mastering ninja dashing skills to become the ultimate battle puppeteer!

5313290.name: Remains on the bus Demo
5313290.short_description: Every passenger could be a shapeshifter. You are a bus driver who must let ordinary passengers board while identifying and kicking out shapeshifters hiding among them.

4385290.name: ExoFlora First Seeds
4385290.short_description: Grow alien plants in an abandoned greenhouse, pair neighbors that react in fire, frost and light, and breed new species you get to name. Tune the climate, explore the valley with robot spheres and hold the line when the pest swarms arrive.

4929280.name: Act Normal
4929280.short_description: Act Normal is a multiplayer game where you blend in as an NPC and steal enough to survive each round. With scores hidden, you never know if you're safe. Every player carries a hidden gun. Find them before they find you.

5287120.name: 人性转世
5287120.short_description: Make peace with yourself.You never needed to regret that choice.

5265790.name: Wisp
5265790.short_description: Live clocks, weather, system monitors, launchers, and notes on your desktop — drag them where you want and restyle any of them with no code. Includes 850+ wallpapers built to sit behind widgets, so nothing lands on the subject.

2196010.name: Evergrind
2196010.short_description: Evergrind is an idle adventure like you've never experienced before! Discover unknown regions, face dangerous creatures, and create the ultimate loot loop. Master skills, process rare resources, and forge powerful gear on your journey to absolute perfection!

5205450.name: Only Axolotls
5205450.short_description: Collect, breed, and care for adorable axolotls in a cozy 2D aquarium, manage your resources, discover new abilities, and build your team to take on turn-based battles.

4318080.name: ALTEREDBLOOD+
4318080.short_description: A BLOOD-soaking Movement-FPS platformer🩸where you Splatter walls and floors with your foe’s BLOOD. Stand in that BLOOD to [ALTER] yourself and your Weapons. Soak up BLOOD to replenish and keep fighting. MOTHER created you to stop them. Beckon our Extinction.

4218730.name: Corridor Duel
4218730.short_description: A competitive 3D strategy board game. Outmaneuver rivals with clever movement and walls in local, online, AI, 4-player, team, and chaotic Crazy Mode matches.

5169390.name: UNDERFED
5169390.short_description: An underground survival game built on proximity voice chat. Every sound in the dark is another person. The deeper you go, the harder it is to get back out.

3348640.name: TSAREVNA. Age of Tales
3348640.short_description: The world's first ballet-inspired action. Become the Tsarevna and carve your way through a dark Slavic fairy tale where beauty becomes a weapon. Chain stylish combos, master graceful swordplay, and turn every battle into a deadly dance.

4675440.name: Fragment Echoes Demo
4675440.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi hack-and-slash roguelike where you wield four weapons, chain fluid air and ground combos, and evolve your combat style with randomized Echo abilities.

3575220.name: Guardians of the Wall
3575220.short_description: Guardians of the Wall is a co-op action RPG where players fight through hordes and bosses beyond humanity’s last fortress. Fast hack-and-slash combat, unique heroes, and dynamic progression await.

5301850.name: Vault Keeper: Tidy Up the Vault Demo

4221670.name: SLOP
4221670.short_description: SLOP is a Co-op Comedy Horror Cooking game where 4 chefs cook the BIGGEST, SLOPPIEST meal possible to keep the Grubshaft running and reach the Final floor before you become SLOP

4635060.name: Noire Police Detective: Gangster Drama Simulator Demo

4996300.name: 火柴：人在异世
4996300.short_description: Choose from heroes with radically different playstyles and build a unique deck in a dangerous otherworld. Combine cards, relics, and character mechanics to create powerful combat engines and overcome three escalating stages of adventure.

5255040.name: The Book
5255040.short_description: No accounts, no stores, no distractions. Bring the books you already own — EPUB, PDF, TXT,  HTML, CBZ, CBR and image folders — and read them as 3D books.

4980880.name: 雀神·喵喵麻将 Demo
4980880.short_description: This world’s mahjong is actually a medium for summoning ultra-powerful familiars?! A mahjong spirit who crossed over from another world, together with a beckoning lucky cat, will set you on your path to becoming the Avian Deity!

5328790.name: DreamPair desktop Demo
5328790.short_description:
Customize your own character pair and put them on your desktop!
Custom parts supported! Watch them talk and hang out on your screen, and share your creations with friends! Focus together in Focus Mode! Your pair sits beside you with a focus timer and a to-do list.

4895870.name: Dumpster Gang Demo
4895870.short_description: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

5401880.name: The Lost Within II Demo
5401880.short_description: You are trapped in dark, abandoned mines where your only way out is to run. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and try to survive while a bloodthirsty monster hunts you down in every corner. Can you make it to the light?

3702120.name: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call
3702120.short_description:
You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil.
Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night.
Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?

4733430.name: Plucked
4733430.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

4461680.name: Bad Goons
4461680.short_description:
Blast through cover, carve trenches, and build massive fortifications to dominate the battlefield.
Adapt to ever-changing environments and discover new tactics with every match.
Outsmart your enemies with pure War-IQ.
No more gooning around! It’s time to join the fight.

5389720.name: Windfall Meadows
5389720.short_description: Choose a hero and survive relentless swarms in a colorful 3D meadow. Attacks fire automatically as you dodge enemies, collect experience, choose upgrades and battle recurring bosses. Play as an archer, warrior, mage or druid.

5175150.name: Hit The Beer Demo
5175150.short_description: Hit The Beer is a lightweight idle collection game that stays in the corner of your desktop. Your anonymous keyboard rhythm brews different beers without recording what you type, attracting customers with unique tastes to come and sample them.

5213480.name: Second Stone Demo
5213480.short_description: Second Stone is a colorful Action RPG built around two fully playable parallel worlds. Play as Shiren, a young treasure hunter who can cross between the vibrant Light World and its sinister mirror, the Shrouded World. Master fast-paced combat and forge your path to power with elemental Manastones.

5286290.name: Type 'n Hatch
5286290.short_description: A cozy desktop companion that hatches hand-drawn birds as you type. Every key you press, in any app, cracks the egg on that key, and the birds that hatch hop around your keyboard. Pomodoro tomatoes, a CRT typing race, and magic words to discover along the way.

5248030.name: FishIdle
5248030.short_description: A multiplayer idle RPG. Queue gathering, crafting, and combat — your character keeps going on the server. Standard and Hardcore are separate paths; five classes fight on autopilot.

5014090.name: Chesstris Demo
5014090.short_description: Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. Your choices in and out of puzzles shape your destiny: become a beloved champion or a despised victor, find true love or ruin friendships.

5300330.name: Drift Riot
5300330.short_description: Drift Riot is an arcade racer where style is speed. Chain drifts, jumps and near misses into huge scores, outrun the Patrols in Heat Run, conquer 150 career courses, race leaderboard ghosts, and build tracks to share.

3339000.name: Chesstris
3339000.short_description:
Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. Become a beloved champion or a despised victor, find true love or ruin friendships.
In Chesstris, your choices in and out of puzzles shape your destiny!

2210150.name: At Fate's End
2210150.short_description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

4433950.name: Funeral Flowers Lament: Helena Demo
4433950.short_description:
A small-squad tactical RPG featuring high-speed battles and gameplay built around fast-paced combat.
With the Reverse Weapon Triangle system and 13–15 character roster, enjoy strategic battles where every ally matters.
【Playable up to Chapter 6・Save Data Transfer Supported】

3310570.name: Night Plane
3310570.short_description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

3885500.name: Ounba
3885500.short_description: Ounba is a 3D arcade action game where you pilot a high-speed spaceship inside a huge futuristic tube. Dodge obstacles, fight enemies, shoot, collect resources, and try to beat your best score and the scores of other players! 🚀

2705130.name: Exoborne
2705130.short_description: Exoborne is an open-world, tactical extraction shooter set in a world torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Customize powerful exo-rigs to gain strategic advantage in ever-changing weather conditions. Face hostile factions, enemy players, and Mother Nature herself in intense high-stakes sessions.

5311500.name: 铸剑者 Demo
5311500.short_description: Forge every blade with your own hands. Build your sword formation, battle demons from all sides, and protect the one who waits for you — a heartwarming wuxia journey of crafting, roguelite runs and auto-battles.

4001660.name: Undying Knights
4001660.short_description: Undying Knights is a couch and online party game that fuses strategy and reflexes. Enjoy quick rounds with flexible team fights, unique weapons and deadly traps, all with a handicap option that keeps every battle fair.

5108500.name: My Summer Project Together
5108500.short_description: Build your first car from scratch in a cheerful summer adventure, solo or with up to 4 players online. Earn money from odd jobs, explore the countryside for hidden parts, buy supplies, assemble every system, and enjoy the freedom and chaos of summer with friends.

3603900.name: Drunkonauts
3603900.short_description: Drunkonauts is a chaotic multiplayer party game with hilarious physics-based combat, crazy weapons and JETPACKS! Battle friends in local or online matches, use unpredictable movement and wacky attacks to send opponents flying, stay on the map, avoid dangerous hazards and claim victory!

2713380.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
2713380.short_description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

4690190.name: Food Devils Demo
4690190.short_description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

5151510.name: Vault Keeper: Tidy Up the Vault
5151510.short_description: "Vault Keeper" is a single-player, therapeutic organization game. You will put over 50 thousands of banknotes and collectibles back in place. Learn to organize efficiently and complete the task faster than anyone else!

5436520.name: Fishing Up The Food Chain
5436520.short_description: Catch a fish and you become the fish. Catch a car, become the car. Fish your way up a gloriously silly food chain, from one soggy fisherman to the entire universe, in a hand-drawn pixel-art fishing game full of googly eyes, upgrades and one very weird portal.

4830690.name: Motel Owner Simulator Demo
4830690.short_description: Build and manage your own motel in Motel Owner Simulator Demo. Design rooms, attract guests, expand your property, and grow from a small roadside stop into a thriving hospitality empire in this Demo.

5324440.name: Meltdown Crew Demo
5324440.short_description: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

5236370.name: 铸剑者
5236370.short_description: Forge every blade with your own hands. Build your sword formation, battle demons from all sides, and protect the one who waits for you — a heartwarming wuxia journey of crafting, roguelite runs and auto-battles.

4457300.name: Motel Owner Simulator
4457300.short_description: Build and manage your own motel in Motel Owner Simulator. Design rooms, attract guests, expand your property, and grow from a small roadside stop into a thriving hospitality empire.

5270410.name: AUROK
5270410.short_description: Free-to-play action arena and co-op campaign. Pick Warrior, Archer, Mage or Barbarian, summon beasts that fight at your side, build a clan and brawl in 12-player free-for-all, 6v6 teams and Titan War. 10 co-op stages with bosses. macOS, Windows and Linux.

4600930.name: Remote Control Demo
4600930.short_description: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

1702850.name: Desperate Survival
1702850.short_description: Descend into dark mines with your crawler. Fight, venture beyond the light, and rebuild your gear with modular cubes. A voxel action roguelite about branching routes, growing danger, and lasting progress back at camp.

5053040.name: Sexception: Dark Seeds
5053040.short_description: Enter unstable dreams, recover a missing past, and choose whether to respect or rewrite the desires of six women in this is erotic, choice-driven, psychological, adult visual novel.

5204190.name: 无尽战斗：放置与构筑 Demo
5204190.short_description:
Endless Battle：Idle & Build（无尽战斗：放置与构筑）是一款放置挂机刷宝游戏，8个技能，4个强化……丰富的装备效果构筑，与机制独特的助战伙伴
消灭每一层的敌人，不停攀登。挂机刷宝，直至——终焉之境！

5318990.name: 真・竹取物語 / Shin Taketori Monogatari
5318990.short_description:
Everyone knows The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter — but the retelling twisted it. This was once something that happened.
On the far side of the moon, a woman wakes with no memory. Trace what she lost; your choices shape the ending.
—Precious, because it ends. A pixel-art sci-fi sound novel.

4853760.name: 掌中帝国 HANDSET HQ Demo
4853760.short_description: Design, build, and sell your own smartphones in Handset HQ! Customize parts, colors, or draw unique shapes. Hire staff, manage R&D and production, and balance costs and prices. Will you create a practical bestseller or a bizarre phone that turns heads?

2817680.name: Mannequin Mayhem - Physics Ragdoll Shooter Demo

5099900.name: Bundoro
5099900.short_description: A Pomodoro timer, desktop companion, and Steam Inventory game.

5109030.name: HENTAI CHAMELEON
5109030.short_description: "Hentai Chameleon" puts your hide and seek skills to the test! Play as a sexy anime girl, pose, and paint yourself to hide in the level's environment. Or play as the male team to find the girls, and catch them to get their "special reward"💕💦Up to 8 players supported! Paint yourself and blend away!

5260240.name: DAEMON
5260240.short_description: Hatch one egg on your desktop and raise the little pet inside. Pet him until his eyes close, dress him in hats, give him a bed, and send him to sleep over at a friend's PC while you peek in. He learns from the way you live, and a month later he's like no other pet on earth.

4677650.name: Buggin' Out!
4677650.short_description: Buggin’ Out! is a multiplayer bug-catching game where you interact, compete with and care for bugs in a whimsical and colourful environment. Explore the island, meet characters and discover new bug species, all based on real life examples!

3116230.name: Abashed
3116230.short_description: Abashed lets you step into the troubled mind of Issac, as the fragments of his past flash before his eyes. Solve puzzles, meet mysterious characters, and alter reality as he faces his worst fears to uncover the truth behind his missing partner, or so he thought.

3587450.name: Crispy Circuits
3587450.short_description: Discover the world of electronics by fixing your hamster’s RC plane. Build real circuits, solve increasingly challenging engineering puzzles, and learn how electronic devices actually work. This wholesome circuitry sim lets you electrocute your hamster without authorities getting involved.

2231020.name: Chronicles: Medieval
2231020.short_description: Step into a vast, dynamic medieval sandbox set in the age of the Hundred Years' War. Explore a brutal but beautiful, historically grounded Europe, command armies in massive battles, leave a mark the chroniclers can't ignore as you make your name one fight at a time. What story will you write?

5374740.name: Archi Vista Demo
5374740.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

5173200.name: Nighthold Demo
5173200.short_description: Experience the first hours of Nighthold in this demo. Build shelters, interact with survivors, explore the alien world, and fight the Rot and raiders to survive the night in this Sandbox RPG.

4637520.name: Tubular Tides
4637520.short_description: Grab your trusty innertube and explore a colorful world in Tubular Tides. Meet quirky locals, take on quests, fish, hunt for hidden treasure and follow your curiosity to uncover the forgotten past.

5275180.name: They Cry Demo
5275180.short_description: They Cry is a psychological horror following Luke seeking to find the source of a reoccurring dream taking over his life, only to find the former husk of his hometown.

4297360.name: Burg Tag
4297360.short_description: A fast-paced online multiplayer game of tag built around ridiculously satisfying movement. Wall kick, swing, slide and roll through colourful maps, and do whatever it takes to escape your friends... or tag them. No friends? Run a time trial!

3975060.name: Danger Mouse
3975060.short_description: Play as Danger Mouse or Penfold through 15 side scrolling, arcade battle action, super danger filled levels - all to stop the latest evil plan by Baron Greenback!

4346510.name: Underkeep Demo
4346510.short_description: Explore a dangerous fantasy world in this role-playing dungeon crawler with tactical, turn-based combat. Assemble a party of adventurers, upgrade your gear and descend into the depths of the Underkeep to uncover what lies hidden below.

5031430.name: I Buried Steve
5031430.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

3774290.name: Aeterna Lucis Demo
3774290.short_description: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

5313120.name: AUTOMATE DEATH Demo
5313120.short_description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

5243200.name: My Penguin Friend
5243200.short_description: Washed up thousands of miles from home, Dindim, a little penguin on a big journey must puzzle across an unfamiliar, tropical coastline, and forge an unlikely friendship to find more than just his way home.

4610680.name: The Hidden Evils Club
4610680.short_description:
When Weird Hill begins to fall, a strange school club becomes the town’s last line of defense.

Build towers, manage resources, trade with survivors, command unusual heroes, and protect the heart of the town from escalating zombie waves.

5076850.name: I Buried Steve Demo
5076850.short_description: Eight players build a lethal beach obstacle course, then all eight have to survive it. Think Ultimate Chicken Horse crossed with Fall Guys, with axes, artillery and a Sharknado. Draft the traps, rig the sand, then run for your life as the water rises.

3954620.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning Demo
3954620.short_description: Start your trucking sim adventure in a massive demo without playtime limits. Explore the full countryside map in a customizable truck. Do transport jobs, meet people, and start expanding the business on your journey to fortune and greatness.

5306120.name: Rig the Casino Demo
5306120.short_description:
The house always wins. So stop playing fair — RIG IT.

ROGUELIKE LUCK-ENGINE BUILDER where you GAMBLE, CHOOSE UPGRADES, and RIG THE CASINO.

4806180.name: Imperium
4806180.short_description: Imperium is a single-player 4X space strategy game. Colonize alien worlds, design your own spaceships, research exotic technologies, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy or open war. Build a galactic empire and rule it your way.

4200960.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
4200960.short_description: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

4758430.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival Demo
4758430.short_description: Survive, build, and grow your own life in Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival Demo. Explore dangerous wilderness, gather resources, farm, craft equipment, and create a safe haven deep in the wild in this Demo.

4457280.name: Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival
4457280.short_description: Survive, build, and grow your own life in Isolation Instinct: Farming, Craft, Survival. Explore dangerous wilderness, gather resources, farm, craft equipment, and create a safe haven deep in the wild.

1757350.name: ILL
1757350.short_description: A realistic first-person action horror game that takes you into a dark fort overtaken by a mysterious entity. Unpredictable monsters, a visceral dismemberment system, and realistic physics create an atmosphere of relentless terror.

4766910.name: Project Angels 2
4766910.short_description: The visual novel sequel to Project Angels. Steel Waters and Apollyon—two factions of the ANGELS have tormented the Indicus Ocean for years. Their maker, a Puppetmaster turned Savior, now aims to balance the two beliefs of liberty and stability, all while reuniting what was whole under a new home.

5080330.name: SnowDesktop
5080330.short_description: A desktop that looks good and works well. SnowDesktop puts components at the heart of Windows desktop organization and personalization. Organize apps and files, keep schedules in view, and make the desktop your own with Dock, Quick Navigation, Icon beautification, themes and Steam Workshop.

4321140.name: DIVE or DIE - Children of Rain Demo
4321140.short_description: Try the opening of DIVE or DIE in this free demo. Experience the complete tutorial and survive your first 10 days. Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice.

3251280.name: Rivals Hover League
3251280.short_description:
'Rivals Hover League' is a vehicular arena combat game where players battle in arenas across the galaxy using hover vehicles with various abilities.
Join your teammates and show off your skills - hover, boost, shoot your way to become the MVP!

5085980.name: After Green Demo
5085980.short_description: Stack upgrades and forge relic-and-tower synergies as cute zombie hordes closing in. Dash, shoot and build defenses in this horde-survival roguelite as you choose your road to the Horde King, solo or in co-op. Fall, and your Last Wish powers the next run back to the floor that killed you!

3176290.name: Fishing Up
3176290.short_description: Catch 48 unique fish and complete collections in a relaxing fishing game. Explore different locations, use various baits and rods, and enjoy a peaceful angling experience.

3245870.name: Wesley Smith's Repair Game Demo
3245870.short_description: Help Wesley Smith to collect items, craft weapons and defeat his opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

4841590.name: Dungebra
4841590.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

4464400.name: Tyrants Must Fall
4464400.short_description: In this turn-based tactical roguelike, build an army to triumph in fast-paced battles. Deploy your troops, plan your attack, and watch as the action plays out simultaneously. Unlock powerful formations and guide the Hero of Destiny as he topples the Tyrant King!

3154460.name: Office Party
3154460.short_description: Office Party is a fully 3D edgy comedy adventure game inspired by classic comedies of the '90s, and also the long awaited sequel to House Party.  Dive into the craziness and debauchery with all new characters, game mechanics and locations, and maybe a visit from some old party friends.

3188660.name: Motocross The Game
3188660.short_description: A hyper-realistic motocross simulator built by riders, for riders. Control bike and rider as two separate physics bodies, race online through matchmaking or private lobbies, and chase the clock on live global time-attack leaderboards. Assists let newcomers learn at their own pace.

4996960.name: Handle with Care
4996960.short_description: A co-op delivery game where you play as tiny postal workers in a town that’s trying to kill you. Deliver everything from coffins to ticking bombs, escape rabid dogs and berserk drivers, and stay in business for six days to earn your pint on Sunday.

3348210.name: Super Yooka-Laylee Kart
3348210.short_description: The most skilful, expressive and explosive racer built around mastery, rivalry, and revenge-fuelled comebacks. Race through a solo campaign, compete against rivals online, or create your own custom race setups and challenge your friends.

5386900.name: Railtown
5386900.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

1044700.name: Hereditas
1044700.short_description: Found your house or lead one of eight noble families in a medieval realm. Raise a castle stone by stone, furnish its halls, command companions and armies, and win the crown through war, trade and diplomacy – or hold what you built against every siege.

4771440.name: Camille Queen of Chess bots
4771440.short_description: Play chess against bots with real personalities  each bound by its own rules, moods, and game plans, not just a difficulty slider. Drill your openings, review every game, and climb from casual sparring to serious battles against the strong Camille engine. Fully offline.

4683590.name: Pale Tide
4683590.short_description:
A top-down zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog scavenge resources from deadly infected zones. 
Rescue survivors, and return to a hidden bunker to upgrade your gear, grow your crew, and prepare your escape before the largest horde ever witnessed floods the region, the Pale Tide.

5357510.name: Stellar Ascendancy
5357510.short_description: Build an interstellar civilization in a turn-based 4X strategy game. Explore a configurable galaxy, colonize new worlds, design warships, manage a complex economy, and outmaneuver rival empires through diplomacy, espionage, or war.

2480840.name: Wesley Smith's Repair Game
2480840.short_description: Help Wesley Smith to collect items, craft weapons and defeat his opponents in this frustratingly funny arcade game. Compete against the merciless bots or up to three friends in couch co-op mode to become the master blacksmith!

4440780.name: Macromancer
4440780.short_description: Macromancer is a programming RPG sandbox where anything can be automated with the power of Python. Live out the fantasy of botting in an online RPG, playing alongside your many, many friends (assuming python scripts count as friends).

4698670.name: Samota Demo
4698670.short_description: Samota is a Solitaire roguelike deckbuilder. You don't draw cards but instead arrange a pile of cards so it will create huge synergy. Find a bunch of unique effects, buffs, modifiers, relics and uncover the secret this game hides! All of it so that the number goes big and bigger!

5415860.name: Beach Volleyball VR
5415860.short_description: Beach Volleyball VR brings 2v2 beach volleyball to virtual reality. Pass, set, spike, serve and block using natural VR movements, play complete matches against bots, or jump online and play with friends.

5088390.name: The Gaffer
5088390.short_description: For anyone who misses the football management games of the 80s. Start in the Fourth Division in 1959 and manage thirty seasons of English football by the real rules of each season, while your board, your pub and your town remember every result and every excuse.

4706870.name: 疫区求生 Demo
4706870.short_description: "Infected Zone Survival" is an open world zombie apocalypse survival game. The game is mainly based on third person action shooting, and can be searched, disguised, built, made, cultivated, fished,hunted, recruited NPCs, simulated management, etc.

4711930.name: Slidegame
4711930.short_description: Slide through strange megastructures with incredible speed.

4486670.name: TALLREAPER
4486670.short_description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

4704000.name: Shark Mart
4704000.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

3270430.name: Systemic War
3270430.short_description: Lead your nation in a modern grand strategy game (2008–2025), using a macroeconomic model with exchange rates, diplomacy, and hybrid warfare. Engage in kinetic warfare on the strategic map, then shift to RTS battles at focal points.

5433480.name: The Lords Next Door
5433480.short_description: Your fighting days are over. Settle a little frontier town, hire heroes at the tavern and clear the monster camps in the woods. Then get to know the lords next door: visit, swap gifts and stand guard for each other when raiders come over the border.

1482470.name: Pirates Republic
1482470.short_description: Build your pirate republic from nothing. Survive, cook, trade, and plunder your way through a procedurally generated Caribbean in this open-world survival sandbox. No fantasy - just history, grit, and freedom. Play solo or with friends in co-op.

5221600.name: Apprentice Mage Gale Demo
5221600.short_description: Apprentice Mage Gale is an Autobattler RPG where your entire party depends on you. You are their ONLY damage dealer, so master 16 spells, build your mage through 100+ skill nodes, overcome monsters and bosses, and fight across eight lands on the road to the Demon Lord.

5152560.name: Quadrillion Carrots
5152560.short_description: 🥕Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos. 🤖

5039880.name: Maiden Legion
5039880.short_description: In this world, rotate and clear energy blocks to summon members of the Maiden Legion and fight alongside them. Rescue your captured companions, unlock their unique abilities, and protect the city together. Level up to unlock intimate, unabashed daily life moments with the girls.

4934700.name: FATE PACK Demo
4934700.short_description: FATE PACK is a ruthless PvP auto-battler: weapon decay forces you to adapt, and skill choices are permanent. Merge gear, build combos, and prove your mettle against real players!

5008690.name: After Green
5008690.short_description: Stack upgrades and forge relic-and-tower synergies as cute zombie hordes closing in. Dash, shoot and build defenses in this horde-survival roguelite as you choose your road to the Horde King, solo or in co-op. Fall, and your Last Wish powers the next run back to the floor that killed you!

4413390.name: Firefighting Rescue Simulator
4413390.short_description: Step into the boots of a firefighter in Firefighting Rescue Simulator. Drive fire trucks, battle intense blazes, rescue civilians, and use advanced tools across three cities. Every mission tests your speed, skill, and courage.

5451710.name: Bedtime Battalion
5451710.short_description: When the house falls asleep, the toys go to war! Command wobbly toy soldiers across a child's bedroom and six ages of history, from cavemen to tanks, in physics battles where a vacuum cleaner, a giant ball or the lights going out can turn any fight.

2022610.name: CRETE
2022610.short_description:
Fight against the Ancestors and other biopunk creatures. Use their DNA to build your own procedural weapons, find a friend and combine your skills to be even more powerful.
The further you go, the better rewards you will get for the next run. It is up to you to reveal what is up there in the north.

5331160.name: Television Dynasty Manager
5331160.short_description: Take over your own station at the dawn of television and turn it into America's greatest TV dynasty. Produce your own series, shows and films, secure the best programs, build studios, expand your broadcast area and plan the perfect schedule. But the competition never sleeps.

5100810.name: Football Card Tycoon Demo
5100810.short_description: Open your own football card shop! Stock up, rip packs, set your prices, and hunt holo, autograph, and serial-numbered cards. Build an all-star lineup, conquer the card leagues, and win the World Championship!

5430600.name: Kandallo
5430600.short_description: A short claymation horror game about feeding a strange fireplace.

5445260.name: Who's the Biggest Degen?
5445260.short_description: You and 3 friends owe Tony the Octopus a lot of money. Gamble on 30 casino games across 8 floors, slap, rob and sabotage each other, and pay Tony every night, or he takes your stuff, pants included. After 5 nights, only one of you is the Biggest Degen.

5361000.name: Breakkaboom Demo
5361000.short_description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks. Break stuff with them and just enjoy a fun playground! You can also explore mysterious simulation worlds, but when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

5066750.name: Tom the Postgirl Soundtrack
5066750.short_description:
Step into the strange and unsettling world of Tom the postgirl with the game's original soundtrack.
A collection of creepy-cute tracks inspired by Tom's adventures and the mysterious village she calls home.

4520000.name: National Park Tycoon
4520000.short_description: Bring your national park to life! Balance nature preservation with visitor enjoyment as you build peaceful trails, cozy campsites, fun activities and more. Rise through the ranger ranks, collect badges, and watch your parks grow into places you’re proud to call your own in this 2D simulation game.

5385030.name: Dawn Archive
5385030.short_description: Choose rooms. Rotate them. Connect your path. Shape a mysterious mansion in this exploration and puzzle adventure. With limited steps and keys, solve puzzles and follow clues in forgotten records to reach the archive deep within.

4621810.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator
4621810.short_description: Run your own ice cream shop in a vibrant Caribbean setting! Prepare ice cream, mix flavors, add toppings, serve customers, keep your shop clean, restock ingredients, hire staff, and expand your shop from a small stand into a busy business.

4855410.name: ケロロ軍曹☆ ハチャメチャTVショー 　～賞金ゲット大作戦であります！～

5335530.name: Deathand
5335530.short_description: The sorcerer Velkorin has cursed the land, and only you are mad enough to go down after him. Crawl his dungeon tile by tile with a single card burning in your hand for light. Every fight is a card battle, and every card you burn to see by is one you cannot fight with.

5030630.name: Carry Bros: Find It Together
5030630.short_description: Hide objects, search industrial locations, and outsmart the opposing team in a fast-paced online party game. Play as Hiders or Seekers, use special abilities and power-ups, and complete your objective before time runs out!

5446570.name: JAILPOT
5446570.short_description: Inmate 4417. Forty years. Nobody here has ever been released. In here money is cigarettes: scratch, roll, spin and bet your way across nine prison gambling tables, pay every boss his cut before roll call, keep your family's rent paid, and gamble your way out.

5117870.name: Antillia
5117870.short_description: Rebuild a fallen seafaring family in this single-player exploration RPG set in the 15th century. Read winds and currents, follow rumors to discoveries, and fund expeditions through trade and patronage. Face naval battles and duels as you write a family chronicle across generations.

5184700.name: Beantopis Demo
5184700.short_description: Beans only know how to do one thing, and that is to kill. You must prevent this. Navigate the structure and remove all Beans. After completing a zone, you will be rewarded with a gift that can help you survive the next zone. Be warned, the structure will be different every run.

4457370.name: Farm Simulator 2026
4457370.short_description: Build and grow your own modern farm in Farm Simulator 2026. Cultivate fields, harvest crops, raise animals, operate powerful machinery, and expand your farming business across a large open world with dynamic weather and a day-night cycle.

4668470.name: hexGame: Hero Path
4668470.short_description: The world needs a hero — choose yours. Any NPC can become the chosen one. Explore a living, procedurally generated hex world, carve your own path, craft unique combinations of weapons, tools, and relics, and fight through relentless hordes in fast-paced combat. Every run is different.

5082160.name: Sisyphus Inc. Demo
5082160.short_description:
(The demo contains the 8 first levels of Sisyphus inc.)
Train Imps to push Jerry the Boulder, speak with various inhabitant of the Underworld, and resist the unpleased gods to free Sisyphus from his eternal punishment in a short incremental et narrative game.

5335510.name: Moon Sweepers
5335510.short_description: An entire Moon to clean. One toothbrush to start. Team up with up to 16 players, collect and sell lunar dust, upgrade your tools, and unlock cleaning vehicles. Turn a ridiculous job into a thriving operation, if your friends actually help.

4661610.name: Farming Incremental But With Guns Playtest

1020280.name: Deslot
1020280.short_description: A realistic miniature racing game featuring Die-Cast, Slot, and Mini RC cars. Master momentum, throttle, and precision driving across handcrafted and procedurally generated diorama tracks. Build your own circuits, customize your cars, and race through Career, Challenges, and Multiplayer.

2426390.name: Farmion
2426390.short_description: Build your dream farm and grow a village around it in this cozy voxel farming and life sim, solo or with friends. Grow crops, raise animals, and turn your harvest into meals, bouquets and cheese for your own café, grocery store and flower shop. Your farm keeps growing while you’re away.

4530370.name: Football Manager 27
4530370.short_description: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline as foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a more enticing football world. Out from November 10.

2154420.name: Never Alone 2
2154420.short_description: Discover a world of fierce, frozen beauty in Never Alone 2, sequel to the BAFTA-winning adventure game created in the Inupiaq storytelling tradition. Explore the Arctic as Nuna and Fox, unearthing an epic mystery threatening your community in this new 3D, co-op adventure.

2932260.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
2932260.short_description: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fairytale world.

2712390.name: One More Tower
2712390.short_description: One More Tower is a horde survival TD set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer an unexplored forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the onslaught of enemies. How long can you survive?

4438400.name: Eldritch Break
4438400.short_description: Vibrant, high-octane 2.5D Boomer Shooter that smashes together the fast-paced action of classics like Doom and Duke Nukem with the mind-bending, non-Euclidean environments of an eldritch prison.

3367810.name: Cemetery Simulator
3367810.short_description: Carry the coffin with your crew and build the best necropolis! Dig graves, lower coffins, and keep everything tidy. Decorate the area to earn the prestige needed to unlock new sectors. Play solo or in co-op mode for up to 4 players, facing vandals and ghosts!

5057660.name: Pop Pop Arena
5057660.short_description: Aim carefully. Blame your friends. Pop Pop Arena is an online physics party game for up to 8 players. Choose your direction and power, launch together, and send rivals flying. Be the last Pop standing in Knockout or race to the finish in Marathon.

4713640.name: Heavy Mental: A Co-op Action Roguelite Demo
4713640.short_description: Experience 3D Run 'n Gun chaos! Fight on foot as a Cyborg or lead an Iron Snake tank with modular trailers. Blast through dual-wielding grandmas and teleporting ninjas to conquer 5 massive fortresses. Upgrade with power cards in this high-octane Co-op Action Roguelite. Join the siege!

3348370.name: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3
3348370.short_description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard in a completely new level of realism, scale, and freedom!

4847900.name: Lofelia's Cozy Corner
4847900.short_description:
Meet Lofelia, your dreamy desktop companion who writes books as you work, study or game. In this cozy clicker game, every time you press a key Lofelia continues to write her stories.

How will you decorate Lofelia's Cozy Corner?

3624160.name: Cardtographer Demo
3624160.short_description: Collect cards, build synergistic decks and adapt your strategy to survive escalating encounters. Choose your own path in a procedurally generated world filled with danger around every corner.

5453610.name: AI Office Idle: Night Shift
5453610.short_description: Run an office of parody AI models through the night. Work jobs by hand, buy models like Llamba and Clawed into desks, and keep them cool with fans, a battery and solar panels. Pivot for Vision, open five offices on a city map and take the company public.

4434860.name: Drive Thru Fast Food Simulator
4434860.short_description: Run your own first-person drive-thru restaurant 🍔 Take orders, cook in real time, manage supplies, clean your kitchen, and serve cars under pressure. Balance speed, precision, and reputation to turn your small fast-food spot into the city’s favorite.

3376960.name: Nighthold
3376960.short_description: Sandbox survival RPG where days are for preparation and nights are for survival. Gather resources, build and fortify your shelter, fight the Rot and raiders - solo or with friends in online co-op.

4878820.name: No Prospects Demo
4878820.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

5320140.name: The Legend of Pepino
5320140.short_description: Level up your character, battle hordes of monsters, earn money to unlock items and spells for your class, and face powerful bosses along the way.

4067630.name: Wetland
4067630.short_description: Dare enter the cursed swamp with your friends. Find the hidden Lab. Extract the Artifact. Get out alive. But as hallucinations spread, reality fractures. You saw it. They swear it never happened. Who will you trust? Who will you fight? Can you still trust your own mind?

5151370.name: Grenade! : Pang Pang Survive!
5151370.short_description: A party game for up to 8 players where the crowd throws grenades, bombs and food onto the field. Catch grenades and throw them back to survive, and mix kart races, football, basketball, hockey, beach volleyball and obstacle courses into the same match.

5001530.name: Xenomire Demo
5001530.short_description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

3650580.name: Golden Tides
3650580.short_description: Forget everything you know about MOBAs. Gather your crew and charge into explosive 4v4 battles across land and sea in Golden Tides. Whether you sail for glory or just for the chaos, every 20–25 minute voyage brings unpredictable encounters, epic ship battles, and tales worth telling at the tavern.

4762570.name: Lust Shelter
4762570.short_description: Apocalypse survival meets incremental adventure. By day, scavenge the wasteland and fight mutated beasts. By night, return to your shelter and have some fun with the girls. The world outside is brutal, but your shelter is pure bliss.

4777680.name: Lust Shelter Demo
4777680.short_description: Apocalypse survival meets incremental adventure. By day, scavenge the wasteland and fight mutated beasts. By night, return to your shelter and have some fun with the girls. The world outside is brutal, but your shelter is pure bliss.

5295290.name: Paladin HC
5295290.short_description: Command a 3D Paladin self-propelled howitzer in scenarios based on real military operations. Calculate firing range, adjust your tactical position, manage resources, and support your allies. Love military games? Add Paladin HC to your Steam wishlist and support our indie team!

2668250.name: Dragona: Fireborne
2668250.short_description: A PC free-to-play MMORPG set in the cursed realm of Bartan. As a Dragona warrior, transform into mighty dragons to face Jurtan's influence. Immerse in rich lore, landscapes, and battles against darkness. Unleash the Dragona within and rise in this dark fantasy adventure. Bartan's fate awaits.

4885910.name: How to grow a man
4885910.short_description: A 17+ BL raising sim where you decide who leads. Spend four years on classes, part-time jobs, and questionable outfits, then romance seven very different men. Your stats determine whether you end up on top or bottom, and your choices unlock dozens of endings.

4639760.name: Radioactive Roses
4639760.short_description: Radioactive Roses is a deckbuilding, tactical RPG. Explore the wasteland, fight mutants, scavage for resources, and... met cute and horny ladies where most guys died, and you are one of the last surviving males!

4413410.name: Dinosaur Survival Simulator - Prehistoric RPG
4413410.short_description: Survive as a dinosaur in a dangerous prehistoric world. Hunt, hide, and grow from a fragile hatchling to a powerful predator. Explore diverse biomes, battle rivals and T-Rex, and unlock new species in this ultimate survival evolution experience.

5127870.name: shlack!
5127870.short_description: Shlack! is a top-down roguelite where you play as an artist trapped inside their own magazine. Survive against your own characters and drawings.

5133330.name: LINER/TRACER
5133330.short_description: LINER/TRACER is a stylish 2D action game where you fight using both your mouse and keyboard. Master fast, fluid mouse-controlled movement, evasive maneuvers, and attacks to defeat your enemies.

5394390.name: shlack! Demo
5394390.short_description: Shlack! is a top-down roguelite where you play as an artist trapped inside their own magazine. Survive against your own characters and drawings.

3980340.name: Imprinted
3980340.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

2670430.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
2670430.short_description: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

2597610.name: モノノケの国
2597610.short_description: Restore villages, purify yokai, and reclaim a lost world in this Japanese-inspired action-adventure set in an otherworld inhabited by Mononoke. Journey through the corrupted Mononoke no Kuni, recover the stolen soul of Musashi the Shiba Inu, and set out on a grand adventure to return home.

5434200.name: TRIROAD
5434200.short_description: A turn-based board game for 2! Place triangle pieces in turn and be first to connect two of your colored spots on the board's edge. Decided within 24 moves, yet no one knows if a winning strategy exists. With a reinforcement-learning AI, 50 puzzles and an editor, a real-time 3D mode and online play.

5013160.name: Hubble Bubble
5013160.short_description: Co-op hookah shop sim for 1 to 4 friends. Run Ghalyan's Hookah Lounge on a space station: pack the bowl, light the coals, serve the aliens and act normal. Nothing on this station is normal.

5313710.name: Cat Over Here! Demo
5313710.short_description: A cozy 3D hunt through a stylish monochrome factory full of hidden cats! Slow down, explore every corner at your own pace, search behind machines, and enjoy a stress-free game of hide-and-seek. No timers, no rush—can you find every single cat hiding in the factory?

3196610.name: AFTERZERO - The Last Drive
3196610.short_description: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.

4247230.name: GONE DIGGING
4247230.short_description: Dig together by day. Feed the darkness by night. A 1–4 player co-op digging thriller where loot, upgrades, and sacrifices decide who survives after sundown.

2716830.name: Don't Fret
2716830.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

4437580.name: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds
4437580.short_description: A mysterious vortex pulls you out of reality. Play as Max, trapped between unknown worlds. Explore, observe, and solve puzzles to progress… but something may try to stop you. 🎮 Demo available — add it to your wishlist.

2677390.name: The Cube Will Kill You
2677390.short_description: Trapped in a shifting 7x7x7 cube of trap rooms, up to 8 players race for the one exit. Only the first one out survives, everybody else burns. Grab items, bluff with flags, bomb your rivals. Trust no one.

4086550.name: Kingdom of Hope
4086550.short_description: Rise from nine years of tyranny to rebuild a scarred medieval land. As a celebrated hero, you’re granted a farmstead by the new King. Forge a fresh life of growth, craft, and community.

5292500.name: ゆめみるサクラの卒業式
5292500.short_description: 卒業式は、何度でも壊れていく。友だちのどちらに先に話しかけるかを選ぶだけの、何気ない一日のはずだった。話しかける順番で会話の内容が変わり、周回を重ねるたびに景色が少しずつ歪んでいく。仲の良い友だちの顔から、なぜか笑顔が消えていく。真実に気づいた時、その卒業式はもう、はじめの卒業式ではない。これは友情を描いたノベルアドベンチャーです。周回を重ねるほど、目を背けたくなる真実に近づいていきます。壊れるところまで、丁寧に。

5429090.name: Bouture - Chinese money plant
5429090.short_description: Pilea peperomioides. Round coin leaves on long stalks. Dries in 6 days.

5425700.name: Bouture
5425700.short_description: Pot little living plants on your Windows desktop. They grow while you work, droop when they're thirsty and bloom after weeks of care. Water them, take cuttings and fill your herbarium: a calm companion that lives behind your windows, or above them.

3679340.name: CAM Model Simulator 2026
3679340.short_description: From first post to full-blown icon - manage fans, cash, and chaos in the ultimate exclusive model simulator. Fame has never been this hands-on.

4550700.name: Pup & Mole: Gold Rush
4550700.short_description: Join Pup & Mole on a cozy mining adventure across 7 historical areas. Hop into your minecart, build rail tracks, and dig deeper for hidden artifacts. Upgrade your gear, unlock new tools, and complete your collection while earning money by selling gold and rare treasures.

5247500.name: 霓虹赌途 Demo
5247500.short_description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

5208900.name: Homegrown: Sports Agent Empire
5208900.short_description: Run a sports agency, not a team. Recruit stars across four leagues, negotiate under real salary-cap rules, survive scandals and holdouts, then retire to an interactive career review and post your score to the monthly global leaderboard. Premium, no microtransactions.

5428840.name: Bouture - Cutting in a jar
5428840.short_description: Monstera adansonii. A cutting rooting in a jar of water, with its roots in plain sight. Dries in 5 days.

2882720.name: Koshmar: The Last Reverie
2882720.short_description: When a city falls to a sleeping plague, nightmares rise up. Awaken the city as a mortician’s daughter who walks the line between the sleeping and the waking. Fight through the dreams, seal the rifts, make choices that chip away at who she is, try to become the nightmare that nightmares fear.

4714820.name: SuperReap
4714820.short_description: Super Reap is a cozy active incremental harvesting game where you swing your scythe through wildly overgrown crops, sell resources for coins, unlock talents, skill cards, gear, and new harvesting methods, and transform a rundown farm into an efficient reaping paradise.

1877490.name: Projekt Melody: A Nut Between Worlds
1877490.short_description: Experience the world's first and most ambitious NEXT GEN HENTAI GAME! With a bit of luck, above-average sexual skills, and a party of beautiful waifus and husbandos at your side, save the entire goddamn Cyberverse from a world-eating corruption in Projekt Melody: A Nut Between Worlds!

5108430.name: Border Control Together
5108430.short_description: Border Control Together is a first-person border checkpoint simulator for 1-4 players. Check documents, inspect vehicles, uncover contraband, manage your earnings, upgrade the checkpoint, and decide whether to follow the law or profit from corruption.

3456660.name: PAYDAY: Aces High
3456660.short_description:
Nothing hits like the moment the mask comes on. Plan bold jobs, pull off stylish chaos, and take down a business titan - one explosive score at a time. High stakes, big money, no mercy: PAYDAY: Aces High is the definitive VR co-op heist game for up to 4 players.

Revenge has never felt so good.

4151710.name: Deckromancer: Haven and Hell
4151710.short_description: A fast-paced deckbuilding action roguelite where every run is shaped by the cards you draw. Build powerful synergies, cast spells, summon allies and switch between Haven and Hell while battling a dynamic Fate Deck that unleashes deadly enemies, hazards and unexpected events.

4658920.name: Fate & Felt
4658920.short_description: Fate & Felt is a single-player poker roguelite built on Texas Hold’em. Read opponents, manage chips, and choose when to check, call, raise, fold, or go all-in. Roll skill dice and combine character abilities, Magic cards, Jokers, and shifting rules through three chapters and four modes.

4556610.name: Nudus
4556610.short_description: Welcome to Nudus — an adult merge strategy game where real-time arena battles, tactical deck building, and seductive 18+ rewards come together.

4977420.name: KleptoMagia
4977420.short_description: KleptoMagia is a unique real-time deckbuilder with no turns. Prepare your deck, react to enemy attacks, and play every card at the perfect moment.

3081510.name: Gang of Frogs
3081510.short_description: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

2315050.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
2315050.short_description: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

4631740.name: Mayhem À La Carte
4631740.short_description: Cook, fight, and serve under pressure in this chaotic 4-player co-op first-person cooking shooter. Prepare delicious meals, defend your kitchen from relentless enemies, and keep the orders flowing before everything falls apart.

5013850.name: 薪上人 Salaryman Demo
5013850.short_description: This is a simulation management and development + romance adventure GalGame. As an unemployed individual short on funds, you encounter various girls while working part-time, sharing the hardships of survival and sparking emotional sparks amidst the mundane daily life.

5395760.name: Pawnshop Together Demo
5395760.short_description: Run your own pawn shop solo or with up to 3 friends! Buy, negotiate, inspect, repair, and sell items to build your business and find new ways to make money around town.

3454860.name: Clerks and Quirks
3454860.short_description: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Tame them to unlock powerful bonuses in this chaotic co-op roguelite: cook dishes, craft gear, and serve demanding customers as you scramble through the weekly rush, solo or with up to 4 friends.

3723710.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
3723710.short_description: Parenthood as told through a cozy, psychedelic, puzzle adventure. Solve hand-drawn escape room-inspired puzzles inside a baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

4836910.name: Grand Vista Hotel
4836910.short_description: Build and manage a growing hotel. Earn stars, upgrade rooms and elevators, add restaurants, spas, conferences and events, and transform a small family hotel into a luxury Palace.

5441650.name: Ashen Marches
5441650.short_description: Ashen Marches is a turn-based tactics RPG played like a tabletop campaign. Roll the dice, parry the blows you see coming, and lead two heroes to the Dragon Cave, alone or with a friend in online co-op.

5153220.name: UFO98
5153220.short_description: UFO98 is a retro incremental simulation game set on an isolated Win98 desktop. Decrypt encrypted alien signals, leak top-secret files, and defy an oppressive government to awaken humanity to the truth.

4545160.name: Dali's Adventure: Lost Worlds Demo
4545160.short_description: Investigate, explore, and solve puzzles inside a mysterious Sheriff Office. An immersive demo blending exploration and logic.

5304530.name: AUTOMATE DEATH
5304530.short_description: AUTOMATE DEATH in this physically simulated incremental tower defense game, as thousands upon thousands of green-skinned goblins pour into your homeland. Defend humanity. Industrialize the battlefield. Slaughter the green bastards with lead fired at increasingly unreasonable velocities.

5107610.name: Joker's Last Call Demo
5107610.short_description: A dark casino roguelike based on One Card, a fast and aggressive Korean card game rarely seen outside Korea. Stack attacks, counter two rivals, build rule-bending relic combinations, and reverse a deadly chain with a single Joker.

4801680.name: Goddle
4801680.short_description: A party word game where everyone plays from their phone. No app, no extra controllers: scan, type, score. Any number of players, six game modes, mix languages in the same round, and build your own dictionaries.

4466850.name: Where is My Pet?
4466850.short_description: Where is My Pet? is a hidden object, sorting, and animal game! Run your cozy shelter: place animals, sell them to loving homes, upgrade your shelter, build your dream house, and search the city for pets. Can you turn a shabby shelter into a profitable business?

5263230.name: クリッカータクティクス：記憶の断章 体験版
5263230.short_description: A clicker × auto-battle tactics game where you place your companions on a 3×3 grid. Link chains with a wide variety of skills and relics, and mow down the hordes surging toward you. An exhilarating incremental RPG where every adventure makes you stronger.

5428800.name: Bouture - Air plant
5428800.short_description: Tillandsia ionantha. No soil and no pot: it simply sits on your desktop. The most forgiving plant, dry in 10 days.

4457310.name: BMX CITY RUN
4457310.short_description: Ride, stunt, and explore extreme locations in BMX CITY RUN. Perform daring tricks, complete missions, and unlock new bikes as you push your cycling skills to the limit across dynamic environments.

3107530.name: Danchi Days
3107530.short_description: A slice-of-life adventure with a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in a 2000s Japanese neighborhood! Play as 12-year-old Hoshino, revive a summer festival, reconnect with neighbors, and uncover truths about her grandma living with dementia.

1551260.name: Solid River
1551260.short_description: Thrive in a realistic environment where crafting, building, and survival meet the intrigue of medieval life. Construct inspiring structures and cultivate a community of loyal villagers. Your ingenuity is your strength. Your will is your weapon.

4124360.name: SandEEE
4124360.short_description: Write code for an alternate universe in SandEEE, just keep in mind "EEE sees all".

440000.name: Portal 2: Community Edition
440000.short_description: Portal 2: Community Edition (P2:CE) is a community-maintained version of Portal 2 that significantly enhances the way you make and play content, offering new capabilities such as a brand-new scripting system, an improved Hammer map editor and significantly increased limits over the original game.

5254720.name: Astral Echelons Demo
5254720.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter! This Demo shows off the first four levels of the full game plus the first bonus level.

5428920.name: Bouture - Calathea
5428920.short_description: Goeppertia orbifolia. Broad round leaves striped with silver. Dries in 5 days.

2966240.name: Factory Survival
2966240.short_description: Build and create automated factories to produce items of increasing complexity, within an infinite 3D world. Use your imagination to design your factory, combine simple elements into ingenious structures, and finally escape from creatures who don't really like you.

5424160.name: DerbiManager
5424160.short_description: Take charge of a club, sit in the dugout and answer to the board. Transfers you have to negotiate, a youth academy, finances, training and scouts. And at kick-off you choose: the final score right away, or the match in 3D, to watch or to play yourself. 1,000 clubs, 60 leagues, 47 countries.

5070080.name: 下海灘–賭博之聖傳說 DX Demo
5070080.short_description: To defeat the legendary "Demon of Gamblers," next-gen "God of Gamblers" Johnny Ko enters her illicit offshore casino, the Aurelius. Under the Demon of Gamblers' command, three seductive female executives await him. A high-stakes showdown of life and pleasure is about to begin!

5251070.name: Want a Bomb?
5251070.short_description: Explore an island in search of the Sun Gem, solo or with up to 4 players online. Blast through mountains, sell ore, research and upgrade your gear, and take on monsters. From chain reactions to launchers that send friends flying, carve your own path!

5428890.name: Bouture - Flamingo flower
5428890.short_description: Strelitzia reginae. Tall paddle leaves, and an orange and blue crest for those who care for it four weeks. Dries in 7 days.

4098920.name: BRICK 2 - Rags 2 Riches
4098920.short_description: You start with a brick. Everything else you take, make or steal. Build a base, run a crew and raid other players in online PvP, on an island of gangs, police and SWAT shared with twenty AI survivors who build, form clans and raid whether you turn up or not.

3238070.name: Bubbits Demo
3238070.short_description: Pop your way to victory in a colorful next generation Bubble Shooter! Beat 24 other players in battle royale, play VS mode with friends or go on a singleplayer adventure. Bubbits is packed with cute customization, explosive power ups and crazy battle events to shake up the game!

3206650.name: Paraxima Demo
3206650.short_description: Welcome to E.S.C. As a team of 1-3, your job is to respond to paranormal outbreaks of The Static. Investigate either as a Field Agent or an Operator. Establish the chain of events with evidence to identify the Entity. Follow the protocol to seal it.

4962500.name: Dread Rune
4962500.short_description: A roguelike RPG inspired by Pixel Dungeon. Choose from 12 heroes, explore ever-changing dungeons, and master 130+ items that wear down with use. Every run is a test of combat skill, strategy, and knowing when to use what you've got.

4889850.name: Rollgeon
4889850.short_description: Build your own collection of customizable dice and battle your way through the dungeon in this turn-based roguelike. Roll, reroll, and create powerful combos inspired by the classic dice game Generala. Enchant your dice, manipulate the odds, and discover new builds with every run.

5066370.name: Night Plane Demo
5066370.short_description: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

5428910.name: Bouture - Bird of paradise
5428910.short_description: Strelitzia reginae. Tall paddle leaves, and an orange and blue crest for those who care for it four weeks. Dries in 7 days.

5116240.name: MistWindow
5116240.short_description: A frosted glass launcher widget that sits on top of your desktop, with video for a background. Line up the apps and games you use most, and keep a clock, a volume mixer and what's now playing right beside them — a small window holding just the controls and information you need.

3126410.name: Expedition: Into Darkness
3126410.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

4779690.name: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol Demo
4779690.short_description: Inspect passengers, scan luggage, interrogate suspects, and uncover hidden contraband at an international airport. Use X-rays, metal detectors, and police dogs to stop smuggling and rise through the ranks in Airport Contraband Police.

1573550.name: LEGO® Skylines
1573550.short_description: Build what only you can in LEGO® Skylines. In this cozy, customizable city-builder, your choices bring a living, breathing metropolis to life. Go big or obsess over the details. No instructions. Unlimited space. And there’s just one rule. Make it yours.

5011210.name: GOLUBI Demo
5011210.short_description: An atmospheric, surreal story-driven adventure. Explore strange rooms, houses, and streets, meet unusual characters, and solve puzzles. Observe, listen, and piece together the story from fragments, because the world of GOLUBI won’t explain anything

4734550.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® Wonderworks
4734550.short_description: It’s the grand opening of a new RollerCoaster Tycoon, featuring new levels of chaos and wonder as you do whatever it takes to keep guests happy (and injury-free). Customize rides, manage guests, and build wild roller coasters in your theme parks as you boost profits and expand your empire.

5429140.name: Bouture - Cape sundew
5429140.short_description: Drosera capensis. Strap leaves beaded with sticky dew, and pink flowers after 16 days of care. Thirsty every 3 days.

5041080.name: Expedition: Into Darkness Demo
5041080.short_description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE coop extraction looter. Craft weapons, customize gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

5086720.name: Embrace Of The Embers
5086720.short_description:
Remember, what you see may not be real; what you believe may not be correct. 

This is not just an adventure to escape a nightmare, but also a journey questioning love, guilt, and loss. 

Welcome home, Arthur.
developers: Hunan Xinghe Yingchuang Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Hunan Xinghe Yingchuang Digital Technology Co., Ltd.

4413470.name: Airport Police Contraband Simulator - Border Patrol
4413470.short_description: Inspect passengers, scan luggage, interrogate suspects, and uncover hidden contraband at an international airport. Use X-rays, metal detectors, and police dogs to stop smuggling and rise through the ranks in Airport Contraband Police.

4836110.name: Gunfire & Magic - Desktop Co-op Extraction!
4836110.short_description:
A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends!

In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your base, and uncover your origins!

5429120.name: Bouture - Pitcher plant
5429120.short_description: Sarracenia leucophylla. Tall white trumpets veined with red, and a crimson flower after 26 days of care. Dries in 5 days.

5259970.name: Shot Rock
5259970.short_description: Shot Rock is a curling game where you call the shot, throw it, and sweep it home, presented like curling on TV. Two full teams take the ice in arenas and club venues. Play the AI, a friend, or players online.

2951600.name: Chefs Arena
2951600.short_description: Chefs Arena is a competitive party game you can play with your friends, family or online strangers. Cook dishes from whacky ingredients, fight monsters, sabotage, steal and feed an ever-hungry King.

3194090.name: Paraxima
