3194090.short_description: Welcome to E.S.C. As a team of 1-3, your job is to respond to paranormal outbreaks of The Static. Investigate either as a Field Agent or an Operator. Establish the chain of events with evidence to identify the Entity. Follow the protocol to seal it.

5181790.name: SIRIUS BFM Coach
5181790.short_description: A live dogfight coach for DCS World. Sirius watches your fight and talks you through it — naming the bandit before the merge, calling the flow and the threats as they develop, and debriefing you honestly afterwards. Spoken only, so it works on a monitor or in VR.

5429110.name: Bouture - Venus flytrap
5429110.short_description: Dionaea muscipula. Toothed traps that snap shut. Thirsty every 4 days.

3227750.name: Spartacus Blood Arena
3227750.short_description:
Fight for freedom through intense, tactical battles, crafted with the expertise of archaeology departments and reenactors from Rome, Capua, and Pompeii.
Prepare for glory. Prepare for blood!!!!

2340970.name: Railborn
2340970.short_description: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

3607400.name: Rise of the Spellbaker
3607400.short_description: In Rise of the Spellbaker, a charming hand-crafted, fairy-tale inspired Action-Adventure, one Witch finds herself to be the sole survivor of an unknown plague. With no-one but your loyal Cat Familiar by your side, set forth into the corrupted land.

5363890.name: Warmasters
5363890.short_description: A turn-based hex wargame where the deck decides who fights. Draw a Battle card, call up knights or archers or a war machine, and make a plan survive the order it is dealt. Two rulesets: a clean card game, or the full tabletop with nerve, toughness and charges.

5428950.name: Bouture - Peruvian apple cactus
5428950.short_description: Cereus peruvianus. A column with one arm, the only cactus. Dries in 16 days.

1777480.name: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades
1777480.short_description: Pathbreakers: Roaming Blades is a turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenaries in a medieval fantasy world. Try your hand at mercenary work, trading, or exploring, and keep your crew well stocked for brutal combat in a procedurally-generated open-world campaign.

2491550.name: Wandersky
2491550.short_description: Wandersky is a skybound top-down adventure with a single arrow and a flying house. Kuu and her companion Tama are on a mission to restore the land of Hyndara. Explore a huge world filled with puzzles, enemies and quests: the sky always carries those who dare to wander…

4830630.name: Spellogger Demo
4830630.short_description:
A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack.

Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

5050870.name: Dragon Decimator
5050870.short_description: A Clicker Game about Slaying a Dragon that Won't Take Forever to Complete! If it can bleed, it can die.

3563060.name: Rockhounds
3563060.short_description: Rockhounds is a 1-4 player extraction shooter where you and your squad brave the deadliest planets to extract minerals for ruthless Megacorps. Every mission is a fight for survival, wealth, and glory. Will you conquer the chaos and escape with your team? Gear up, and prove you’ve got what it takes!

5428650.name: Bouture - African violet
5428650.short_description: Saintpaulia ionantha. A low rosette that flowers at its heart. Dries in 5 days.

5394270.name: Trash Party Demo
5394270.short_description: Online co-op party game for up to 4 players. Drive a garbage truck through a colorful cartoon city, hang off the back, and sort recyclable, organic and glass into the right compartment. The faster your crew cleans every block, the more stars you earn.

5307590.name: Avalon: Legacy Edition Demo
5307590.short_description: Try the free demo of Avalon: Legacy Edition. Explore a distant world, face dangerous creatures and discover the first secrets of this classic 2D RPG, faithfully recreated by its original makers for modern systems.

4262710.name: Airship 2: Kingdoms Ablaze
4262710.short_description: Command fleets in tactical aerial battles, build trade and industrial networks, and shape diplomacy in this skypunk action simulation strategy game where rival powers clash for control of the skies.

5319690.name: Wasteland Gunsmith Simulator Demo
5319690.short_description: A cozy post-apocalyptic gunsmith simulator where you run a traveling workshop from the back of your camper. Craft, repair, restore, and customize unique weapons from scavenged junk while serving settlers, mercenaries, and gangs across the wasteland.

4964000.name: KalshwK
4964000.short_description: Get aboard the Ghost Train and fight with 99 lives worth of hardship to forge your own destiny with the unnatural grasp of KalshwK Desert : Top-Down 2d Roguelite Shooter

5415110.name: Monstarium
5415110.short_description: Tiny pixel monsters live along the bottom of your screen, and climb on top of your windows. Hatch eggs, merge twins to evolve them, and collect over 1,000 looks across 95 forms while you work. Pet them, toss them a treat, and watch them make friends.

4668060.name: Reshine Demo
4668060.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

3601670.name: Stellar Shipyard
3601670.short_description: Stellar Shipyard is a space colony sandbox where you design modular ships and stations, and automate resource production using drones and workers. Let the automated systems fly even the most improvised designs. Face rival factions and threats solo, or alongside friends as allies or rivals.

4213840.name: Gunsmith Simulator - Heavy Metal DLC
4213840.short_description: Heavy Metal DLC is a tribute to weapons that don’t do subtle - they just roar. This add-on brings four machine guns to Gunsmith Simulator: MG3, M60, PKP Pecheneg, and M249.

4434380.name: Blackout Route
4434380.short_description: The world has been taken over by the Synchronization Network. A co-op action horror game with crafting, raids, and extraction. Defend your base, rescue survivors, gather resources, fight Network Agents, disable Signals, and make it back to camp alive.

5142910.name: ORTHEVYR
5142910.short_description: ORTHEVYR is a dark fantasy third-person action RPG. Journey as a lone traveler through dangerous lands, master fast-paced combat, wield weapons and magic, customize your equipment, and face deadly creatures and formidable bosses.

2334320.name: Cthulhu Keeper
2334320.short_description: In this Lovecraftian real-time tactics game you play as a 1920s cult leader on a mission from the Old Ones. Build your cult, summon eldritch monsters, and undertake stealth tactics missions to spread insanity and amass power! In CTHULHU KEEPER you are the cosmic horror.

5361340.name: SPH: Neon Geometry Survivor
5361340.short_description: Neon geometry arcade survivor. Aim, dash and blast endless neon hordes with 12 weapons and 5 heroes, climb two global leaderboards, and clear a 20-level campaign with 4 boss showdowns. A fast, stylish twin-stick roguelite.

5140530.name: DEEPWARD Demo
5140530.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

4776500.name: Carry On Together
4776500.short_description: Carry On Together is a physics-based online co-op moving game for up to 4 players. Run a tiny delivery company with your friends: lift heavy furniture together, drive the truck across town and deliver everything in one piece… or don’t. Can you keep the company alive?

3288480.name: Gunsmith Simulator - Flint & Powder
3288480.short_description: Discover the secrets of historical firearms masters in the "Gunsmith Simulator - Flint & Powder" DLC! Repair, reconstruct, and test five unique models of historical flintlock weapons. Experience the craftsmanship of old gunsmiths and the history captured in iron and wood!

5107200.name: 72 Seconds
5107200.short_description: 72 Seconds is a fast-paced isometric action RTS where tactical squad micro meets ARPG progression. Command specialized units, build defenses, upgrade skill trees, and battle hostile alien threats. Adapt to randomized enemy affixes and survive high-stakes campaign permadeath.

4434770.name: We’re In Trouble
4434770.short_description: A CO-OP stealth game about a problem that can’t wait until morning. 🕵️‍♂️ An empty office, a body, and absolute silence. Work together, avoid guards and cameras, handle unpredictable physics, and escape unnoticed. One mistake can ruin everything.

2667460.name: KEMURI
2667460.short_description:
KEMURI is a Yokai-Possession Action Adventure set in KEMURI CITY, where the everyday and paranormal cross paths.
Explore as a Yokai Hunter, uncover the unseen with the FOXWINDOW, and wear their powers.
Run the streets, race across walls, and cut through the air to dive into the supernatural!

4637410.name: HYPE:Highschool Yokai Patrol & Exorcism
4637410.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op comedy-horror where you and your friends are running a highschool occult club. Chase rumors by day, sneak into the warped school at night to hunt a yokai, then Tape Seal its cursed object before everything goes wrong.

5359430.name: SNF Breakdown
5359430.short_description: An online multiplayer game for 1-6 players. Run a chaotic alien nursing home with your friends, care for unhinged residents, and sabotage your coworkers with a vast arsenal of weapons, traps, and chaos fruits. Whoever has the most points at the end of the shift wins.

3900570.name: Black Stars - The M87 Conflict
3900570.short_description: Command a rising interstellar empire in the M87 cluster. Explore and colonize distant worlds, build powerful economies, terraform hostile planets, deploy specialized fleets, and wage war against rival factions in a VR-exclusive galactic 4X strategy game where every decision shapes the conflict.

5248130.name: Prism Rules
5248130.short_description: Prism Rules is a game where you use mirrors and prisms to bend light and solve puzzles.

5070750.name: The Studio - Indie Grind
5070750.short_description: Build a game that generates a million dollar in revenue. Or sell a million units. 10 turns is all you get. Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run launch, clean up post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Economy, Turn based strategy.

3499740.name: Gunsmith Simulator - Fabryka Broni Radom
3499740.short_description: Fabryka Broni Radom – Polish Quality and Tradition in Gunsmith Simulator! Discover four legendary firearm models – the modern MSBS GROT, the iconic VIS wz. 35, the battle-proven Beryl wz. 96, and the compact Mini Beryl. Repair, explore history, and feel the passion for Polish engineering!

3177490.name: Bay 23
3177490.short_description: You're an expendable robot on the night shift. Haul packages through a procedurally generated warehouse, dodge a hunting AI and roaming sentinels, and get out before your battery dies. Co-op scavenger horror with full physics-based hauling.

5220900.name: PeeVPee Demo
5220900.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

5219690.name: Crack Surgeons 🍑
5219690.short_description: 🍑 Crack Surgeons is a chaotic co-op surgery game for 1 to 4 backyard doctors. Shrink down, venture inside patients deemed unsaveable by traditional medicine, and cure bizarre ailments from the inside out. Which way you go in is up to you! 🍑

4846060.name: Eugene Onegin vs. the Undead
4846060.short_description: An HD-remaster of a comedy-horror visual novel from 2009, mixing classical Russian literature with anime, zombies and glam rock.

4532500.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
4532500.short_description: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

4816340.name: Helrift Demo
4816340.short_description: Experience old-school MMORPG intensity in Helrift, where two towns clash. Battle for dominance in server-wide events, master a classless stat and skill-based progression system, and engage in high-stakes open-world PvP. Forge your path through crafting, trading, and tactical combat.

3199530.name: Dark Ruins: Nine Dragons Pulling the Coffin
3199530.short_description: Dark Ruins is a thrilling idle looter auto-battler! Train heroes to escort the 9-dragon Coffin through 20 monster waves per stage. Every wave drops loot, and you keep 100% of items even on defeat! With 1-of-3 skill upgrades, a huge talent tree, NG+, and an AI assistant handling chores.

5355650.name: NEXO GAME
5355650.short_description: NEXO GAME is an online social game for adults. Create your character, explore realistic worlds, and meet other players. Customize your look, spend time with friends, and share the moments that make you want to meet again.

4709270.name: DEEPWARD
4709270.short_description: Choose three heroes from a roster of six and switch between them instantly during combat. Each has their own health, weapon and ability. DEEPWARD is a fast horror FPS roguelite set in an alternate 1920s, where keeping your squad alive means fighting through the madness. Hero death is permanent.

5109010.name: Sexhelgard: Shadow of Lust
5109010.short_description: Enter Sexhelgard, a dark fantasy adult visual novel where you play a charming mercenary hunting a stolen magical artifact. Seduce powerful women, unravel an occult conspiracy, and discover how far desire can lead a hero.

5392270.name: Swish and Flick: Tidy Up Together
5392270.short_description: A wizard duel has wrecked the wand shop: thousands of magical objects lie scattered across its rooms. Sort wands, potions, runes and candles back where they belong, cast tidying spells, and watch every room wake up in a burst of magic. Play solo or with up to three friends.

3560890.name: Rushmark
3560890.short_description: Your dash is your weapon. Miss, and you wait. Kill, and you get it back instantly. A cyberpunk speedrunning platformer built on one refundable dash: wall-kick, chain and strike through ten handmade courses in thirty-second runs, then race any rival's ghost off the leaderboard.

5316520.name: Grass Demo
5316520.short_description: Grab your tools and team up in a cozy co-op or solo lawn care simulator focused on smooth, satisfying teamwork. Mow, trim, water, burn, and clean up sprawling properties as you improve the neighborhood and climb the mower app rankings.

2643540.name: Age Twisters
2643540.short_description: Age Twisters is a 2-player co-op narrative adventure game that allows you to send a free invite to friends via the Friend’s Pass. Play as a grandfather and granddaughter to solve puzzles by freely changing your age and reveal the dark secrets hidden beneath a facade of lies.

5405110.name: Zombie Wrap Simulator: Grill the Dead Demo
5405110.short_description: Apocalypse! You run the last kebab shop in a ruined world. In the demo, serve hungry survivors, grill questionable meat. Deliveries across wastelands. Tense days. ZOMBONERS attacks at night! Will the shop survive? Enter the apocalypse grill!

3240890.name: Chaos Agents
3240890.short_description: Chaos Agents, designed by Richard Garfield, is the world’s first Autobattler Royale where every hero is one of a kind. Born with unique names, appearance, and skillsets you guide your Agent to victory by fusing the strategic planning of autobattlers with the tension and scale of a Battle Royale.

5428870.name: Bouture - Hyacinth in a glass
5428870.short_description: Hyacinthus orientalis. A forced bulb on its glass, with a spike of blue flowers after 12 days of care. Dries in 4 days.

4400020.name: The Dust Between: Observer
4400020.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op horror strategy game where you guide unseen clients, draw the map, send commands, solve cases, and survive the dangers inside your own office.

4571310.name: Spooker
4571310.short_description: A roguelite pool-like game of cursed billiards. Turn the tables in your favor by stacking combos, cranking up multipliers, and breaking the game wide open. It’s the only way you’ll ever leave this place.

5312390.name: DEADLINE: Afterlife Processing Demo
5312390.short_description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. The first five shifts at Station 9.

3876300.name: Drunk Dork On Pitchfork
3876300.short_description: Drunk Dork on Pitchfork is a unique rage arcade game. Play as an Imp dragging a hefty Dork through hellish traps & mazes to throw the ultimate party! Control both characters with special fork mechanic – keep yourself and your living cargo alive while he slipping away into lava!

4589970.name: Breakkaboom
4589970.short_description: Discover a weird fireworks shop. Buy some ridiculous fireworks. Break stuff with them and just enjoy a fun playground! You can also explore mysterious simulation worlds, but when you see hordes of strange creatures, you can hide or run! Or just go wild. Go Kaboom!

4672480.name: ChickenPlaguePolice
4672480.short_description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.

5233210.name: Shadows of the Dungeon Demo
5233210.short_description: A first-person tactical dungeon crawler inspired by 1990s classics. Explore two full levels, choose from 9 playable species and all 12 classes, and experience tactical combat, spells, abilities and dice-driven adventuring.

4324230.name: ORMOD: Directive Demo
4324230.short_description:
Shape your own survival experience in an infinite open-world sandbox. 
Customize world difficulty, rules, and playstyle. 
Play solo, co-op, or on 24/7 MMO-style servers across PvP, PvE, Hardcore, or Creative modes as you build, automate, fight, and survive.
The choice is yours.

2744160.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
2744160.short_description: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

5063150.name: ゆるキャン△ つなげるみんなのオールインワン!! ちるタイム
5063150.short_description: Right beside you as you sit at your desk, Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others are out camping again today. You can focus on your work or studies while watching them. Create your own unique campsite using over 1,000 types of gear, and watch your focused time accumulate in your diary.

731340.name: EscapeNET
731340.short_description: Survive in first person, deadly AI-controlled chambers in EscapeNET, where players must cooperate as humans and drones, solve deadly puzzles, and face off in high-stakes PvP arenas — all under relentless time pressure.

5455030.name: Unscrewed
5455030.short_description: Run a cozy recycling depot at golden hour. Drill out every screw from chairs, fridges, arcade cabinets and more, watch them wobble and collapse in a satisfying heap, sort the scraps for cash, hunt rare finds and upgrade your drills in this chill physics sim.

4466550.name: SCP: Minor Case - FLP -
4466550.short_description: A story-driven adventure game set in the SCP Foundation universe

4520810.name: Tap Monster: Saga
4520810.short_description: Welcome to the world of monsters — an idle collection game where you can recruit every boss, flexibly switch formations, and discover new solutions on every map.

3170130.name: Red Recon: 1944
3170130.short_description: Red Recon is an isometric real-time tactics game with stealth elements, where you command a squad of Soviet scouts deployed into East Prussia in the autumn of 1944, on the eve of the Red Army’s strategic offensive. Be the first in the enemy’s lair!

4172450.name: The Hidden Ones
4172450.short_description: The Hidden Ones is a cooperative horror puzzle game that supports four-player online multiplayer. An seemingly ordinary fire incident unravels the prologue to a cold case that has been buried in a small town , binding the fates of four protagonists into an eerie and intricate maze of mystery.

2726580.name: PUBG: DED.NET
2726580.short_description: PUBG:   is a multi-player FPS with roguelite elements set in 1990’s Cascadia.

5185320.name: The Ninth Witch’s Jail
5185320.short_description: The Ninth Witch's Jail is an anomaly-hunt game with a crunchy retro aesthetic set in the Medieval era. Spot the signs of curses or witchcraft in the prison to break out of an endless loop, continue your exploration and confront the ninth witch.

3976340.name: Cucina Stellata
3976340.short_description: Cook traditional 19th-century Italian recipes in a kitchen haunted by hunger. A short psychological horror where gastronomy, ritual and cosmic appetite share the same table.

3509380.name: GrimKeep
3509380.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

2550530.name: The Legend of California
2550530.short_description: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends.

5044500.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院
5044500.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

4175630.name: Strange Dreams
4175630.short_description: You inherited a house in another town. When you arrived, it was cold and raining, so you went straight to bed. That was mistake. You fell into a deep, dangerous dream where an entity will force you through increasingly strange and terrifying stages of sleep. Want to wake up? Find a way out.

4846310.name: Corner Dungeon
4846310.short_description: Lightweight desktop idle battler. The ultimate workday distraction.

4676260.name: Puck'n Hell
4676260.short_description: A dark arcade air hockey duel set in limbo. Strange opponents. No excuses. Just you and the puck. Easy to understand. Difficult to master. Welcome to Hell. Grab your paddle.

3907570.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
3907570.short_description: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York criminal underworld. Build your empire through front businesses and bootlegging, lead your crew in brutal top-down tactical combat, and rule the city through cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

3049240.name: Spaceborn Awakening
3049240.short_description: Start as a mortal. End as a god. Carve through corrupted hordes, evolve your arsenal and unlock cosmic powers that clear the screen with a wave of your hand. A narrative-driven bullet-heaven roguelite.

4183150.name: YokaiRun 巡妖
4183150.short_description:
Oops! The master's away and the monsters escaped!
Can the rookie who started this mess clean it up?
Don't expect expert heroics. You've only got half-baked spells and wobbly kung fu. Turn this fail into your comeback story!

5364440.name: Formula Z: Controlled Dose
5364440.short_description: Build your pharmacy, manufacture unapproved Formula Z drugs, sell them on the streets or to hospitals, rob stores at night, evade the FDZ, and expand your business across four eras in this first-person pharmacy and business simulation.

4686750.name: Pinball Hero
4686750.short_description: Pinball Hero is a turn-based roguelike RPG on an arcade cabinet. Everything is a marble — heroes, skills, talents, all marbles colliding with each other. Piece them together into your build.

5294810.name: 兰岛物语2：奇沧的幻海 Demo

4832050.name: Entered
4832050.short_description:
Entered ■■■■■■■...
A retro-style horror visual novel branching into various horror subgenres.

4513800.name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral Demo
4513800.short_description: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

5195010.name: JUST PRESS SPACE Demo
5195010.short_description: JUST PRESS SPACE is a brutal pixel-art souls-like, roguelite where one button controls everything.

3024130.name: PAO PAO
3024130.short_description: Welcome to PAO PAO! Discover a cozy seaside town full of little joys! Play solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Cook delicious meals, go fishing, grow crops, and create a home of your own by the sea.

5392080.name: The Crown Must Endure
5392080.short_description: Rule a medieval kingdom where every decision has a consequence. Settle disputes, manage scarce resources, and defend your castle against invading armies. Your choices shape who stands beside you, who betrays you, and how your reign will be remembered.

4962850.name: Joker's Last Call
4962850.short_description: Korea's One Card, reborn as a dark casino roguelike. Face two rivals at once, stack attacks and push the chain around the table, reverse it with a single Joker — and each battle, slip one trick card from your sleeve. Relics bend the rules. Tricks break them.

4952800.name: Ablahshikar
4952800.short_description: Ablahshikar is a turn-based ASCII salvage-survival game adrift on the Candle Sea. Bound to a worn terminal of bone-white and brass, you must strip wrecks and tear organs direct from rival vessels. Graft severed parts onto your keel to rebuild a failing warship into a doomed chimera.

3690370.name: Senior Survival Club
3690370.short_description: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

4681770.name: Everfront
4681770.short_description: Lead a nation through a roguelike strategy campaign where borders grow continuously. Choose your path, unlock technology and push the front.

4932820.name: Bottle Flip Inc
4932820.short_description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

3859810.name: 风吹屿小镇 测试版

5193720.name: Rise From Ashes Demo
5193720.short_description: Demo for <Rise From Ashes>, a tactical survivors-like where your build, not your luck, decides the run: merge Scrolls, bind Sigils, and complete synergies as you climb the Spire. Every run will be a volume of a comic, which your adventure draws each page.

5338030.name: Knockout Kiss💋
5338030.short_description: Five women have gone missing across a neon-lit city. Fight your way through 15 missions with dead-simple one-button combat: tap to strike, hold to charge, release. Every victory brings her closer and unlocks uncensored reward scenes. 18+ only.

4963920.name: Porthole - Local Port Sharing
4963920.short_description: Play LAN and self-hosted games with faraway friends. Porthole is a proxy that forwards a port you pick to your Steam friends, so they connect as if on your LAN. No port forwarding, no public IP, no router setup. A Steam-based take on Hamachi and Radmin.

3950270.name: Teach my little sister how to drive Demo
3950270.short_description: Your sister's first driving lesson! If you fail to teach her properly as an older brother, your survival cannot be guaranteed. Will you be able to survive safely until the end?

5408980.name: Fire Isle Demo
5408980.short_description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

5146530.name: On Any Journey Demo
5146530.short_description: Designed exclusively for two players, < On Any Journey > is a co-op adventure packed with varied gameplay challenges that call for teamwork, coordination and a healthy dose of sabotage.

5399100.name: Deadgate
5399100.short_description: Take a contract onto a quarantined island overrun by zombies. Loot what you can carry, outlast rival squads and reach your exit before midnight, or lose everything you brought. A first-person extraction shooter for up to 32 players. No contract, no exit.

5154200.name: Tabletop TD
5154200.short_description: A random tower defense around a tavern table, where everyone guards their own board. Draw towers with gold, from Spearman to Railgun, and set them by hand beside the rail. Merge three of a kind to grow stronger; it never fails. One lucky draw can turn the board around. Hold out solo or with friends.

4730460.name: Farm Bang
4730460.short_description: Raise living ammo, blast monsters, haul massive loot, and survive the debt collectors in this chaotic top-down farming shooter.

1619290.name: Andromeda Wars
1619290.short_description: Andromeda Wars is a retro styled space RTS. In Andromeda Wars you must gather power, build a fleet, build defences to defend your mothership, and try to survive the onslaught from the opposing factions. Each ship you add to your fleet gives you powers but also reduces your dwindling resources.

5373570.name: CrossSpell Demo
5373570.short_description:
Weave words together and create chains through intersections! This is a demo version of *CrossSpell*, a competitive crossword puzzle game.
You can play modes such as CPU battles, local multiplayer, Deck Spell mode, and experimental online matches.

4836940.name: Ghost Receipt Demo
4836940.short_description: Run a cyberpunk grocery store and pawn shop in a neon-soaked city. Buy, sell, negotiate deals, investigate mysterious items, and piece together customer stories through the items they bring, the secrets they hide, and the risks you choose to take.

4782680.name: ALIGNMENT Demo
4782680.short_description: a road engineering construction and driving demo. Create roads, adjust horizontal and vertical alignments, add ramps, and generate bridges, tunnels, and slopes from terrain. Then drive your own design and feel how curves, grades, and structures shape the journey.

5323450.name: Scope Creep: The Board Game Demo

5367680.name: MAZZIOSI
5367680.short_description: MAZZIOSI is a single-player tactical card game about an unlikely crew reclaiming a crooked city. Recruit heroes, form three-person squads and fight turn-based battles. Follow the story or take on roguelike runs with branching routes, changing enemies and new upgrades.

5263410.name: Steal A Coffin
5263410.short_description: Steal coffins, collect rare monsters, and turn their income into speed. Train on your treadmill to reach distant biomes and haul back better loot. Upgrade your gear and occasionally steal a coffin right out of another player's hands.

4773050.name: Bullet Rift
4773050.short_description: Bullet Rift is a top-down shooter ARPG packed with loot, builds, dungeons, rifts, crafting, bosses, and deep character progression. Blast through hordes, chase legendary gear, perfect your build, and push deeper into an endgame built for players who love grinding for power.

5246510.name: The Inkwell
5246510.short_description: Monitor. Identify. Purge. Watch haunted cartoon feeds, identify entities by the anomalies they leave behind, and perform precise exorcisms. Keep the corruption contained, or the broadcast will claim you next.

1911870.name: Vaewolf
1911870.short_description:
Half-werewolf, half-vampire… all vengeance. 

Unleash your relentless wrath in a brutal, ceaseless quest for revenge in a bold Hack and Slash power fantasy set in the untamed English North.

1170580.name: Acid Knife
1170580.short_description: Combat like 2D Mario found a knife and fell into a Souls game.  Built around "Action Crafting" where chopping trees, mining resources, cooking and creating items is all done through action mechanics, not menus.

3764400.name: LIMIT ZERO BREAKERS
3764400.short_description:
Explore the floating islands of Seraphia as a Breaker in this anime action RPG.
Build a team of characters with different fighting styles and unleash stylish attacks as you battle through ancient dungeons and massive monsters in search of the Archive of the Gods.

4734020.name: Wreckreation 2
4734020.short_description:
Wreckreation 2 is a return to classic arcade racing where every race is a battle.
Winning means driving fast, taking risks and knowing when to race and when to fight.

3274710.name: 4 Penny Coffins
3274710.short_description: In 4 Penny Coffins, up to 8 players hunt a hidden murderer through lies, shifting alibis, and hard evidence in our online multiplayer mode. This social investigation game also includes a solo mode for those brave enough to face the fog alone.

4929080.name: Carcelera
4929080.short_description: Carcelera is a short exploration and light puzzle game. You are in prison, and so is the Moon. Forge your own destiny, you can repent later.

2600730.name: Ties: Soul Link
2600730.short_description: TIES: Soul Link is an emotional and brutal 2D metroidvania that combines action RPG with adventure platforming. Explore a decaying world in the year 2097, uncover its secrets, and face savage, bloody battles that will test your endurance and your deepest fears.

4010040.name: 万象之环 Demo
4010040.short_description: "OMNIRING" is an, multi-cycle, strategy role-playing game. Assemble a team of Samsarans, experience stories in vastly different worlds during continuous cycle adventures - battle, interact, make choices, resolve events... Train your team, step into the final battle, and become The detached.

5450560.name: Escape the Walls
5450560.short_description: You're surrounded by walls. All you have on you is your hands. You have to punch your way through, no other choice.

3756700.name: Warhammer Age Of Sigmar: Deathmaster
3756700.short_description: Play a sneaky, ruthless Skaven assassin and slay your way up the ranks of the ratmen in this grim and dark new 2D stealth-action platformer. Escape. Kill. Ascend. Become a Deathmaster.

3202730.name: Reforj
3202730.short_description: Reclaim the future. Rewrite the past. Reforj the world.

5235120.name: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms Demo
5235120.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

5307870.name: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor Demo
5307870.short_description: Pool of Radiance: Ruins of Myth Drannor is a turn-based party RPG set in the Forgotten Realms. Build a band of heroes, descend into the haunted elven ruins of Myth Drannor, and use tactical positioning, spellcraft and steel to stop a dracolich from corrupting the realm.

4863090.name: Bravemech: The Century War
4863090.short_description: An action strategy RPG with mechs. You are the ace pilot and commander of one warship in a hundred-year war, and in time you hand it down to the next generation. Fly your own mech in side-view real-time battles, solo or with up to 4 players on one screen.

4123520.name: Project Substrata
4123520.short_description: Dig, build, connect—and watch your factory come to life. Shape the terrain, link mining and production lines, and manage power in a first-person base-building and automation game. Restoring a ruined planet is our long-term development goal.

3337980.name: Only Fog Remains
3337980.short_description: She came in search of a ghost story to record, but is now part of it. With only a cassette player in hand, Cynthia must now traverse the fog and search for her friends before it changes them forever.

4001430.name: Seres Universalis:Three Kingdoms
4001430.short_description: Return to the Three Kingdoms period. On the grand strategic tactical battlefield, use terrain for defense setup and resource allocation to shift the battle situation. Control the war via hexagonal grid movement and tactical ability activation, and unify the realm.

4718760.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels Demo
4718760.short_description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

3456950.name: Pixel Gun 2
3456950.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.

5454430.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
5454430.short_description: A boy, a flashlight, and a house that no longer feels like home. No Such Monsters is a side-scrolling horror adventure. Explore dark rooms, tunnels, and a ruined chapel, solve environmental puzzles, and outrun the creatures that find you.

5341930.name: Pipkind
5341930.short_description: Pop matching dice, collect playful outfits and help 100 quirky friends in a colorful retro puzzle adventure. Explore a growing village, tackle 1,000 campaign levels, or chase your best score in an ever-faster Marathon. Think fast: wrong shots stack up!

3957770.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels
3957770.short_description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

5024620.name: Critical Ward Demo
5024620.short_description: Critical Ward is a reverse horde-survival roguelite where you save the crowd instead of killing it. Treat patients, build absurd combos, survive hospital chaos, and master three wildly different characters in this free demo.

2174060.name: Sincognito
2174060.short_description: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

2369780.name: Unnatural Worlds
2369780.short_description:
Innovative yet familiar real-time strategy game in development.
Grand-scale RTS game played on maps/planets of any 3D shape.
It emphasizes strategy, base building, logistics, and reduces micro-management of individual units.

3577710.name: 末日下班特快
3577710.short_description: My coworkers turned into zombies—and they’re still making me work overtime! Recruit passengers and unleash surprising combos with double-sided cards in this roguelike deckbuilder.

3999220.name: Meal Quest
3999220.short_description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

5400300.name: Swornhand
5400300.short_description: A dark fantasy tactical card game with a story campaign, deckbuilding and online duels planned for launch. Discover 480 cards, fight for control of 3×3 and 4×4 boards, and challenge another player on the same computer.

3844890.name: Lost Jelly
3844890.short_description:
An arcade adventure with a new twist!

🚀 The alien robot Nimble must gather all the runaway Jelly after a crash landing. But there's a catch — his brakes are broken! Every move must be carefully planned, because once Nimble starts going, he won’t stop.

3614010.name: 末日下班特快 Demo
3614010.short_description: My coworkers turned into zombies—and they’re still making me work overtime! Try the demo, recruit passengers, and unleash surprising combos with double-sided cards.

4879410.name: Critical Ward
4879410.short_description: Treat patients, build massive combos, create absurd builds, deploy automated medical infrastructure, and survive the escalating arcade chaos before hospital saturation reaches 100%.

3856200.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
3856200.short_description: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

5413490.name: Tanuki Tag Demo
5413490.short_description: Play the Tanuki Tag Demo! This ain't your grandma's hide-and-seek! Stretch, squash, and shape yourself into ridiculous disguises. Go tiny, go HUGE, blend into your surroundings, and cause absolute chaos with your friends!

3577020.name: Clean Start
3577020.short_description: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

5094710.name: Feather's Edge Demo
5094710.short_description: Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

5117640.name: Dude, Trust Me Demo
5117640.short_description: Get hopelessly misunderstood by your two best friends. One of you goes blind, one goes deaf, one loses their voice, and no puzzle here can be solved by one person. Can the three of you work out how to understand each other?

5165160.name: Unharvest Demo
5165160.short_description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

5211430.name: Vaulted Demo
5211430.short_description: Rumors of the Vault beneath an old fort draw those who have nothing left to lose in a war-torn world. Vaulted is a dieselpunk roguelite shooter. Sneak through the shadows, turn enemies against each other, or fight your way through shifting dungeons to reach the Vault and discover what lies within.

5233940.name: Keelblade Demo
5233940.short_description: Sail across a fantasy world in your own pirate ship. Master souls-like combat and powerful magic to hunt deadly bosses. Discover new islands and loot them for hidden treasures to craft upgrades for both you and your ship. (1-6 Players)

5295160.name: Farmer's Diary Demo
5295160.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

5315310.name: Loftia Demo
5315310.short_description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

5324790.name: Superpower Rally: Home Guard
5324790.short_description: Relaxing light roguelike tower defense! Roguelike progression, plant hero growth, selectable super plants, day/night modes. Awakened plants vs zombies—collect plants, unlock skills, upgrade sun economy, defend your home. Low-spec friendly for tower defense and roguelike Build fans.

5338850.name: Ignite the Depths Demo
5338850.short_description: Ignite the Depths is an atmospheric dark-fantasy PvE dungeon crawler set within a sprawling, hand-crafted labyrinth. Descend into the darkness alone or unite with up to 4 players in a co-op adventure. Will you conquer the Abyss?

4865360.name: Novalex Project Zero
4865360.short_description: A turn-based car-company tycoon. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, undercut on price, and out-engineer a field that grows to 30 AI rivals across a century of motoring. Build the carmaker that lasts, or go bankrupt trying.

4736580.name: Abyssal Lapidary Demo
4736580.short_description: A Victorian workshop management sim where you inherit the fading Vermilion House in the underground city of Fathomholm. Appraise rawstones, cut gems, design jewelry, rebuild your shop's reputation, and uncover the horrors buried deep beneath the strata.

4741520.name: Dominus Gladiatus Demo
4741520.short_description: Experience the opening of Dominus Gladiatus. Recruit, train and equip gladiators, build your Ludus and make life or death decisions as you begin your fight against Rome’s rival Domini.

4769550.name: Castillon Demo
4769550.short_description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

4813850.name: Stella Sora
4813850.short_description: Stella Sora is a free-to-play light-action fantasy RPG. Join the Trekkers to battle, conquer mysterious labyrinths called "Monoliths," explore the vibrant continent of Nova, and uncover secrets buried beneath the sands.

4990360.name: Plink Lab Demo
4990360.short_description: A satisfying active plinko incremental where you drop and bounce fantastic creatures (tiny humans for starters) to clear pegs and earn a trillion $! Wacky balls, massive tech tree, total physics-based chaos, and a very chatty goblin shop owner.

4991500.name: SKEW Demo
4991500.short_description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

5058330.name: STATO Demo
5058330.short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

5063310.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It. Demo
5063310.short_description: Treasure chests, foes, ore, or materials—each adventurer follows their own compulsion. Set a destination to guide their automatic movement, weigh the risks of shortcuts and detours, and grow through skills combining powerful abilities with troublesome quirks in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

5076290.name: No Body No Problem! Demo
5076290.short_description: Get your first taste of chaos in No Body, No Problem! Demo. One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, and try to get away with the perfect crime before the police uncover the truth.

4555930.name: 余烬列车 - Ember Express Demo
4555930.short_description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

4664450.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth Demo
4664450.short_description: Rise as the ruler of Athens, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods. In Theos: Cities of Myth’s Demo, you’ll have a taste of the first 3 chapters of the Athens adventure, with Athena or Dionysus as your patron deities.

4665220.name: Blades & Trades Demo
4665220.short_description: Forge your legacy as both merchant and hero. Explore Zoldar, battle monsters for rare materials, and craft epic gear. Team up with friends to build a thriving shop in the village markets or arm yourselves to conquer the dangerous depths of the wild.

4686830.name: On the Rocks Demo
4686830.short_description: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Scavenge the wasteland, brew with what you find, and serve whoever comes through your doors. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run together.

4713280.name: Foundation: Harvest Festival
4713280.short_description: Master the land by raising livestock, planting lush orchards, and cultivating hardy new crops. Expand your production chains to create new resources and crown your success by hosting the grandest of Harvest Festivals.

3367180.name: HitTube Demo
3367180.short_description: HitTube is a 1-4 player horror streamer shooter. The zombie apocalypse is here and now you're a streamer who kills live for donations. Your weapon is a minigun and your minigun is your best friend!

4237760.name: Mutter Demo
4237760.short_description: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.

3787060.name: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Demo
3787060.short_description: Step into the shoes of an electronics technician and repair damaged devices: receivers, phones, speakers, and more. Solder, diagnose, replace components, earn money, and grow your workshop!

3816030.name: DayZ Badlands
3816030.short_description: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

3839910.name: Only Fans
3839910.short_description: <Only Fans> is an object finding game where you find mildly boobs and mildly butts objects in a gooning rehab full of fans.

5150150.name: Arcade Lacrosse
5150150.short_description:
Top-down arcade box lacrosse inspired by an all-time childhood favorite. Pick skinny, medium, or heavy body types - each with radically different speed, power, and checking.  Versus, Co-Op, Multiplayer.  Global leaderboard.

 GET IN EARLY. 

Lowest price during inaugural version.

3355360.name: 4:LOOP
3355360.short_description:
It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. 

Thankfully, that’s all part of The Plan.

5117550.name: Fart Together
5117550.short_description: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op parkour game where 2–4 players steer the same boat using fart power, with competitive modes supporting up to 8 players. Coordinate your direction, timing, and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

5111340.name: 复苏之旅 Demo
5111340.short_description:
In this open-world exploration game, you enter a mysterious post-apocalyptic world.
With your companions, you’ll explore strange factions, collect, modify, ally with, or battle them, and uncover the hidden secrets of the world.

3408620.name: Cafemart Simulator Demo
3408620.short_description: Build, decorate, and manage your very own grocery store, complete with a cozy restaurant where customers can shop and enjoy a delicious meal. Play solo or team up with friends in co-op multiplayer!

3486530.name: Stupid Never Dies
3486530.short_description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

3657330.name: Pelikeeper Demo
3657330.short_description: In this demo of Pelikeeper, you will defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the first season and get an introduction to this cosmic adventure.

5293980.name: 限界ライバー しめきり1週前 Demo

2982320.name: Guild Wars 2® Janthir Wilds™ Expansion
2982320.short_description: Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds™ is the fifth Guild Wars 2 expansion. Begin a risky expedition in search of support in the treacherous Janthir wilds, where hidden secrets and malevolent creatures lie in wait for your arrival.

4411580.name: Geareo
4411580.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with intricate clockwork contraptions, steam-powered systems, and fully functional circuits.

1429280.name: Prodigal Soundtrack
1429280.short_description: Listen to the sounds of Prodigal anytime and anywhere with the full soundtrack!

4904010.name: Novalex Project Zero Demo
4904010.short_description: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

5417380.name: Runaway Rocket
5417380.short_description: Your rocket blasts into the sky — but the monster could turn around at any moment! Time your landing, build up the target prize, and push your limits!

5159950.name: Pack or Die Demo
5159950.short_description: Manage your inventory case in a classic style as your character automatically advances through a post-apocalyptic world, fighting hordes of zombies with weapons and ammo you strategically organize.

3046700.name: CamGirl Simulator
3046700.short_description: Step into the tantalizing world of online entertainment with "CamGirl Simulator"! This immersive simulation game puts you in control of your own virtual cam model career. Experience the highs and lows of the industry as you navigate the challenges and rewards of being a popular camgirl.

4483960.name: PASTDARK
4483960.short_description: PASTDARK is a horror extraction game with CO-OP up to 4 players with a twist - MADNESS! This makes each of the players see and hear things which are not there. Extract toys and submarine parts by utilizing stealth, teamwork, proximity voice chat and various items before the madness overwhelms you!

3480840.name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
3480840.short_description: CloserLook VR: Oldways is a story-driven VR adventure set in modern-day West Africa. Trapped in a university building, explore secret locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping narrative of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

4611240.name: Music Manager
4611240.short_description: Sign artists, develop talent, release music and steer careers through tours, festivals and changing trends in a detailed music industry management sim set from 1952 to 2026.

5306640.name: DOOD
5306640.short_description: Bring your drawings to life with eyes, legs, wings, and other parts, then set them loose on the Junk Planet in this sandbox ecosystem sim. Breed and fuse surprising new creatures, tackle strange research requests, and recreate the lost ecosystem of Sage’s home planet.

5264160.name: Bloodlines & Banners
5264160.short_description: A historical 4X where you rule a dynasty, not just an empire. 88 civilizations across ten eras of real history on a hex map of Earth. Your rulers age and die; the heir you raised inherits their traits, their rivalries, and your bloodline's standing.

5300840.name: Final Depth
5300840.short_description: Navigate through the dungeon in this modernized traditional fantasy roguelike fighting monsters, gathering loot and leveling your character as you try to make it to the Final Depth.

3836940.name: Realm Nine
3836940.short_description: On the land of Jiuzhou, there are fragments of your plundered Elf Wings hidden. You will play as five types of real-time shapeshifters and embark on a journey to find the lost fragments.

5230170.name: Sort the Tapes! Demo
5230170.short_description: Sort the Tapes! Demo — уютная игра о сортировке VHS-кассет в американском видеопрокате начала 2000-х. Изучай обложки, ищи подсказки на видеомагнитофоне, принимай возвраты от клиентов и наведи порядок, прежде чем Рэй отправится в отпуск!

4778980.name: GoGeez Demo
4778980.short_description: GoGeez is a cozy idle incremental where cute chibi creatures stack into a self-growing engine of synergy, progression, and quiet obsession. Build, break, and rebuild - until the power goes out. You're alone in your room. Or are you?

4553100.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS
4553100.short_description:
A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains.
Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

551370.name: Gravity Sketch VR
551370.short_description: Bring better products to life: Gravity Sketch is an immersive 3D workspace built for ideation and collaborative problem-solving. Explore, and align around 3D ideas at any scale, from anywhere. Test ergonomics and proportions at true scale, gain feedback and make informed decisions faster.

4096830.name: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready
4096830.short_description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–4 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.

5320920.name: 永眠之匣雪上之樱 Demo
5320920.short_description:
《永眠之匣，雪上之樱》是一款以殡仪馆为舞台的剧情向视觉小说！

没错，殡仪馆！

这是一个关于"告别"与"陪伴"的故事，温馨，治愈，偶尔塞你一口刀（

本作25万字全程语音，无分支主线，十余个EX小剧场，全通后还有打破第四面墙的Meta剧情等着你！

没有黑深残，大家都有happy end~请放心游玩(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

4765850.name: Stories Terminal Demo
4765850.short_description: Stories Terminal is a detective text adventure inspired by classic parser games. Type your own commands, explore pixel-art locations, collect evidence, and solve a murder case on a midnight university campus.

5128560.name: Tanuki Tag
5128560.short_description: This ain't your grandma's hide-and-seek! Stretch, squash, and shape yourself into ridiculous disguises. Go tiny, go HUGE, blend into your surroundings, and cause absolute chaos with your friends! For 2–8 players.

4768160.name: Hostile Architect
4768160.short_description:
Who is the deranged mind behind those trap-filled stages from classic 2D side-scrolling games? This time, it's you.

Your kingdom is being invaded by heroes. You have to construct the stages they will traverse in this fast-paced 2D tower defense game.

4427790.name: Total Blade: Mythology
4427790.short_description:
Lead over 3400 soldiers in massive real-time battles across a vast 16th-century world from Europe to Japan.
Conquer cities, recruit famous historical figures, and forge your empire in a grand sandbox RPG

1540720.name: Forgery Craft
1540720.short_description: Master the art of forgery in this story-driven simulation game. Start with altering documents by changing single signatures and dates. End up forging entire art pieces that could fool any museum expert.

4677900.name: Crypts Of Carith - Chapel Cellar Demo
4677900.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

3825370.name: Never Wither Demo
3825370.short_description: Experience unprecedented creature collection gameplay—Transform into almost any creature you see! Collect and raise fantastical creatures, and command them to farm, build, and craft. In this open world survival crafting game, Establish your settlement, become the last hope against the Corruption.

4417480.name: Gacha Shop Simulator
4417480.short_description: Run a cozy gacha shop! Sell blind boxes and figures, serve customers, expand your store and open a few boxes for yourself. Who knows what rare figure is waiting inside?

5049140.name: INANIMA Demo
5049140.short_description: A survival horror game set in the isolated facilities of a strange corporation. Search for limited supplies, and fight terrifying creatures to reveal the truth behind the Lazarus project. Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

5288650.name: Love Locks
5288650.short_description: Love is forever. Until you bring bolt cutters. Remove 100,000 love locks solo or near friends in this relaxing cleanup game. Fish for keys with a magnet in the Seine in Paris, unlock tools from lockpicks to lasers, and turn romantic gestures into scrap metal 🔐

4751960.name: Blown Cartridge
4751960.short_description: Stock shelves, manage employees, decide when to add new sources of income, or just collect rare cartridges! Welcome to Blown Cartridge. A cartridge rental sim where you grow your reputation (or sacrifice it for a quick buck). Keep your customers happy and they might just become regulars!

2994600.name: Lysward
2994600.short_description: Lysward is a single-player survival game set in a vast and unforgiving desert in the fantastical world of Umbra. Explore, craft, team up with your companion, and leverage the Amri magic to endure the heat.

1864220.name: Knuckle Paradise
1864220.short_description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate seagull. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

3370370.name: Fruitopia
3370370.short_description: FRUITOPIA is an original casual game for Deathmatch competition

3765000.name: Seaworks: Trap Season
3765000.short_description: Seaworks: Trap Season is a hands-on crab fishing life sim set in the remote pacific northwest in the 1990s. Take fishing bounties by fax, maintain and customize your boat, brave changing weather, sort your catch and build a small life on the edge of the sea.

4825500.name: Kamiyo
4825500.short_description: A dystopian visual novel about Gods, humans and the 'Godkillers'. Pray to your God, and death to the Godkillers.

5245610.name: 机骸：第九行星 Demo
5245610.short_description: Iron Grave: Planet 9 is a sci-fi mech survivor game. Pilot multiple mechs with unique skills and evolution, slaughter enemies, unlock upgrades. Set on the ninth planet over a century from now, fight alongside your squad and become a hero.

5289740.name: Tiny Dwellings Demo
5289740.short_description: Tiny Dwellings is a cozy pixel-art builder with over 1,000 hand drawn items to place, decorate, and unwind with. Create charming little homes and tiny dioramas at your own pace, surrounded by calm lo-fi vibes, soft lighting, and cozy ambience.

5291460.name: Empty The Lake!
5291460.short_description: Empty the lake, make money, and discover what’s hidden at the bottom! Pump out thousands of liters of water, upgrade your tools, and keep going deeper to uncover what lies beneath the surface.

4110770.name: Apple Crumble
4110770.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

4986470.name: クイズ！罵倒ネア！
4986470.short_description: This game is a quiz game that includes satire and jokes.

4881270.name: 赢麻了
4881270.short_description: MAHJONG RUSH is a relaxing ink-wash roguelike. Score by matching mahjong tiles into combos — no mahjong experience needed, an interactive tutorial teaches you from scratch. Collect Flowers, Fu cards, and Relics to grow small scores into huge ones. Every run is randomized. This round — clean house.

5375990.name: Chill & Thrill - Deep Down
5375990.short_description: Venture even deeper into the forest and track down the sentry! Enjoy the beginning and look forward to the "Entrance" to the "Guard Post" or the "Ruins" – lovingly and creatively designed by the developer!

2709170.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech
2709170.short_description: S.E.X. Project is a first-person sci-fi adventure where you explore a futuristic facility and build relationships with female androids through dialogue and choices. Complete quests, uncover secrets and discover how your decisions lead to different storylines and endings.

4015730.name: Bunny Hopper
4015730.short_description: Bunny Hopper is a dynamic 3D platformer where you take control of an agile combat robot. Jump, wall-run, dash, and shoot targets as you conquer challenging levels set in stylized arenas.

4984320.name: NAND²
4984320.short_description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate, together: online co-op for up to 4 players on one board. Wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. Level editor and Steam Workshop.

3342670.name: Crypts Of Carith
3342670.short_description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

2355020.name: Lost Hellden
2355020.short_description: Resist your Sin. Reclaim your fate. Lost Hellden is an action JRPG from a team of genre veterans, featuring a gorgeous hand-painted 3D art style, a vast world to explore, and a unique phased battle system that blends turn-based and real-time combat.

3402230.name: Sivers
3402230.short_description: Sivers is an RPG-roguelike with a unique style, where waves of enemies test your strategy. Use spells and build defenses, develop your hero, and fight bosses and varied foes. Victory on the first try is unlikely — every attempt brings you closer to success!

4240900.name: Vice Club Simulator
4240900.short_description: Build your own nightclub from zero to hero in Vice Club Simulator! Hire talented dancers, build deep relationships with your girls, and create the hottest lineup in town. Manage the chaos, grow your club, and keep the party going until sunrise!

3731590.name: 巨神的遗址 Demo
3731590.short_description: A 2D Rougelike action game with pixel art style. You are a summoned "hero", in exhilarating combat, smooth action and dazzling combo, defeat and execute enemies. Build from 100+ skills! Blending adventure, action, and strategic builds, the journey offers endless possibilities in every fight.

5080900.name: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight Demo
5080900.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

2381520.name: Unrecord
2381520.short_description:
Unrecord is a single-player FPS that tells the story of a tactical police officer from the perspective of his body camera.
As you work to solve a complex case, you'll need to use your tactical and detective skills to succeed.

5416150.name: Gnomes Go Boom
5416150.short_description: Garden gnomes vs. gardeners. Gnomes run screaming "lolololo", then freeze into a perfect ceramic statue among 300 identical ones. Gardeners hunt in first person with a water sprayer: statues drip, live gnomes steam. Spray the right one before it goes BOOM. 2–10 players online.

5209580.name: Raftcraft
5209580.short_description: A 4-player co-op adventure where goblins build a fragile makeshift vessel, hunt for loot across dangerous lands, and use their Mage Hands to grab, swing, pull, and thoroughly inconvenience each other.

5388470.name: プロやきゅう好きやねん！プロ野球チーム経営シミュレーション－ボールパーク・チャンピオンズ－ Playtest

4266210.name: Todd is Late
4266210.short_description: Todd is Late is a FMV point and click hidden-object game that pits you not only against the clock, but also against your own ability to plan and adapt with every attempt. Help guide Todd out the door with everything he needs in time for his big day at work.

4759570.name: No Road Home
4759570.short_description: Post-Apocalyptic Open World Survival. The bombs fell. The world didn't survive — but some people did. Now mutants haunt the ruins and raiders rule what's left. You have a car, a few bullets, and one mission: bring the survivors back together.

5408580.name: Mayhem TV
5408580.short_description: Lights. Camera. CARNAGE!🩸 Welcome to MAYHEM TV, where the audience wants blood and the Producer wants ratings. Blast through hordes of maniacs, unleash ridiculous weapons, trigger insane studio disasters, crank up the HYPE and survive 11 monstrous bosses. THE SHOW MUST GO ON. YOU MIGHT NOT!

3905500.name: Beware of the Cartographer!
3905500.short_description: Map a mysterious land during the Age of Enlightenment. Draw the border between two warring kingdoms. Meet the locals. Juggle their demands with the requirements of your mission. Ethical dilemmas, secret plots, strange phenomena… will you be able to bring peace back to the land?

2616540.name: Croak
2616540.short_description:
Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Grit your teeth! You're gonna CROAK.
-DEMO OUT NOW!-

5078480.name: Fleshgrinder Demo
5078480.short_description:
An isometric tactical horror RPG.
Fleshgrinder is a virus that causes an extinction-level event, harvesting DNA samples and trying to digitally accelerate evolution in the so-called Genesis Chamber after taking over the minds of the augmented population.

5419880.name: Wild West Canyon
5419880.short_description: Revolver in hand, bison in sight: Experience a ruthless survival adventure. Defy wild animals and Native Americans. Build a refuge and show who is in charge!

3448000.name: Planted!
3448000.short_description: Sow. Grow. Throw. Planted! is a chaotic 1-4 player combat game where gardens are arenas, plants are weapons, and grudges are settled one harvest at a time.

4543610.name: Priority One
4543610.short_description:
Priority One is a game where you and your friends play as a SWAT team where you defuse bombs, rescue hostages, locate evidence and arrest or eliminate Hostiles
Also features a Alternative mode With Zombies ,objectives to search for and survivors to rescue
1-4 player Co-Op

3582690.name: Night Crew
3582690.short_description: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.

5180920.name: Plastic Lust 2
5180920.short_description: An erotic visual novel about doll girls who swap out their parts for futanari fun. Enjoy raunchy play with gorgeous dolls as Dane starts to build his harem. Featuring art by Modeseven!

4879300.name: Xenomire
4879300.short_description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

3396730.name: Under The Basement
3396730.short_description: A survival horror game where you must escape ancient claustrophobic caves filled with terrifying threats. Climb, crawl, and fight to survive, but beware: nothing in this place wants you there. What if your only way out was to run, but running could bring the entire place crashing down?

5302140.name: 灵劫变 Demo
5302140.short_description: 《灵劫变》是一款开放世界玄幻修仙角色扮演游戏。你可以使用自己的专属形象在数万格的手工地图中不断探索全新机缘，体验蝴蝶效应般的非线性剧情与红尘情缘。除却驾驭灵兽与法宝进行策略战斗，你还能开辟洞府、经营宗门，甚至与道侣建立家族，亲自培养下一代天骄，开启有温度的修真之路。

4675720.name: Music Manager Demo
4675720.short_description:
This is the demo version of Music Manager. The demo lets you play for 18 in-game months.



Demo save compatibility with the full game is planned where possible but cannot be guaranteed while the game is still in development. Major updates may make some demo saves incompatible with the full release.

4580030.name: Papaya Plaza
4580030.short_description: Welcome to your new life as mayor of a tourist town in this small slice of life town building game. Restore the community, meet adorable villagers, and create your dream escape at your own pace. What will you build today? Peep peep!

5096020.name: LYSSA: Goddess of Rage
5096020.short_description: A tactical PvP card RPG in a world run by mercenaries. Climb the rankings in short, brutal real-time battles, recruit legendary fighters, and build a deck around your Commander. Seize territory with your alliance and get to know your crew off the battlefield.

5367360.name: Plucked Demo
5367360.short_description: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

5027100.name: Bomber Battle 2 Online
5027100.short_description: Face other players in explosive battles, use bombs and power-ups, compete in minigames, and survive the chaos in this fun online multiplayer party game!

5383030.name: Police Activity: Cardboardman
5383030.short_description: Police Activity: Cardboardman is a first-person slasher game where, in one segment, you play as a serial killer nicknamed "Cardboardman," and in the other, as a detective trying to catch him.

5204490.name: ROG Lite
5204490.short_description: An isometric fantasy MMORPG of dungeon expeditions, open-world PvP and guild conquest. Master weapons and magic, explore deep dungeons with friends, build a home and fight for control of forts in a shared, persistent world.

3919710.name: PISO 6
3919710.short_description: PISO 6 is a first-person psychological horror game with a low-poly aesthetic. After his father’s death, Tomás returns to the apartment where he grew up. What seemed like a simple search for a will turns into a nightmare that pulls him back into the past.

5367460.name: Real-Time Screen Translator
5367460.short_description: A Windows app that reads game subtitles and interface text in a selected screen area and translates them in place. Choose from offline-capable local models covering up to 100 languages, with stable subtitle overlays and a customizable glass-style display.

544450.name: Typing with Jester Demo
544450.short_description: Typing with Jester is a typing game with a 8-Bit retro fourscale style. Imagine those classic handhelds had a keyboard and a game like this. Sounds awesome right?

5340660.name: オーダーバーガー
5340660.short_description:
[Overview]
"Order's Burger" is a fast-paced action game where you stack ingredients to match incoming orders.   [Key Features]Fast-paced ingredient stacking   Increasing difficulty levels   Time attack & high score rankings   Test your reflexes and become the ultimate burger master!

4253570.name: Reshine
4253570.short_description: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

3818450.name: Everlast
3818450.short_description: On Everlast: Undying Tale’s magical world of Sarkis, the undead have risen. Gather, explore, skill, and craft in this MMO-Lite Action RPG Adventure. Only by bridging the gap between the living and the dead can you break Death’s curse.

4651330.name: 暗黑废墟 试玩版
4651330.short_description: Dark Ruins is a thrilling idle looter auto-battler! Train heroes to escort the 9-dragon Coffin through 20 monster waves per stage. Every wave drops loot, and you keep 100% of items even on defeat! With 1-of-3 skill upgrades, a huge talent tree, NG+, and an AI assistant handling chores.

2485550.name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot Playtest

1937070.name: Engines Of Destruction
1937070.short_description:
Engines of Destruction is a mech simulator.
Take on the role of pilot, create your own custom mechs, fight in PvP or PvE battles, and control a fully interactive cockpit in VR or on desktop.

5302170.name: CrashCrash
5302170.short_description: Clock in with Destruction Squad for the world's most questionable demolition jobs! Team up in online co-op for up to 4 players, grab bizarre tools, and wreck physics-driven worksites. Efficiency is everything, safety is optional... just don't demolish your teammates!

3296100.name: Stand Alone
3296100.short_description: Stand Alone is a dynamic real-time strategy game, where players compete to control land in epic multiplayer battles. Engage in intense, tactical warfare as you capture fortresses, manage resources, and forge alliances or betray them all while navigating a world of shifting power and diplomacy.

3536520.name: Warding Witches
3536520.short_description: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

5427290.name: Alchemist: Infinite Corridor
5427290.short_description: Run a cozy alchemy shop at the mouth of an endless dungeon. Sell potions to adventurers, secretly raise monsters in your cellar and release them below. Pay the corridor its toll in gold, earn wisdom, and descend - until it devours you, or you rule it as the Grand Alchemist.

5286750.name: 地獄リゾートへようこそ！ Demo
5286750.short_description: Try Welcome to Hell Resort!, a tower defense game built around tile placement. Extend corridors, combine turrets, traps, and guard stations, and choose blueprints to build your defenses in hell.

1730790.name: A Sister's Journey
1730790.short_description: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

4425970.name: Guildrun Demo
4425970.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.

4090240.name: Rhythm Doggo
4090240.short_description:
You wanted to play a video game and just got transformed into a dog!
Rhythm Doggo is a classic platform adventure where you play as a dog and make music on the way. Can you go back to your human form?

3303720.name: Dataclysm
3303720.short_description: Embark on a journey into the heart of a digital kingdom unlike any other. Dataclysm invites you to explore a world where ancient data comes alive, and every line of code tells a story waiting to be unraveled.

3856030.name: Bolt Action
3856030.short_description: Step into the boots of a battlefield commander in Bolt Action, a turn-based WWII strategy inspired by Warlord Games’ tabletop classic.

4136620.name: Emissary One
4136620.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

5254700.name: GemSlasher Demo
5254700.short_description:
