GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems.
Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

4136630.name: Emissary One Demo
4136630.short_description: Co-op horror (1 to 6+ players). The squad was sent to the next site, but contact was lost. Find them and team up for the current mission. It seems you're not alone here again.

4461370.name: 夜酌星河：吧台物语
4461370.short_description: A lighthearted visual novel about bartending. A century after humanity reached the stars, Nana is just a bartender on Blue Star — serving drinks, listening to her guests, learning the universe. And if she can, she might change the world with one small glass.

4430260.name: Beat For Speed
4430260.short_description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

2487330.name: Stuntman: Hollywood
2487330.short_description: Become Hollywood's most sought-after stuntman. Perform explosive scenes inspired by blockbuster movies, defy danger, and drift your way to stardom.

5269870.name: STAR³
5269870.short_description: STAR³ is a cosy 3D logic puzzle where colours wrap around cubes and your thoughts become music. Solve puzzles, awaken stars and build your constellation. No timer. No lives. Just a little curiosity and a universe to bring to life.

4531250.name: Tiny Dwellings
4531250.short_description: Tiny Dwellings is a cozy pixel-art builder with over 1,000 hand drawn items to place, decorate, and unwind with. Create charming little homes and tiny dioramas at your own pace, surrounded by calm lo-fi vibes, soft lighting, and cozy ambience.

5391350.name: NO EXIT
5391350.short_description: A survival horror FPS where you face hordes of zombies, explore abandoned environments, gather resources, and fight to survive.

5173120.name: 脱毛沙龙模拟器 Demo
5173120.short_description: Ready your laser, rev up those trimmers, and run your own hair removal salon! Utilize cutting-edge salon tech, leaving clients hair-free and feeling fresh. Manage their pain levels, launch ludicrous sales pitches, and sink profits into gear upgrades and employees. Become a grooming powerhouse!

5350450.name: CYBERBIKES
5350450.short_description: CYBERBIKES is an intense vehicular combat game where you pilot a futuristic motorbike armed with classified tech. Tune and upgrade your custom ride to outgun a ruthless syndicate, battling to reclaim the streets across scale-accurate recreations of iconic locations like Paris, Kyoto, Giza and more!

5366290.name: ARES: THE IRON VANGUARD
5366290.short_description:
▣ Stylish Sci-Fi Action RPG ▣
■ Switch combat suits and classes in real time.
■ Master parries, perfect dodges, and powerful combos.
■ Battle massive enemies across vast battlefields with other Guardians.

4875980.name: CyberDeck Demo
4875980.short_description: Play the free Act I CyberDeck demo: a cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder with three operators that feel like different games. Blitz through fights as GG, rig loot-box odds as El Money, or power cards on the turn-based Beat as CyberMaster. Draft cards, install chrome, and beat the boss.

1952620.name: The Lost Wild
1952620.short_description: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

2207620.name: Fellowship of the Oak
2207620.short_description: Fellowship of the Oak is a cozy crafting sim where you gather a fellowship of heroes, providing them with everything they need to succeed on their adventures. Build cozy homes, craft gear, farm provisions and manage expeditions in order to collect powerful loot!

5350000.name: PROJECT M.E.D.S. Demo
5350000.short_description: The body is under attack. Hordes of infectious germs are spreading rapidly, overwhelming its natural defenses. As the last line of defense, you'll battle through massive waves of pathogens, unlock powerful medical weapons, and fight to keep your host alive.

3517190.name: MVX: London
3517190.short_description: Save London in a shared-world co-op shooter set in a 1:1 recreation of the city. Battle creatures with real-world weapons and mysterious Flux powers.

3610180.name: Olympus Rangers
3610180.short_description:
Welcome to the ultimate battle simulator where you can create, manage and face dozens of opponents in multiple battle modes. Can you become the champion? Throw away your fainted teammates? How about becoming the world's best in online play? Take on the Olympus!
Can you become the very best?

2838950.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
2838950.short_description: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.

4754860.name: Bad Grip Club
4754860.short_description: Bad Grip Club is a physics-based co-op climbing game where you grab ledges, pull friends up cliffs, use ridiculous items, and survive four cartoonish biomes. Play on PC or in VR, team up with friends across platforms, and enjoy the chaos together!

4712640.name: Escape the Space Hotel
4712640.short_description: Stranded in a luxury space hotel orbiting 400 km above Earth, Max Reed must solve mind-bending puzzles to survive. Explore stunning zero-gravity decks, hack systems, and make life-or-death choices in this classic 2D point-and-click sci-fi adventure packed with 100+ clever puzzles, can you Escape?

4210060.name: ZERO Sievert 2
4210060.short_description: ZERO Sievert 2 is a top-down PvE extraction shooter set in the ruined country of Zakov. Hunt alone or with a crew, face anomalies, bandits, and mutants, and make it out alive.

4708780.name: Rookie Raiders
4708780.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

4779720.name: Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling Demo
4779720.short_description: Manage heavy machinery, load cargo, operate cranes and tugboats, and keep the harbor running smoothly in Port Logistics Simulator: Dockside Harbor Handling Demo. Experience realistic port operations across dynamic day and night conditions ⚓

4907650.name: Laboratorio de Videojuegos
4907650.short_description: Play, create, and share 3D platformer levels while discovering the secrets of video game design. Learn by creating, overcome challenges, and become the designer of your own adventures.

5198670.name: No Murders in Grimwick
5198670.short_description: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.

5283850.name: Trick or Eat
5283850.short_description: Halloween night, and the monsters are going door to door. Whoever opens up gets eaten. Defend the neighbourhood solo or with up to three friends: fight ghouls, witches and werewolves, spend your candy on upgrades, and if you fall, rise again as one of the monsters.

3153700.name: My Cannibal Family
3153700.short_description: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

1188960.name: Send and Defend
1188960.short_description: Send & Defend is a competitive multiplayer tower defense game. Carve your own maze, build towers and send creeps to grow your income. Watch your rivals, steal their lives and be the last one standing.

3560450.name: Store Life Simulator Demo
3560450.short_description: Store Life Simulator (Demo) offers a limited experience! Manage a small grocery store, hire employees, handle stock, and serve customers while facing challenges. Ready to start?

4956350.name: Momoawase
4956350.short_description: A memory game with strange rules my 3-year-old daughter decided on all by herself. Match pairs of "も" (mo), spell out hidden animals in Japanese for big combos, and relax in quick solo rounds♪

4424940.name: One Must Rule
4424940.short_description: An empire-building auto-battler set in a harsh medieval settlement where every strategic command shapes your kingdom’s fate. Build your empire from the council table, discover game-breaking card synergies, and battle against rival players. Every choice counts, only one will rule!

5073910.name: Cave Crawler 2 Demo
5073910.short_description: Crawl, run, and shimmy your way through this caving experience to survive the horrors lurking through the underground, and discover what would drive a man to go so deep into the bowels of the earth.

4830710.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build Demo
4830710.short_description: Survive the dangerous swamp on a floating raft. Gather resources, craft tools, catch fish, purify water, expand your shelter, and defend yourself from hungry crocodiles lurking beneath the surface.

4457320.name: Survival Float Simulator - Crocodile Waters Craft, Raft, Build
4457320.short_description: Survive the dangerous swamp on a floating raft. Gather resources, craft tools, catch fish, purify water, expand your shelter, and defend yourself from hungry crocodiles lurking beneath the surface.

5353330.name: Cairn & Carat
5353330.short_description: Crack stones, discover what's inside and build a legendary collection. Break rocks from a giant quarry pile, sell your ore, upgrade your tools and hunt 20 rare special stones with your detector. Play solo or in online or LAN co-op for up to 4 players.

2715880.name: Farmer's Diary
2715880.short_description: There is a lot of work to be done on this farm. A long-term adventure awaits you where you can take farming and orcharding to the next level with your friends.

5461860.name: Shameless Supreme
5461860.short_description: Shameless Supreme is a story-rich pixel RPG with turn-based combat and dark humor. Explore crumbling worlds, build your party, and combine status effects for deadly reactions. Use optional mic-powered trash talk to weaken enemies and break their defenses. Survive, and find your way home.

5121000.name: My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang! Demo
5121000.short_description: Will your comment get picked up by your oshi? In "My Oshi Uses Too Much Slang!", you join the stream of a rookie VTuber who calls herself seiso but whose emotions spill right out. Read the room, drop the right slang, and she'll call your name. Comment fearlessly and carry your oshi to 1M subs!

5450930.name: Avenues & Acres
5450930.short_description: A top-down city builder that combines detailed road construction, interconnected economic systems and the everyday lives of individual residents. Design your city from the ground up, manage the services that keep it running, and discover the stories unfolding behind its streets and rooftops.

5405000.name: Luckforge
5405000.short_description: The House always wins. Unless the whole table cheats. Luckforge is a co-op casino auto-battler for 1-4 players, online or on one couch. Spin a cursed slot machine for recruits, merge them into monsters, and yank the lever mid-fight. What could possibly go wrong?

5412820.name: Starfall Chronicles
5412820.short_description: Starfall Chronicles is a single-player 2D loot RPG. Skills cast themselves: dodge in combat, tune gear and shape builds outside it. Three classes, artifacts, gear sets and stat counters make every gear choice count. Face four difficulty tiers and a 100-floor tower. Buy once, no microtransactions.

5140410.name: Fame & Fear: Dungeon Architect Demo
5140410.short_description: Build the kingdom's most famous dungeon. Kill enough heroes to grow rich. Let enough survive to become legendary.

5245730.name: Rookie Raiders Demo
5245730.short_description: Rookies, raid the dungeons — claim your wealth and fame! Craft your own builds with a cast of one-of-a-kind characters and complete your party. Everything runs on your design. Rookie Raiders — the fully automated combat roguelite RPG!

3625430.name: Dash and Smash
3625430.short_description: Dash and Smash is a chaotic party brawler where players clash in fast-paced, physics-driven battles. Choose unique characters and Dash and Smash your way to victory, locally with friends or online!

4806560.name: Project Gears
4806560.short_description: Charge! Smash! Don't stop! Survive! Race through chaotic city streets as Engine Heart and Motor Soul. Upgrade each hero's unique abilities, blast through enemies at top speed, and keep your engine running. If your power runs out, so do you.

3305190.name: One More Plate
3305190.short_description: Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to a bizarre cast of Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu. Catch, balance and fling food with absurd, anything-but-proper plates — solo, or 2 players on one PC or via Steam Remote Play Together. Everything obeys physics; nothing obeys you.

3183080.name: Kyoryu
3183080.short_description: You are a young, genetically modified, son of a samurai T-Rex in a post-apocalyptic Tokyo, who is fascinated by the once mighty humans and the ruins of their civilization.

5385330.name: Taise-CityVsBus
5385330.short_description: This city has been swallowed by apocalyptic chaos. The crew entered the streets before you and are still fighting. You are the bus driver. Drive through the city and rescue the scattered crew in this exhilarating apocalyptic bus action game!

4830720.name: Scandinavian Cottage Survival Simulator Demo
4830720.short_description: Build and customize your dream Scandinavian cottage in this demo, live off the land, and experience peaceful Nordic countryside life through crafting, fishing, hunting, and exploration in a relaxing open-world survival adventure.

4801600.name: YuanRong
4801600.short_description:
"Ten great war-chariots lead the vanguard." — Shijing
2D turn-based tactical RPG. Four cultural origins, procedurally generated continents, individual soldier recruitment and training, chain-of-command formations, hex-grid combat, fight outnumbered.

4250370.name: Sol Protocol
4250370.short_description: Sol Protocol is a dynamic VR Co-Op roguelike where you team up and physically pilot a spaceship through dangerous, procedurally generated stellar systems. Manage your spaceship, man the turrets, explore abandoned stations on foot, and make strategic decisions as you push deeper into the deep space.

5234390.name: Logisticats Demo
5234390.short_description: Move to a floating island and start a new life alongside a colony of cats with unique personalities! In this cozy business sim, you'll help your cats to plant crops and build buildings before taking to the skies in your airship to lead your feline crew in search of treasure and adventure!

5396440.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang
5396440.short_description: Trap rivals with jelly bombs — pang-pang! A 50-stage adventure through ten candy worlds against the Sugar Giant, online battles for up to 6, two players on one PC, and a map maker to build your own arenas.

5397610.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Cotton Candy Funfair
5397610.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Cotton Candy Funfair style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

5044660.name: UniversiaTCG Demo
5044660.short_description: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes. Featuring an in dept visual novel for a lore filled story mode that covers each card.

5381660.name: Little Desk Farm
5381660.short_description: Run a pixel farm on your desktop. Grow crops, hire farmers, raise chickens and arrange buildings your way. Assign farmers to sow, water and harvest, then sell crops to expand your land. Check in on the farm now and then while you work, study or take a break.

5332660.name: Escape From Necromaze
5332660.short_description: During a night date, your girlfriend is snatched by an evil Necromancer! With 0 combat power and no weapons, your only hope is lightning-fast reflexes and spatial memory. EA features 15 levels. Delve into the trap-laden dungeon, dodge undead, and save your love in the ultimate showdown!

5211100.name: ShootyCraft Demo
5211100.short_description: Massive space battles with base building, crafting, automation, and destructible environments. Fight as a team or take on everyone in a free-for-all arena. Play online, single-player, or cooperative with friends.

4324830.name: Steps into Corruption
4324830.short_description: A kinetic adult visual novel about a young married couple diving into swinging and open relationships. Play as the husband as curiosity quickly turns into temptation in an explicit NTR/NTS story of jealousy, desire and a marriage that will never be the same.

1444990.name: Praxion-7
1444990.short_description: A drowned world you can never leave. Crash on it, jack into alien tech, and make your living cutting open salvage, fitting ships and undercutting rivals on a market players run. 390 islands are still unclaimed. Take one.

2272360.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
2272360.short_description: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

4108680.name: Nightholme
4108680.short_description:
Team up or strike out alone to hunt an eldritch Gloomfiend in a city crawling with horrors. 
Channel corruption and transform into a monstrous Grimspawn for devastating bursts of power. But beware. Madness is patient, and you look delicious.
Survive the run. Take the prize. No one leaves unchanged.

5119780.name: Evil Among Shadows: Hollow Creek
5119780.short_description: After Kevin's disappearance, Sam stays with her aunt and uncle to support them after the loss of their son. She and her friend Anthony soon stumble down the same rabbit hole as her cousin did, growing increasingly obsessed with proving there is a serial killer lurking in Hollow Creek.

4707610.name: Bon Voyage
4707610.short_description: A game about a steamtrain and its passengers in 19th century Belgium. Meet a diverse range of believable characters and plan your route to satisfy their quirky transportation needs. A companion game where the gameplay occurs at stops, allowing you to focus on other things in life during travel.

4396460.name: NOTAIM
4396460.short_description: Fight for the corner office in this chaotic fast-paced multiplayer office shooter. Random weapons, brutal close-quarters combat, and no second chances. Climb the corporate ladder the only way that matters: violence.

4265670.name: GameJam 水群模拟器 Demo
4265670.short_description: A simulation game that immerses you in the real group chat dynamics of indie developers during a 21-day game jam.

3460540.name: Cardtographer
3460540.short_description: Evil has returned! Complete the card collection to seal it away! Build synergistic decks for tactical battles. Survive procedurally generated roguelike runs—solo or in co-op—with danger lurking around every corner. Carve your path and become the cardtographer!

5163250.name: NOROI SHOPPING
5163250.short_description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…

2106730.name: Phantom Hellcat
2106730.short_description: Phantom Hellcat is a dynamic slasher-platformer with showy combos in a theatrical setting. When demons kidnap Jolene’s mother, the young woman must take the stage and save her—but in the world of plays and props, things are not always what they appear to be.

2865960.name: SAW: Genesis
2865960.short_description: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

5008260.name: ShootyCraft
5008260.short_description: Massive space battles with base building, crafting, automation, and destructible environments. Fight as a team or take on everyone in a free-for-all arena. Play online, single-player, or cooperative with friends.

4420980.name: Drunkslop: Pub crawl COOP
4420980.short_description: DRUNKSLOP: 100% Chaos. 0% Hangover. The only co-op where getting totally wasted is the actual win condition. Scavenge for cash, chug drinks, make terrible choices, and somehow clutch it out. Strap in, it’s a long-ass night.

3352150.name: Bushcraft Simulator
3352150.short_description: Stranded in the wild with only your skills and wits, gather resources, craft tools, and build shelters to endure a hostile environment. Alone or with friends, battle the elements, hunt for survival, and push your bushcraft prowess to its limits.

2321960.name: Spirit Crossing
2321960.short_description: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

4844910.name: VECTORHYTHM
4844910.short_description: Turn rhythm into firepower in a neon bullet heaven. Time your attacks to charge Power and strengthen your weapons, build devastating synergies in Survivors mode, or chase high scores in quick Arcade runs as every song drives the fight.

5072320.name: False Echo Demo
5072320.short_description: False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Stelantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

5336590.name: Howling Woods
5336590.short_description: A cozy Halloween town builder. Lay out paths and plots in a clearing in the woods and the town takes care of the rest: crooked houses go up, curio shops open, and goblins, ghosts and witches move in. The spookier your town gets, the grander it grows. Nothing costs a thing. Every day is Halloween!

5308910.name: De Potrero Demo
5308910.short_description: This is De Potrero playable demonstration. It will let you access the most basic features of the game, check the gameplay loop in a span of 3 in game years with a young footballer.

4182520.name: The Pond
4182520.short_description: Lovecraft horror merging puzzle game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

5326610.name: XGUN Demo
5326610.short_description: A free slice of XGUN: one district of a drowned Persian Gulf resort island. Loot it, survive the infected, and reach the extraction point before dark. Play online, solo offline, or split-screen on one couch - no server required.

4338090.name: Master Thief Simulator
4338090.short_description: Master Thief Simulator is a stealth-focused crime simulator where every move counts. Plan heists, sneak past security, pick locks, steal valuables, and vanish without a trace. Rise from petty theft to high-risk break-ins and become a true master thief.

4856560.name: Dice Ark Demo
4856560.short_description: Roll dice to cross the ever-changing Ark, assign your results to cards in battle, and build your deck and fortune. Defeat monsters, control crystals, disrupt rival explorers, and win not by being the strongest, but by claiming the greatest total assets.

4218970.name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
4218970.short_description: Experience daily police duty on Germany's Autobahn like never before and keep the peace in a living open world. From traffic stops to high-speed pursuits: every call is yours to answer.

3799970.name: Beach Bar Simulator Demo
3799970.short_description: Step into Miami and build your own Beach Bar! Experience realistic drink mixing, creative building, and customer management. Play the demo today and get a taste of the ultimate beach bar management simulator.

5420920.name: Corebound
5420920.short_description: Fight, build and engineer your way through five stages to protect a living energy Core. Corebound mixes twin-stick combat with deckbuilding, tower defence and a production network — every card, tower and weapon changes what the other three can do.

4328610.name: Clockwillows™ Voy Quest Demo
4328610.short_description: Take control of Voy and jump all over the place! This demo includes the first game area.

5108530.name: CURSECADE: Pachinko Roguelite Demo
5108530.short_description: Build explosive chain reactions with balls, pegs, and cards inside a cursed arcade machine. Place and upgrade special pegs, master physics-driven bounces, and survive stages and bosses that keep rewriting the rules.

5242180.name: Paw Works Co.
5242180.short_description: Run your repair shop in a cosy animal neighborhood. Diagnose and repair your customers' broken belongings, and organize your workshop your way. Grow your shop, unlock upgrades like delivery, and manage it all from your computer.

5354780.name: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion
5354780.short_description: PETAFAB: Bot Invasion is a single-player first-person shooter with fully destructible environments and large-scale physics simulation. Blast through massive swarms of AI-controlled bots and take down huge bosses. Collateral damage is just a bonus.

5353360.name: Project MAGNUM Demo
5353360.short_description: Take control of the M1A5 MAGNUM. Fight mechs, drones, robots, and enemy tanks across ruined cities, frozen wastelands, and abandoned battlefields. Explore a hostile world and customize your tank with a powerful arsenal of weapons and upgrades as you uncover the secrets buried beneath the ruins.

5121770.name: Sky Pirates Demo
5121770.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, recover treasures, and survive the dangers of the skies in this co-op adventure where every expedition can quickly descend into chaos.

5375410.name: Link Loop
5375410.short_description:
Link Loop is a 2D puzzle platformer built around portals and satisfying physics.
Use portals to move objects, redirect lasers, and transport fluids. Levels have multiple solutions, and creativity is key.

3603860.name: Beach Bar Simulator
3603860.short_description: Build your own paradise on the Miami coast! Run a beach bar solo or with up to 6 friends in co-op. Expand your pier freely, master realistic mixology, and keep rowdy crowds under control. In this sun-drenched simulator, every drink you mix shapes your success.

3809970.name: Night Machine Demo
3809970.short_description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

3144010.name: Usagi Shima: Bunny Island
3144010.short_description: Welcome to Usagi Shima! Build your own bunny paradise, attract fluffy tourists with toys and decorations, and befriend lovable bunnies by feeding, petting, and playing with them. Relax with rabbits in a beautiful sandbox of your own design.

5116080.name: Civil Twilight
5116080.short_description: Go into a fog-sealed city every night and carry salvage back out. You only see what your flashlight touches, you can't shoot while your hands are full, and every gunshot calls the anomalies. Find an exit before sunrise. Solo or up to 4 players.

3530640.name: Pecking Order
3530640.short_description: Pecking Order is a 16-player online physics-based party game where you eat your friends.

5049860.name: Speed Goes Up
5049860.short_description: Race, earn, upgrade, repeat. Turn faster laps into Bits, build a fleet of income generating Ghosts, master drift powered boost, race other cars, and push your vehicle to its limits

4244910.name: Horizon Hunters Gathering
4244910.short_description: Hunt deadly machines in tactical co-op action and adapt your Hunter for intense missions.

4695130.name: Tenshi Gun Gun
4695130.short_description: A fast-paced angelic run‑and‑gun platformer with twin‑stick shooting, fluid movement, and a unique dual‑weapon system.

5321980.name: At Fate's End Demo
5321980.short_description: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

4381890.name: Sky Pirates
4381890.short_description: Set sail with your friends aboard a flying pirate ship! Explore mysterious islands, plunder ships and treasures, and amass a fortune… But beware: the richer you get, the more you attract unwanted attention!

2303271.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - Angels DLC
2303271.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to the Angels!

5221310.name: Autosaurs: Hyper Dino Battler
5221310.short_description: Bolt experimental Parts onto robot dinosaurs, chain their statuses into game-breaking synergies, and merge your squad into evolved monsters. A single-player auto-battler roguelike where every run crafts a new team and a new gauntlet to the boss.

2652120.name: 驱邪师
2652120.short_description: Exorcist is a first-person horror role-playing game where players step into the shoes of an exorcist, visit haunted locations, follow clues, complete specific tasks, and gradually uncover the truth behind the haunting

4097070.name: Wielders of the Essence Demo
4097070.short_description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Cast spells, command troops, and take your town from puddle to paradise. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

3367710.name: The Abyss Break
3367710.short_description: Hardcore first-person co-op horror game. Explore the worlds beyond the Abyss alone or with a team, gather what you need to survive, and discover how far consciousness can change before it is no longer your own.

5147980.name: DELIVERX
5147980.short_description: Packages won’t deliver themselves! Jump into your van with up to 4 friends, drive out to a massive shifting facility, and retrieve high-value cargo from deadly horrors. Every run is unpredictable. Deliver at all costs. Have a fearless delivery!

3126810.name: Lyric Video Studio
3126810.short_description: Video editor built for musicians and content creators. Create lyric videos, music videos and visualizers with a real multi-track timeline. Sync lyrics, edit footage, use local AI, APIs or ComfyUI, create audio-reactive visuals and export up to 4K. No subscription required.

5330530.name: CRUSH LOAD
5330530.short_description: Pilot an armoured mech through fifteen minutes of the horde. Choose where to move and what to pick up as your weapons fire automatically. Seven zones, seven colossi, twenty-one weapon lines: equip five, evolve them, and push one to its apex.

3347910.name: Rat Game
3347910.short_description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

5366690.name: My Own Roguelike: RPG
5366690.short_description: An auto-attack roguelite RPG. Pick level-up cards every run, farm gear with random options and grow a 331-node passive tree to craft a build that is all your own — across 9 worlds, Hell difficulty and an endless boss tower.

4832970.name: What the Buck?!
4832970.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

3960600.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
3960600.short_description: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

4593940.name: Thicc Rogue
4593940.short_description:
“Thicc Rogue” is a roguelike RPG.
Form a party with adventurers you’ve freely customized and conquer dungeons.
Lead your one-of-a-kind adventurers to break through dangerous, unexplored labyrinths.
But here’s the catch: all the female adventurers must be “Thicc”!

4974640.name: zenaimu
4974640.short_description: A slime pen for your desktop! Make your workspace 10x cuter with slimes that bounce around while you use your PC. Try your luck at the gachaclaw each day to get new slimes for your collection!

4295420.name: Long Trip Demo
4295420.short_description: Long Trip is an action role-playing VR game set in a fantasy world where you can ride mounts, recruit warriors, tame pets, hunt, gather, cook, craft weapons, obtain magic abilities, and even summon ancient mechs or dragons to aid you in battles against bosses.

3339080.name: Wyrmspan
3339080.short_description: Wyrmspan is an engine-building, card-driven strategy game for 1 to 5 players. Play as an amateur dracologist discovering a world of dragons. Excavate caves and explore your sanctuary. Entice dragons and chain their abilities to create powerful combos.

5326600.name: Hanabi Craft Demo
5326600.short_description:
Craft firework shells and launch your own creations into the night sky in this 3D fireworks crafting game.
Enjoy a wide range of crafting tools and realistic visuals inspired by real fireworks. 
Light up the night sky with your original fireworks and build your own collection.

5437170.name: HARVEST CLAUSE
5437170.short_description: A farming action game: fight crop-eating monsters with modified farm tools, defend your fields, and sneak past security robots to harvest. On this planet, the fields and the workers all belong to the company, and your pay vanishes into absurd deductions.

1728620.name: IKUMA - The Frozen Compass
1728620.short_description: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

5066300.name: Go Next! Demo
5066300.short_description: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

4157490.name: Water's Way Down Demo
4157490.short_description:
After surviving a plane crash, Caspian wakes up with a strange new power— he can turn into water!
Determined to learn more about his powers, he sets out on a journey to find others like him...
Use his abilities to solve tricky logic puzzles and help him uncover the truth!

4022900.name: If Red Then Stop Demo
4022900.short_description: Program traffic lights, barriers, and more to solve your city’s traffic problems! Improve your coding skills by learning to control time-dependent processes with realistic state machines.

2412030.name: TeamSpec
2412030.short_description: The class-based shooter where you can make your own class, both in terms of gameplay and looks!

4950490.name: PITH Demo
4950490.short_description: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

5089050.name: Zombie Royale
5089050.short_description: Zombie Royale is a single-player or multi-player 3rd-person shooter set in a future reality TV show where contestants fight to the death for money, in a deadly world of genetically engineered Zombies, Cyborgs, and Ghosts.

5181900.name: Runecast Demo
5181900.short_description: Free RUNECAST demo: 15 waves on Easy, from Act 1 to the Web Queen's lair. Cast runes, summon heroes, choose promotions, and prepare your team with the Forge, equipment, and merchant's tent before each battle.

5460790.name: Frogball Demo
5460790.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Compete against your friends and the world for the highest scores on 8 unique, interlinked pinball tables. It's fast, fun and impossible to put down!

4216910.name: StreamOX
4216910.short_description: StreamOX — the ultimate streamer toolkit in one app. Multistreaming, chatbot, multichat, alerts, and widgets in a single interface. Stream to Twitch, YouTube, Kick, and other platforms simultaneously. Set up your professional broadcast in minutes.

3854950.name: You're Nuts!
3854950.short_description: Wake up, little robot: it's time to plan your escape. Solo or with up to 3 friends, crack the factory's puzzles, craft gear, open shortcuts and upgrade your base to go faster and further every day, until you carry the key to the exit. Set it up your way, from super cozy to nearly impossible.

5396100.name: Pawnbroke
5396100.short_description: A darkly funny pawnshop roguelike. Your late uncle left you his shop and his debt to Mr. Grin. Buy strange stock, arrange the shelf so every item boosts its neighbours, and pay up every five days. Come up short and he takes a finger.

5398240.name: Seabun Demo
5398240.short_description: Seabun is an incremental 2D survivor-like with creature collection elements, where you play a scientist bunny diving deeper and deeper to find the source of the sea's corruption. Haul your loot home between dives, grow your lab, and raise the fish you rescue into rideable mounts.

5411030.name: Unframed
5411030.short_description: Rob a bank with your friends, keep the loot in one piece and watch out for the traitor. Unframed is a physics-based heist game for 3–6 players. Help your crew or tape up someone you don’t trust. Just remember: the getaway vehicle is one seat short.

4229910.name: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars Demo
4229910.short_description: Command thousands of soldiers in a Napoleonic real-time strategy game where every volley matters. Win through quick decisions and well-chosen formations. Preserve your troops, develop veteran units, and turn the tide of battle.

1637460.name: TankRat
1637460.short_description:
A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are.
Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

5181680.name: Inn-Poster
5181680.short_description: Embrace a fully randomised story with Inn-Poster! A fantasy story-driven murder mystery game set within an inn during the Renaissance. Assume the position of an undercover detective tasked with creating potions and gathering clues to the identity of a serial killer terrorising the local town!

3646950.name: 灵能中介所 Ghost Hunting Journal
3646950.short_description: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. Follow a duo of self-proclaimed “Spirit Agents” as they take on supernatural cases, use a range of ghost-hunting techniques, and investigate urban legends surrounding the lingering spirits of Riverrun.

4383310.name: GraveDiggers
4383310.short_description: You and up to five friends play undertaker cats with one job: bury the dead. Find the bodies, keep your coffins away from a necromancer, fight what stands in your way, dig the graves and eat cheese whenever you can.

4374700.name: SummaGrande
4374700.short_description: A friendly math card game for two. Combine number cards to hit each task's target value, chain multipliers, and beat the clock. Play solo against AI or online with a friend — built to make arithmetic fun at school and at home.

3546610.name: Wielders of the Essence
3546610.short_description: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Cast spells, command troops, and take your town from puddle to paradise. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

5309220.name: Relicbearer TD
5309220.short_description: Build your defences, unleash devastating abilities, and claim powerful Relics in this 2D Tower Defence Strategy game.

2069330.name: Changer Seven
2069330.short_description: 3D Single-Player Action-Adventure! Explore a Vibrant World, Recruit Colorful Teammates, and Swap them during Combo-Driven Battles! ❤️ A Love Letter to the Toku-Sentai, Shounen Anime, Mahou Shoujo, and Classic Morning Cartoon Shows of our Childhood!

4036370.name: Risk it Little Biscuit
4036370.short_description:
Risk it, little biscuit! 
Crunch through endless hordes of sugar-crazed sweets in this bite-sized bullet-heaven roguelite. Pick a hero from the pantry, stack absurd snack weapons, evolve them into pure kitchen chaos and topple crowned bosses, one crumbly run at a time.

4158000.name: SqueakOut
4158000.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op game where laboratory mice survive deadly experiments, upgrade their shelter, and build a giant screwdriver to escape a mad scientist.

5425260.name: ActNormal Demo
5425260.short_description: Act Normal is a multiplayer game where you blend in as an NPC and steal enough to survive each round. With scores hidden, you never know if you're safe. Every player carries a hidden gun. Find them before they find you.

2974540.name: Night Machine
2974540.short_description: We’ve just learned the Moon is a giant alien doomsday factory, which is kind of a bummer. You've been chosen to operate a spaceship into the core and destroy it for us. Think fast, adapt under pressure, and deploy powerful combinations as you fight your way through in this real-time card battler.

5264440.name: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040 Demo
5264440.short_description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

5126370.name: Dog Eat Fly
5126370.short_description: Dog Eat Fly is a colorful 2D roguelite platformer where you run, jump, dash and eat flies. Build powerful combinations of upgrades, survive increasingly chaotic challenges, and push your run further with every attempt.

5405980.name: Shahed Hunters
5405980.short_description: Night raid on the city. Launch an interceptor drone from your own FPV radio or gamepad, man the anti-aircraft gun of a mobile fire team, run the air defense post — and keep the lights on. A realistic first-person air defense simulator against Shahed drones.

1579420.name: Guardians of the Wild Sky
1579420.short_description: Survive, build, craft and explore a vast magical world as you capture and bond with powerful Guardians. Captain your own airship and sail the cloud seas. Build everything from cozy homes to flying castles. Explore this world solo or with friends; the skies are yours to conquer!

2390910.name: Arcane Revolt
2390910.short_description: Arcane Revolt is an action role-playing game with pixel graphics. Lead a revolution as a powerful mage against tyrants in a fantasy medieval world. Customize your spells and make decisions that will benefit your cause in battle. Improve your spells, start the rebellion, and bring down the order!

5038070.name: 三國撞撞樂 Demo
5038070.short_description: A fast Three Kingdoms roguelike strategy card game. Recruit generals, build your team, choose events, and watch automatic battles collide. The demo includes a complete 10-stage single-player run.

3555440.name: Lich Lords
3555440.short_description: A Lovecraftian roguelite where you wake up as a Lich with no memory, trapped in a world where everything wants to kill you. Forge deadly builds, slay rival Liches and monstrous horrors, and uncover the truth behind this strange new world.

2482760.name: Hunting Simulator 3
2482760.short_description: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

854850.name: RAD: Ascension
854850.short_description: Some runs you race the clock. Some you just flow. RAD is a movement game built around speed and experimentation. Pump, jump, swing and glide through neon courses, race leaderboard ghosts, shave milliseconds off every run, and play it all to your own music. Instant restarts; one more run, every time.

5022920.name: Chess Town
5022920.short_description: A cozy chess career simulation where every move matters. Shape your strategy with decision cards, rise through local tournaments, and work city jobs to build the life that supports your path to becoming a champion.

552740.name: The Marquee: Lights. Camera. Legacy.
552740.short_description: Build a film studio from the ground up, create original movies, manage talent and production, compete for audiences, and turn unexpected successes into a cinematic legacy.

2257440.name: Tom the Postgirl
2257440.short_description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

5136840.name: ChillTank
5136840.short_description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats from scratch: shape the landscape, add water and decorate a home for your fish. Play offline, at your own pace.

5261510.name: ChillTank Demo
5261510.short_description: Collect, care for, breed and trade colorful fish in a cozy aquarium game. Build your own 2.5D habitats from scratch: shape the landscape, add water and decorate a home for your fish. Play offline, at your own pace.

4251870.name: The Pink Robot
4251870.short_description: The Pink Robot is a fast-paced isometric action roguelite with deep build variety and fluid combat. Create powerful synergies through skills and mementos, and face relentless challenges that grow stronger with every run.

5209400.name: 莫比乌斯环
5209400.short_description: A story-driven visual novel set in a fictional parallel world. Make choices, explore branching storylines, and uncover the secrets behind a fateful encounter. This is an unofficial, free fan-made project featuring an entirely fictional story.

4976660.name: Mayhematic
4976660.short_description: Mayhematic is a bullet heaven where the next door is always worth the trouble behind it. Blast through cartoon hordes solo or in 4-player online co-op, spend your kills on doors that go deeper, build something ridiculous and put your name on the leaderboard.

4974880.name: Castle Crew
4974880.short_description: In a vast magical castle, everything has ended up out of place! Sort books, scrolls, runes, and potions, find where each item belongs, and watch as room after room transforms from total chaos into a satisfyingly organized space - on your own or with friends.

4685240.name: Kiwi
4685240.short_description: Triple-jump, air dash, plant your beak on walls, leap off and more in this 3D collectathon platformer about a flightless bird that gets everywhere anyway. You crashed on tiny open-world islands, and you have places to be. Find secrets, Meet the locals, fix your plane and F off home (F is for Fly).

1325610.name: Anthology of Fear: Prologue
1325610.short_description: Anthology of Fear is the first-person psychological horror, focusing on the story and solving the secrets of the game world. Discover the beginning of the first of three completely unique dark stories in this climatic prologue.

4857130.name: Пятизвёздочный курьер и туман, воняющий мертвечиной
4857130.short_description: Experience the work of a courier in a city of living rumors and legends. Pay off your debt by carrying out strange requests from mystical customers. Uncover the reason behind the appearance of a mysterious fog that smells of decay.

4182460.name: ROCKBEASTS Demo
4182460.short_description: A darkly funny narrative RPG where you manage a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Book gigs, wrangle egos and navigate a cutthroat music industry. Every choice shapes your band’s story and your own. Make it big without selling out.

4202430.name: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars
4202430.short_description: Command thousands of soldiers in a Napoleonic real-time strategy game where every volley matters. Win through quick decisions and well-chosen formations. Preserve your troops, develop veteran units, and turn the tide of battle.

2735850.name: Wilderdark
2735850.short_description: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft items to survive.

5430890.name: Hungry Ghosts Demo
5430890.short_description: Hungry Ghosts is a wild tower defense roguelike where you exorcise hungry ghosts with magical desserts and drinks! Play as a fearless witch and her various companions with unique powers, upgrade your dishes, and unleash powerful synergies to survive haunted waves and defeat bosses.

4678460.name: Outscratched
4678460.short_description: Outscratched is a scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble your deck from a multitude of powerful cards, collect blessed charms to influence your luck, and discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

2877650.name: One Maze
2877650.short_description: Type fast. Build your abilities. Destroy endless waves of words in a chaotic roguelike typing survival game.

3445440.name: Fablery
3445440.short_description: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.

2959540.name: Matelotes Demo
2959540.short_description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic but incompetent female sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and—as fate would have it—a chicken. Explore islands, resolve political crises, and upgrade your ship in this narrative-driven adventure inspired by RPGs.

5258290.name: THE FINALS - Season 12 Starter Pack
5258290.short_description:
The Season 12 Starter Pack bundle includes:

- 3 Legendary Weapon Skins
- 1 Epic Season 12 Sticker
- 1 150 Multibucks.

5139080.name: Arcade Together Demo
5139080.short_description: Run the arcade. Play the arcade. Together. Team up with friends to run your very own arcade! From classic cabinets to extreme experiences, from a corner shop to a grand entertainment center — build your arcade empire, side by side!

4905780.name: The Apothecary Diaries: The False Imperial Brother
4905780.short_description: Investigate mysteries, craft medicine, and uncover the truth in this brand-new story from The Apothecary Diaries. Explore the rear palace and capital to gather evidence and question witnesses, then assemble what you've learned into theories and deductions to solve thrilling mysteries in this sprawling adventure game.

4931550.name: モグモグ！クソバトル
4931550.short_description: Control a 🥕, gather 🐰, and feed them to 🐺 with your teammate! Eaten 🐰 turn into 💩 and get SHOOT at the enemy! 2v2 online battle for up to 4 players. Play solo or with friends!

5072430.name: Ghost in the SQL Data
5072430.short_description: A call reported a school fire 14 minutes before the first witness saw it. Find out who made it, in SQL, by exploring a year of Paris emergency calls.

5168140.name: Castaway Slime
5168140.short_description:
Castaway Slime is a survival game where a shipwrecked slime must survive 30 days until a rescue ship arrives.
The game features survival elements such as hunting, farming, cooking, and mining, along with RPG-style equipment, stats, and skills.
Online co-op supports up to 4 players.

5072550.name: Ghost in the SQL Data Demo
5072550.short_description: Somebody reported the fire fourteen minutes before it started. Prove it in real SQL. Learn the language from your first line, question a live evidence database, and let the records name the culprit for you.

3447670.name: Block King Demands Red Squares
3447670.short_description:
Automate a network of towns producing the required shapes for the ever fickle Block King while keeping the citizens happy.
Remember, if you fail, you will get fired.

5099050.name: Little Warrior Demo
5099050.short_description: The Tiny Warrior demo features early-game content, allowing players to experience the core combat, character progression, and level-based gameplay. Demo content may differ from the final release.

5383550.name: CLACKPOT: Marble Bounce Roguelike
5383550.short_description: A physics-based roguelike where you pull back a marble, let go, and score every time it bounces off a wall. Combine Patches to activate multiple Synergies, upgrade them and collect Relics to make a build of your own, then climb past rule-bending bosses to the final boss.

2710740.name: Lost Legions
2710740.short_description: Survive the aftermath of the historic Battle of the Teutoburg Forest in this story-driven open-world Roman survival game, with mythological elements. Build camps, free lost legionaries to fight by your side, defend against tribal raids, and explore an ancient Germanic world alone or with friends.

5255860.name: Bombs & Mold
5255860.short_description: A bizarre 3D platformer where mold creatures race to escape a nuclear test silo, blasting their rivals and climbing their way to the top.

930880.name: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER
930880.short_description: THIS IS TORTURE TOGETHER is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players, following a structured campaign with randomized elements. Abducted by a sinister kidnapper, you now must escape his deranged facility, survive twisted abominations, solve puzzles, and reach one of several endings.

5175940.name: 我在大厂搞外包
5175940.short_description: A darkly comic workplace visual novel set inside a Chinese tech giant. Decide what programmer Lin Mo believes, what he says aloud, and which records he keeps. Your choices reshape credit, access, relationships, and the truth left behind across seven endings.

3447700.name: Block King Demands Red Squares Demo

5258300.name: THE FINALS - Bog Standard Set
5258300.short_description:
The Bog Standard Set includes:
1 Legendary Outfit,
1 Legendary Weapon Skin,
1 Legendary Emote,
1 Rare Charm,
2 400 Multibucks.

5160320.name: White Christmas Demo
5160320.short_description: White Christmas is a cozy multiplayer winter playground set in a snowy village. Build snowmen, trade gifts, rent skates, throw snowballs, and warm up at the Christmas market. Host a village with friends and turn a school-free snow day into shared holiday chaos.

4977840.name: Otherside Tapes: Favela
4977840.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.

4751840.name: Firewall Demo
4751840.short_description: Become a hacker building cyber defense systems in this retro-futuristic deep strategy tower defense game. Build your firewall using limited compute power and sector space, connect mods, fight along your defenses running programs and expand to new sectors to protect the Grid from ever-growing chaos.

5108470.name: Titanic Survival Simulator Together
5108470.short_description: 🚢 Titanic Survival Simulator Together is a cooperative survival game aboard the sinking Titanic. Explore the massive ship, find a way to safety, and survive the cold, darkness, rising water, and deteriorating sanity. Play alone or with up to 4 players. 🧊🌊

3309100.name: Zombie Must Dead!  Demo
3309100.short_description: Guizi Must Dead is a historical FPS with Tarkov-like gameplay and survival base-building. Infiltrate enemy lines, loot supplies, fight foes, and extract safely. Use resources to farm and fortify your base. Inspired by WWII guerrilla resistance, supports up to 4-player co-op.

4916420.name: Path of Damned
4916420.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

4418720.name: Edroseph's Tower
4418720.short_description: A dark fantasy turn-based roguelike RPG with 25 classes and deep buildcraft. Climb the tower solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players, combine talents and equipment, and adapt your party to every run.

4195990.name: 风吟战记：巨龙残歌
4195990.short_description: The Dragon left elusive traces in the world, dancing elves and wandering bards travelling along the world. The magical Astral Spires, slumbered kingdoms, and many more regions are waiting for you to explore. Enter this world with your companions and finally create a heroic epic of your legend!

5022330.name: Abraxas Online
5022330.short_description: Build a lasting hero in a classic fantasy MMORPG. Explore a persistent world, fight in real time, compete in PvP, master nine professions, craft, and trade with other players.

5258280.name: THE FINALS - Season 12 Ultimate Battle Pass Bundle
5258280.short_description:
The Season 12 Ultimate Battle Pass includes:



- Season 12 Premium Battle Pass

- 20 Battle Pass Levels*

- 25% Match XP Boost

- 1,000 Multibucks

- Season 12 Ultimate Rewards in the Battle Pass



25% Match XP Boost will be applied to your Contestant for the duration of Season 12.

5203540.name: Starliners Demo
5203540.short_description: Build your first interplanetary civilization. Gather resources, establish colonies, connect your worlds, and develop the technologies needed to expand humanity across the Solar System.

3848520.name: PROJECT LEVELS
3848520.short_description: PROJECT LEVELS is a creative multiplayer sandbox where you and your friends can build worlds, create interactive experiences and bring your ideas to life together.

5313270.name: Pay or Die: Cartel Simulator Demo

1993050.name: Morgue Rot : The Coroner's Quest
1993050.short_description: Inspired from the METAL Magazine! The Coroner's Quest is a horror RPG influenced by metal for metal-heads! Play as the coroner and uncover some gruesome events which lead you on a path to putting a stop to the ultimate evil and saving the town of St. Anne. If you can stop the MORGUE ROT!!

4516970.name: Ego Lifting Simulator
4516970.short_description: A physics-driven lifting career sim where you physically control every rep. Train hard, train smart, manage your work-life balance and diet, and become the next lifting champion.

5054700.name: Fakin It XL
5054700.short_description: In Fakin’ It XL, one player, the Faker, never gets the prompt and has to bluff their way through. Choose in-room or remote play up front, and get round types built for either. New content, new question types, same lying and grilling you love.

4697340.name: MayDay MayDie Demo
4697340.short_description: A first-person social deduction game on a luxury plane, featuring real-time action and betrayal for up to 8 players. Passengers rush to complete tasks and survive violent turbulence to land the airliner, while hidden Hijackers sabotage it to force a crash. No voting, just pure paranoia.

5300910.name: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo
5300910.short_description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

4605930.name: Revenant Rangers
4605930.short_description: Ride out as a Revenant Ranger—an undead lawman bound by Hell’s contract—to hunt the escaped souls of the damned. Gun down demons, witches, and sinners across the Hell Plains in a brutal, fast-paced third-person co-op shooter where death is only the beginning.

3664440.name: Red Rust Pioneers
3664440.short_description: Build a new life in the Wild West open world of Red Rust Valley, alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. Hunt, farm, raise animals and craft through the changing seasons in this survival game as your camp grows from a canvas tent to a homestead. Free land, open skies, and a world worth exploring.

5070240.name: Calc and Beat
5070240.short_description: Calc and Beat is a tactical roguelike where resource management is key. Think several moves ahead, craft upgrades, and level up to protect your golem. Conquer an ever-changing dungeon that puts your strategy to the test with every run!

5271480.name: Racefoot Manager
5271480.short_description: Take command of a racing team and build a dynasty. Negotiate driver and sponsor contracts, develop your car through R&D, plan tyre strategy through sun and rain, and chase championship glory across full, consequential seasons.

3093990.name: Fire Isle
3093990.short_description: A cozy, turn-based strategy party-game for 1–4 players where everyone moves at once. Spread fire across a new hex island every match, block rivals, set traps and race for Wisps, the key to victory. Play online with friends or solo against bots.

4487370.name: 师姐别急，我抽卡就变强 Demo
4487370.short_description: Don't worry, senior sister. I draw cards to make Dome stronger. It's a card game that allows players to possess themselves in card battles

5173620.name: Shift Happens: Together
5173620.short_description: Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Take warehouse orders, find the required parts, move goods, assemble and pack products, handle unexpected incidents, and deliver everything as quickly as possible to maximize your earnings.

5287960.name: Sort On The Ball Demo
5287960.short_description: A cozy game about opening tons of capsules to sort and collect cute toy balls. Sort like you're on the ball!

4285600.name: Where is my sword
4285600.short_description:
A mismatched duo—a wicked demon god and a kind-hearted fox girl—is gathering followers!?
Travel across many lands and survive hectic yet strategic real-time battles by rummaging through your bag for just the right item!
Fight your foes or turn them into followers... What awaits at journey's end?

5377670.name: Brinelight
5377670.short_description: An incremental idle game that transforms your desktop into an animated deep-sea wallpaper. Grow a reef of glowing creatures, weave threads of living light, pull currents through the web, and descend through six mysterious zones into the Leviathan’s endless dreams.

3902160.name: Game About Breaking A Cube
3902160.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

5144250.name: House Rules 21
5144250.short_description: Blackjack, but every dealer plays by their own house rules. Work your way through nine dealers, each bending the rules of 21 in a different direction, build your bankroll, and unlock the modifiers, side bets, and card backs that turn a simple hand into a full run.

5066840.name: Hack You
5066840.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

5258310.name: THE FINALS - Dead Certain Set
5258310.short_description:
The Dead Certain Set includes:

1 Mythic Outfit,

1 Mythic Weapon Skin,

1 Legendary Weapon Skin,

1 Mythic Emote,

1 Legendary Charm,

1 Epic Player Card Background,

6 250 Multibucks.

5014530.name: Cats to Mars
5014530.short_description: A strategic 2D physics game where you stack adorable cats to reach Mars. Use each cat's unique size and weight to build your tower as high as possible!

2471590.name: StarBoost
2471590.short_description:
Boost, strafe, survive! Test your skill and reaction speed in this action-packed sci-fi racing game. 
Experience thrilling 360° parcour racing on your path to becoming the intergalactic champion. Be fast, make risky jumps, blasts and fight your way to the top.
Can you win the Tournament?

5405660.name: Eternal Survivors Demo
5405660.short_description: In this swashbuckling survivor-lite, face relentless hordes and ultimate bosses. Embark on a 3-act journey with 5 intrepid heroes. Harvest P.L.A.N.T. power and shatter game designers’ dreams of balance with game-breaking builds.

4844170.name: Dungebra Demo
4844170.short_description: Dungebra is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you choose multiple cards at once, trigger Combo, Overload and Sequence, build your deck during the run, and turn every turn into an explosive play.

5342280.name: Doodle Wars: Ink and Paper
5342280.short_description: Hand-drawn auto-battler on ink and paper. Open a pack, build a five-card army of stick troops, and let them duel for the rival tower. You do not steer the units: you design the deck. Campaign versus AI and online PvP.

5203230.name: Kazfall Demo
5203230.short_description:
Kazfall is a single-player roguelite dungeon crawler built on 25-minute runs. 
Fight with stamina and timed blocks, discover NPCs who sell upgrades and gear, and reach the boss before time runs out. 
Even failed runs make you stronger for the next descent.

4171290.name: Frog Knight Demo
4171290.short_description: A brave little frog and his talking sword climb a cursed well in this precision platformer. Jump, bounce, and master your timing to save the world. No checkpoints. No shortcuts. Just one long climb... or fall.

4200110.name: Nekome: Nazi Hunter
4200110.short_description: Hunt and kill Nazis in a stealthy single-player campaign with bloody and brutal melee combat. Study your enemies, confirm your approach, and become an unexpected assassin fueled by violent revenge.

5112550.name: Shit-Stealing Gnomes Demo
5112550.short_description: Co-op adventure in which you play as little gnomes robbing houses. Be stealthy and steal the dirtiest things you can find.

5202830.name: We Were Here Tomorrow: Fan Edition
5202830.short_description: The Tomorrow Fan Edition contains exclusive content for our most dedicated Explorers. Discover the art and music of We Were Here Tomorrow with the Digital Art Book, official soundtrack and exclusive wallpapers.

5202800.name: We Were Here Tomorrow Soundtrack
5202800.short_description: The Official We Were Here Tomorrow Soundtrack - Listen to the sounds of an imagined 80s future with 15 tracks of nostalgic synthwave, composed by Tom Wolkers.

5307920.name: SEC//SIM — セキュリティエンジニア・シミュレーション Demo
5307920.short_description: At 1 a.m., stand watch as a defensive AI in a SOC. Play SEC//SIM's first three nights and an exclusive fourth, Two Sounds. Check signals, trace hosts and keys, earn human approval, then strike at once. Can you spot the quiet move behind a ransomware countdown? Four nights lead into the full story.

3360800.name: Midnight Horde Demo
3360800.short_description: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror parkour action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies. Upgrade weapons, fortify castles and towns to keep darkness at bay.

5190120.name: 百年征战 Demo
developers: SHENZHEN JIYE MINGNIAO GAME TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.
publishers: SHENZHEN JIYE MINGNIAO GAME TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD.

3957680.name: They Will Come
3957680.short_description: Survive a nightmare and save your family. They Will Come is a cinematic steampunk horror adventure set in an alternate 1897. You must avoid detection, solve puzzles, and fight back against mysterious enemies with the help of your powerful robot companion, Talus.

4075630.name: Bloomies
4075630.short_description: A cozy incremental creature collector that lives on your taskbar! Plant seeds, hatch eggs and raise over 70 unique Bloomies while you work or play. Unlock skills until it all runs itself, defeat bosses for new seeds and hunt rare Sparkle variants to complete your collection.

2691080.name: Godreaper
2691080.short_description: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

3780520.name: Mercy Incore
3780520.short_description:
Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension.
Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

5374730.name: Deep Drift Fishing
5374730.short_description: Drop your line into the uncharted abyss! Dodge exotic aquatic fauna on your descent, snag high-value specimens on the reel-up, and survive encounters with mythical Apex predators. Upgrade your winch, harness burst nets, and unlock new oceans in this fast-paced arcade deep-sea fishing adventure.

5164820.name: Experiment 15
5164820.short_description: Experiment 15 is a two-player online co-op psychological horror puzzle game where you share control of a single body. One controls the body, the other the mind. Communicate, combine what each of you can perceive, and survive a series of disturbing experiments.

5288460.name: Underground Sweeper
5288460.short_description: A side-scrolling exploration game with light looting and incremental progression. Explore underground ruins, defeat monsters, collect and sell loot, upgrade your gear and abilities, venture deeper, and pay off your debt.

2509360.name: Water Me and You
2509360.short_description: A cozy co-op adventure in which you play as a water or seed-like character, changing states and rebuilding a world left behind by humans.

5270780.name: Chill Rogues Demo
5270780.short_description: Chill Rogues is an incremental action game with automatic combat, build crafting, and ongoing prestige.

5281380.name: UBAI 0
5281380.short_description: Follow Gen's story as he recounts the founding of Ubai. Discover the tale that led to the organization's creation as Gen reveals their origins.

5288080.name: Aqua Factory Simulator Demo
5288080.short_description: Build, automate, and grow your aquatic factory. Harvest from the sea, farm resources, process your catch, automate production, stock the shelves, and expand your operation. Team up with friends and build your factory together in multiplayer.

5011020.name: Rustmourne Demo
5011020.short_description: Demo for Rustmourne, a sci-fi survival horror game with detailed, VR-designed interactions. Traverse the corridors of an ancient, derelict structure and face the tortured beings within: hide, run, or cut off their limbs to survive. Will you understand the purpose of your awakening and get out alive?

5025090.name: Firefighters Code Red Demo
5025090.short_description: When fear takes over, your mission begins: in Firefighters Code Red you battle flames, smoke, and the clock!

5071840.name: TALAKA Demo
5071840.short_description: Slash, shoot, and restore myths and beasts in fluid, fast roguelite combat through a stunning hand-drawn watercolor world, where legends and even Orishas are going rogue in fear of being forgotten.

5102100.name: Rideshare "Stimulator" Demo
5102100.short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

5106820.name: Kaiju Princess: Super Survivor Showdown Demo
5106820.short_description: Explore a phantasmic realm! Pulverize your enemies! Don't die! Ah... But don't forget to find a way out! Choose from a variety of weapons, skills, and items to complement your character's traits and customize the optimal combat style for survival. Get ready for a fast-paced roguelike survival game!

5129800.name: Epic Seven Demo
5129800.short_description:
PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven.
A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations.
Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.

5189600.name: Sirens Demo
5189600.short_description: The pre-alpha demo features a section of the first level of the game- Nordic Island.

5198290.name: The Grand Book Archive: Tidy Up Demo
5198290.short_description: Restore the Grand Book Archive by sorting 2,990 books onto their rightful shelves. Use your observation and magical spells to organize the collection as quickly as possible. Explore a variety of book themes and discover endless possibilities within the archive.

5219790.name: DREADMOOR Demo
5219790.short_description: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

5224010.name: HANDS OVER Demo
5224010.short_description: Try HANDS OVER in this demo: a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends and try to stay at the table until the end.

5248110.name: Evil Moon: Unspoken Demo
5248110.short_description: Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

5248620.name: Silicone Heart Demo
5248620.short_description: Build a self-sustaining cyber farm on a planet-sized junkyard. Grow biomechanical crops, automate production, repair discarded robots, and secretly reshape a mechanical society from the inside in this cozy farming and automation adventure.

4538840.name: Things to Forget – Lighthouse Demo
4538840.short_description: James Miller, a 36-year-old lighthouse keeper, returns to work after a brief visit with his sister Olivia. Used to solitude, the sea and empty rooms, he senses the lighthouse feels different this time—and his routine shift is becoming something he never expected.

4660850.name: Vice Club Simulator Demo
4660850.short_description: Take charge of a strip club in the Vice Club Simulator demo! Hire dancers, stock the bar, and keep your guests happy through the nightly chaos. A first-person management sim where everyone else gets to party.

4782620.name: ICBM: Escalation - Assassin's Mace
4782620.short_description: Rise from the ashes of civil war and transform China into a global superpower. Leverage asymmetric warfare, revolutionary doctrine and the Assassin's Mace strategy to overcome stronger rivals and reshape the balance of power.

4822560.name: Cats In The Shell Demo
4822560.short_description: Provoke explosive chain reactions and experiment ever-evolving combat strategies in this mech-building roguelike auto battler. Mix and match components and mech modules to discover powerful synergies, then watch each creation spring to life in satisfying combat sequences.

4832670.name: Cinderline Demo
4832670.short_description: Drive the Cinderline as an anthropomorphic bird, exploring strange towns in an aging system. Gather ingredients to create the last S’MORE and deliver its delight to the Heart that keeps the system alive.

4163460.name: CitaDrill Demo
4163460.short_description: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your paw-some cat crew. DEMO CONTAINS THE FIRST FEW BIOMES.

4225130.name: Surfpunk Demo
4225130.short_description: Surfpunk Demo is a 1-4 player co-op ARPG featuring radical surfer-pirates, procedurally-generated islands, awesome loot and endless swarms of monsters. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

4269790.name: Zero To South Demo
4269790.short_description: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South! In this demo version, pick up your first passengers, trade items, and test your survival skills.

4354580.name: Hemlon the Grey Demo
4354580.short_description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

4381180.name: Coin Harvest
4381180.short_description: Robotic arms sweep a steady pour of coins off your plateau. Unlock islands, conquer six realms and ascend for crystals in an idle game that sits on your desktop while you work or play.

4395820.name: I’m a Wizard, But I Dig Demo
4395820.short_description: Shorten your journey to the castle by digging a tunnel through the mountain. Use magic and craft: swing your pickaxe, cast spells, blow up obstacles, and light your path with glowing slimes. Trade resources with the Goose, unlock new tools, and uncover the mountain's secrets.

4498390.name: 下一站青城 Demo
4498390.short_description: Enter the mythic world of Sanctum: Whispers of Qingcheng, Seek ascension through the Three Orthodox Schools, or delve into the Nine Unorthodox Arts of the mortal realm—mastering forbidden arts like corpse refinement and demonic shapeshifting. Your path defines the realm.

3929730.name: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends (Unlock)
3929730.short_description: Play the cooperative multiplayer experience inspired by Japanese folk tales and mythology.Choose from four classes – Samurai, Hunter, Ronin or Assassin – and play with friends or via online matchmaking in two-player story missions, four-player survival missions or Rivals Mode.

4142230.name: THE FATUM Demo
4142230.short_description: The Supreme Committee congratulates you on your promotion. Your task is to identify citizens infected by the unknown virus. Interrogate, inspect, pass a verdict. Test your deduction in a world of total control. Remember: the Standard above all.

3378390.name: Rekindled Trails Demo
3378390.short_description: Gather and Sell faraway goods to rebuild ruined towns and bring back light to a dark world in this cozy adventure game. With the help of your fire companion, fish, pull and mine natural resources in Aurteris to unite the people of this strange yet fantastic world!

3885720.name: Murals
3885720.short_description: These are not the tales you were told. Express yourself through stylized combat in the hand-painted worlds of Murals, a twisted isometric action-adventure where fairytales have gone spectacularly wrong.

3012110.name: Never Be Alone Demo
