3012110.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

2735900.name: Wilderdark Demo
2735900.short_description: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

2987410.name: 狗与哥布林 Demo（Dog And Goblin Demo）
2987410.short_description:
A minimalist deck-building game. 
Wisely choose your items and minions to destroy human's fort!

3618000.name: Hordeguard: Winds of the North
3618000.short_description: Leap into the heart of a Viking fantasy siege where tower defense meets action combat, strategy, and co-op survival. Gather what you can, raise your defenses, fight beside your friends, and hold the line against an unending horde.

1440860.name: Past Visiting Hours
1440860.short_description: Past Visiting Hours is a 1v3 asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Diagnose cursed patients, survive the hospital's monstrous inhabitants, or take control as The Board and turn the hospital into a living nightmare. Your shift is about to get a whole lot worse.

3764790.name: A Night at Ashmere Manor
3764790.short_description: When your father goes missing with little more than a letter to clue you in, it's up to you to find him. His last known whereabouts? Ashmere Manor. Will you succeed in solving the mystery at the heart of the house and find your father, or will you succumb to its phantom call?

5255600.name: 骰战异世界 Demo
5255600.short_description:
roguelike card game of claiming land on a board-game board. 
Build a squad with strategy and luck, defeat lords to win.
Isekai heroes' power becomes cards: build decks, pair artifacts, make clever choices.

1648533.name: Icarus: Dangerous Horizons Expansion
1648533.short_description: DANGEROUS HORIZONS opens access to Elysium, a hazardous new map warped by radiation and exotic fallout. Discover Eden, tame new mounts, survive 30+ new species, and dive deeper into six chained narrative missions. Push yourself further with the arrival of Tier 5 tech, oil drilling and advanced gear.

3969990.name: Ghost Hunting Journal Demo
3969990.short_description: Ghost Hunting Journal is an anime-style narrative adventure game. The duo partners of self-proclaimed "Spirit Agent" accept various supernatural commissions, use a full set of ghost-hunting techniques to tackle urban myths caused by lingering ghosts in the city of Riverrun.

4643110.name: Garden Of Being
4643110.short_description: Garden of Being is a hand-drawn oil pastel art game and a quiet journal of moods. Plant flowers, dedicate gardens to loved ones, and create downloadable prints. A fusion of art and code where gardens come alive while you are in them, and wait silently when you leave.

4926360.name: UBAI Ending
4926360.short_description: Ryousuke is suddenly confronted with a difficult decision regarding the future of Ubai.

5091010.name: Abandon All Hope
5091010.short_description: Abandon All Hope is a 1 to 4 player dark fantasy action RPG. Hunt the Seven Sins across a shattering world, master tactical combat, and craft absurdly powerful gear. Mix Weapons with different classes, play your way combat. 5+ Ways to earn loot after the campaign. Can you survive the decent?

5332690.name: Slot Crawler Demo
5332690.short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

416900.name: Void Invaders - Soundtrack
416900.short_description: The Void Invaders OST is here! The soundtrack features music by .

4222500.name: Solid Boat Adventure
4222500.short_description: Solid Boat Adventure is a co-op adventure game where you and your friends control an odd steamboat delivering curious cargo across treacherous waters.

5290320.name: Spot the Difference Fighter
5290320.short_description:
Fighting games meet spot-the-difference! Find the differences and KO your opponent!
No complicated controls—just sharp eyes and quick reflexes! Chain combos and compete against players from around the world!

4690280.name: Social Space
4690280.short_description: Social Space is the ultimate sandbox for creating and playing together. Whether you're here to discover something new or bring your own ideas to life, Social Space offers a welcoming environment for everyone!

3021550.name: Flock Off!
3021550.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action-adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off mutant sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

5136250.name: 结丹模拟器
5136250.short_description: Build a cultivation factory inside your body. Study an ancient manual, guide and refine qi by hand, then automate your cultivation with meridians and methods. Manage spiritual sense, clear away turbidity, and form your core before your lifespan runs out.

5089860.name: Slot Crawler
5089860.short_description: Explore. Kill. Loot. Die. Feed your hard-earned tokens to a slot machine with questionable intentions, then unlock new ways to make terrible decisions on the next run. Slot Crawler is a top-down action roguelike with procedural maps, chaotic builds, and combinations that definitely should not work.

3017550.name: Argus
3017550.short_description: Argus is 3D animation software which uses 3D hardware and game technology to allow you to create animations in lightning fast time.

3737630.name: Tenebris Legion Demo
3737630.short_description: Day 1 of Tenebris Legion. In 1988, FBI trainee Ethan Nolan reaches his father's remote New England house and meets Laura Bennett, the woman his father married. Play the opening hours of an adult visual novel of mystery, temptation and supernatural dread, where every choice counts.

5344410.name: Death To The Deathless  demo
5344410.short_description: 《Death to the Deathless》is an adventure game featuring lightweight roguelike elements. It combines deck-building with slot machine mechanics for combat. This game contains no real-world monetary gambling or microtransactions whatsoever.

5446080.name: Deuce Agency 2027
5446080.short_description: Run a tennis agency, not a player. Scout unknown juniors, negotiate contracts and sponsorships, plan every player's season across a 52-week world tour, and give tactical orders between sets — a deep management sim built on how professional tennis really makes money.

5235050.name: Time For Changes
5235050.short_description: During exam prep, Semyon faces a family crisis that leads to failure and a transfer to a troubled class. There, he encounters not only hostility but also makes new friends and meets girls who change his outlook on life. He must make tough choices between friendship, dreams, and harsh reality.

5161740.name: Night Gig
5161740.short_description: The boss needs the product shipped before the deadline and hires people for the night shift at high pay. At your workstation you handle post reviews, file sorting and audio repair; meanwhile the office lights dim, devices cut out, and a ghost closes in on sound and sight. Finish the night's work — and avoid the anomalies.

2437390.name: Enginefall
2437390.short_description: Session based survival where players upgrade and live aboard their own personal trains. Team up with friends, make new ones or go solo. Board colossal Titan Trains to fight, build, craft, gather and steal much needed resources. Fortify and stock your personal train fortress. Will you survive?

4510190.name: Gloop: Liquid Physics
4510190.short_description: Gloop: Liquid Physics is a real-time particle and liquid physics sandbox and VJ instrument. Thousands of interacting particles stir a canvas of flowing, pooling pigment. Paint into it with your mouse, drive it with music, your webcam or your own images and video, save scenes, and perform them live.

4199210.name: Evocation Demo
4199210.short_description: Evocation is a card game with unique gameplay, high interactivity, and deep mechanics. It includes a roguelike PvE mode and an online PvP mode without in-app purchases. Draw and maintain your magical circle, freely trade and craft equipment, and purge the heretics along the pilgrimage path.

4578110.name: I Am Your Beast - Quitting Time DLC
4578110.short_description: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

5026300.name: Escape Together: Prison Break
5026300.short_description: Dig a secret tunnel and escape a heavily guarded prison. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players. Hide your operation from guards, dispose of dirt, trade valuable finds, upgrade your tools, and plan the escape using proximity voice chat.

4817620.name: 再再启程 One Way Tickets
4817620.short_description: “One Way Tickets” is a roguelite incremental adventure game where you embark on a exciting journey in a fantasy world. Choose your vehicle, equip your device and face challenges from all kinds of enemies. Ram! Unload bullets! Swing with all your might! Keep growing and push forward!

2083940.name: DROSS
2083940.short_description:
DROSS is a procedurally Generated FPS, set in a derelict facility infested with alien bugs.
Explore, collect powerful weapons and equipment, to upgrade your gear and fight the Dross.

4274410.name: ApocalypseHQ
4274410.short_description: Lead a survivor headquarters after the zombie outbreak in this turn-based management strategy game, where each turn represents one day. Allocate scarce people and supplies, restore territories and infrastructure, and expand through research and high-risk external operations.

5458290.name: VRX3D
5458290.short_description: Play your flat PC games on a giant 3D screen in VR. VRX3D captures the game window, works out the depth of every frame live on your graphics card, and shows it in stereo on a big screen in a dark room lit by the picture. Keep your keyboard, mouse or controller.

3703450.name: Trick-Taking Rogue
3703450.short_description:
Trick-Taking × Roguelike!
Trick-taking games fused with roguelike elements like skills and shops!
Features 9 trick-taking games including Spades, Oh Hell, and Schnapsen!

4672440.name: Phroller
4672440.short_description: The next generation touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion! Featuring a massive library of free assets and models.

5256860.name: Wobblebound
5256860.short_description: A physics stacking roguelite where every toy has a face. Draft toys and lucky charms at every bell, beat wind, thunder and snow, unlock 37 charms and 8 harder levels, then race or build one tower together with up to four players on one PC.

5374230.name: Meowsweeper
5374230.short_description: Welcome to Meowsweeper. As an orange cat on the clock, flip cards to catch mice across from your black cat boss. Caught mice snitch on Mean Dogs—every board can be deduced, no guessing. Chain laser pointers and catnip to bank 999 Mouse Chips in 12 shifts and buy the Golden Can.

4555040.name: Sushiamo
4555040.short_description:
Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. 
Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

5232680.name: Desert Survival Demo
5232680.short_description: Survive 15 minutes in a desert that wants you dead. Fight swarms out of Arabian folklore, forge elemental builds and weapon evolutions, answer daily contracts, and grow stronger between runs with deep skill trees. Free to play - every run tells a different story.

4311530.name: Very Safe Dino Park 🦖
4311530.short_description: A chaotic 1 to 4 player dinosaur park sim where feeding the dinos, cleaning the mess, and surviving the chaos are all part of the job.

4625610.name: Plumber Simulator
4625610.short_description: Become a plumber and restore water flow in suburban homes. Unclog toilets, replace sink traps, renovate bathrooms - the residents can only count on you during an emergency.

4857350.name: The Trivia Show
4857350.short_description: Chaotic multiplayer for up to 8 friends. Think fast, dodge traps and turn the tables. A question hits the screen, the clock runs, and every wrong answer sets off the room: exploding platforms, ankle bombs, a revolver on the table and much more.

4792850.name: Phroller - Free Version
4792850.short_description: The next generation touchscreen native, controller tested, battery efficient, cross-platform with tablets and mobile, offline enabled, 2.5/3D VTT, Dice Roller and RPG Companion! Featuring a massive library of free assets and models.

4540940.name: Grinner's Diner
4540940.short_description: A co-op horror cooking game for 2 to 4 players, also playable solo. Grill burgers and fry tenders at a roadside diner in the Appalachian hills. By day it's a rush. After dark, cryptids come to the window, and something in the woods is waiting for the lights to go out.

5100070.name: 大烟枪
5100070.short_description: I Got Smoke is a pixel-art, top-down action game. Play as a traditional cigarette and kill every vape. Gunfights, close combat, executions—kill everything you see, or be killed.

4455610.name: Stargazer Simulator
4455610.short_description: Go from zero to a real amateur astronomer. Join the astronomy club, set up your own telescope, start with your first bright star, and go on to find the Moon’s craters and distant galaxies in the real night sky. Every star you learn in the game is really up there tonight.

3209660.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
3209660.short_description:
Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore.

Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

5152910.name: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE
5152910.short_description: BACKROOMS: REALITY FAILURE is a first-person psychological horror game where your first day at work becomes a nightmare. Explore a distorted office complex, uncover mysterious letters, and find a way out as reality begins to fall apart around you.

5228190.name: Last Store on Earth Demo
5228190.short_description: You run the last store in a ruined world, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op. Clean and restore your shop, get the generator running, restock the shelves, and open your doors to the survivors who still come knocking. A survival and shopkeeping sim where every customer has a story.

3255840.name: Insanitorium - Don't Be Afraid
3255840.short_description: Trapped in a psychiatric hospital, you must escape demons lurking in the shadows.Explore Insanitorium only with your flashlight and scarce batteries, defend yourself with a machete and a dart gun, and face the strange patients. Remember, do not listen to the mannequins that whisper inside your head.

4132280.name: PHUY
4132280.short_description: You’re a crew of hapless thieves with one job: rob a museum and make it out alive. Hunt for valuables, solve puzzles, and survive the locals. Just try not to become part of the exhibit. A co-op horror game for 1–4 players.

2849490.name: Outward 2
2849490.short_description: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements, focusing around a grounded experience. There’s no hand-holding, no scaled encounters, no divine blessings to make you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: an unforgiving, rewarding adventure awaits.

4511860.name: Approaching Infinity: Survivors
4511860.short_description: A sci-fi Bullet-Heaven survivors-like in the rich Approaching Infinity universe. Fight increasingly difficult battles both in space and on the ground. Level up fast! Unlock new ships, captains, and weapons. Decide the fate of the galaxy! (Made for humans, by humans, but aliens would be welcome.)

2888120.name: Auto Clicker
2888120.short_description: Auto Clicker is secure, works with games and apps, and removes the need for repeated clicking. You can use the Standard or Advanced mode according to what best suits your needs.

5207110.name: 大烟枪 Demo
5207110.short_description: I Got Smoke is a pixel-art, top-down action game. Play as a traditional cigarette and kill every vape. Gunfights, close combat, executions—kill everything you see, or be killed.

4755890.name: Crude Empire
4755890.short_description: Build an oil empire in boomtown Texas: find oil, drill the well yourself, lay pipelines, refine gasoline and run your own gas stations. Every stage can become the bottleneck, and rival oil companies fight you for every field and every customer.

4616970.name: S-Ranker
4616970.short_description: Enter 5-minute dungeons, clear out monsters, choose your powers during battle, and rise from F-Rank to S-Rank in an action roguelite.

4758440.name: TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER Demo
4758440.short_description: Live the life of a truck driver in TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER Demo. Travel across open roads, complete jobs, manage your needs, upgrade your truck, and build your path in a world driven by distance and time.

4748860.name: D.A.M.N! Demo
4748860.short_description: Try team play with a friend for free, right now, via Steam Remote Play Together — they don't even need to buy the game. Full online co-op with per-player progression awaits in the full game.

4659640.name: TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER
4659640.short_description: Live the life of a truck driver in TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER. Travel across open roads, complete jobs, manage your needs, upgrade your truck, and build your path in a world driven by distance and time.

4394720.name: The Warden's Rite
4394720.short_description: The Warden's Rite is a fantasy tower defense game set in a world consumed by the Fire God. You are humanity's last hope. As the Warden, command Earth, Air, and Water with the power of the Elemental Gods. Combine elements to create traps, block paths, and place towers to set your strategy.

5441330.name: Last Star Standing
5441330.short_description: The aliens have weaponized the asteroids, and the stars are going dark. You are the last star standing. Pull worlds into orbit, forge them into planets that fight for you, and grow into a whole solar system to defeat the armada. A space bullet heaven.

5133680.name: Tiny Survivors Demo
5133680.short_description: Carve a path through massive hordes of enemies while creating ridiculously broken builds. Collect powerful loot, unlock new characters, and combine upgrades to create a tiny but unstoppable force. How long can you survive the onslaught?

5119490.name: Note Bounce – Sheet Music Game & Video Creator Demo
5119490.short_description: Free demo: tap bouncing balls on real sheet music across 7 songs, import your own MIDI files, and render 720p videos. The full game unlocks 30+ songs and watermark-free 4K rendering.

4195140.name: PIX Football Manager
4195140.short_description: An online football manager. Scout talent from 350+ clubs, trust your eye to find the right players, and outbid rival managers in auctions. Build squad chemistry, shape your tactics, and face other managers’ clubs in weekly leagues, on your own schedule.

5131150.name: Hack You Demo
5131150.short_description: Desktop hacking and social engineering in a moral thriller. Write viruses, hide them in game builds, crack other people's PCs — to get to the former friend who stole your life and built a new success on its ruins.

5074630.name: Fleshgrinder
5074630.short_description:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic Action-RPG.
Take on the desperate mission to stop the Fleshgrinder from causing planetary extinction by harvesting the infected population.
Loot, equip and level up your characters, interact with npcs in a persistent world filled with quests and danger.

4943910.name: KickTheDungeon Demo
4943910.short_description: Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game based on the SRD 5.1 rules. Assemble a unique party, tailor your own build, and enjoy the thrill of combat. Use cards to cast familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a different experience.

5070730.name: Blossoms of Light
5070730.short_description: Relax with 60 floral puzzles across 5 chapters. Move, rotate, and connect colorful pieces to reveal flowers with a stained-glass look and soft pearlescent textures. Enjoy gentle music, optional hints, and automatically saved progress at your own pace.

5436980.name: Cursed To Move
5436980.short_description: `Cursed To Move is a dark chess roguelite where every run rewrites the rules. Upgrade your pieces with game-breaking abilities, choose your path through battles, shops and bosses, and keep your king alive as the board collapses around you.

4457380.name: Viking Colony Builder Valhalla
4457380.short_description: Build and expand a thriving Viking settlement. Manage resources, develop trade, train your colonists, fortify your lands, and lead warriors into tactical battles, daring raids, and new conquests.

5062690.name: Re:Draw
5062690.short_description: One day the Erasure happened. The world didn't die - it was simply erased. You're one of the few left holding a pencil. Restore the erased world from scratch: sketch, bring ecosystems to life, and watch as the settlers you drew build a civilization.

5257240.name: AutomaticBox Demo
5257240.short_description: A bunch of boxes move on their own. All you can do is watch them move and reset them. It's a box-pushing game without a main character. You need to use the order and direction of the boxes to guide them to stand on the destinations at the same time. Hope it gives you a relaxing brain massage.

5208650.name: E36 and the gang
5208650.short_description: A driving and drifting game about good roads, big skids, and having a good time behind the wheel.

3099830.name: Darkest Darkness
3099830.short_description: Darkest Darkness is a roguelike deck-building game with extraction elements. Choose your identity and venture into a Lovecraftian town. Craft every card yourself—collect materials, build powerful cards, plan your route, or extract with your gathered materials to gain an edge in your next run.

2938410.name: The Witch's Redemption Demo
2938410.short_description: Step into a world shrouded in mystery and peril in “The Witch’s Redemption,” an RPG teeming with narrative depth and strategic intrigue. Unravel the mysteries that hold Alice captive through captivating dialogues, thrilling battles, and cunning investigations.

4387900.name: The Hundredth Floor Demo
4387900.short_description:
The Hundredth Floor is a 3D action loot game. You can collect many equipment to defeat various enemy and evacuate in the right time.  
In the demo,  8 type of weapon can be used and a part of level is open.

1718750.name: SVFI - Professional
1718750.short_description: SVFI Professional Version: super resolution modules, more exclusive VFI models, HDR content processing module and fine-grained output settings.

5282240.name: ORAE
5282240.short_description: Explore a dense, interconnected world once inhabited by humans and souls. Find your path, solve puzzles, collect floppy disks and make friends to uncover this world's deepest secrets.

4223800.name: A Rat's Quest - The Way Back Home | Season 2
4223800.short_description: Stranded far from home, Mat, the determined young rat, must brave the dangerous "Outside" to make his way back to his friends and Nat. Armed with only a rivet, he must face new foes and forge alliances in order to complete his epic quest and be reunited with his beloved.

2845100.name: TIME JOURNEY
2845100.short_description: This game is perfect for players who relish sci-fi mysteries, engaging storylines, and intellectual challenges. "Time Journey" invites you to decipher the secrets of your identity and the alien lab, making every discovery a step closer to the truth.

4296940.name: Mercy Incore Demo
4296940.short_description:
Solo indie character-action. You are a medieval knight in a techno-dimension.
Become a jet-boosted vampire to survive. Follow a full-metal spaniel to escape

5412920.name: Roads Taken
5412920.short_description: A tactical role-playing game where every adventure is new: the story, the heroes, the world and its battlefields are drawn from a single seed. Lead your company through a land at war, forge bonds that change the fight, and live with the roads you take.

5229010.name: Mana Boom Demo
5229010.short_description: Magic meets physics, and the world is yours to mess with! Battle or race with up to 8 players in real time. Lob spells with your choice of elements and projectile behaviors, swing on ropes, and destroy or create terrain. Win your own way. Play dirty, but don't let it backfire!

1204050.name: Pixel Studio - best pixel art editor
1204050.short_description: Best pixel art editor. Simple. Fast. Portable.

5196060.name: Rottenlands Demo
5196060.short_description: Rottenlands is a tower defense deckbuilder where you build a deck of units, towers, and abilities to hold back waves of Mold-corrupted enemies and protect the kingdom.

5223600.name: De Potrero
5223600.short_description: You are a footballer, straight from the youth ranks until your last season. One decision at a time: when to shoot, when to pass, what to say to the press. A whole career decided by what you choose, and a little by your luck.

4866020.name: Sokobomb
4866020.short_description: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

4167200.name: UN:Me
4167200.short_description: UN:Me is a soul triage adventure. Four souls share one girl’s body, each certain it is the real one, yet only one can remain. Through dialogue you search a beautiful, unsettling world for its true owner, fleeing the traumas that surface as you go. When only one can stay, which will you keep?

5207010.name: Gateholt
5207010.short_description: Gateholt is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Enter a cursed place and erase the marks an evil spirit has left behind. Every mark you erase brings it closer. You cannot fight it — run, or hide. The way back is still open.

1993410.name: Laws of Nadragia
1993410.short_description: Become a prosecutor in the totalitarian Nadragia. Convict criminals: use the laws and facts of court cases to get a verdict at any cost... But can you keep your conscience?

4954970.name: No Body No Problem!
4954970.short_description: One of you is the cop. The rest are panicked suspects. Hide the body, clean up the evidence, don’t rat each other out, and get rid of everything before your cop friend knocks on the door. There is only one rule: if the body is found, you’re all done for.

4338000.name: Saraab: Beyond The Veil Demo
4338000.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel about healing, where saving your brother means facing your own demons. Elham’s search pulls her through visions and entities rooted in Arabian folklore, and family secrets that should have stayed buried.

3506750.name: Monster Punk
3506750.short_description: Dominate the ultimate motorsport roguelite. Smash, blast, and pull off wild stunts through extreme arena challenges. Fight through each run alone or in co-op, defeat brutal bosses, and earn the cash to upgrade your ride. Lose, and your run is over. Rise from “nobody” to Arena Champion

5303370.name: Suspencil
5303370.short_description: An online drawing and social deduction game for up to 8 players. Draw your prompt and discuss the drawings to find the Werewolf—the only one with a different prompt. The Madman scribbles on others’ drawings to help the Werewolf. Even if caught, the Werewolf can win by guessing the Citizens’ prompt.

5388210.name: Riddled Together Demo
5388210.short_description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

5038030.name: Frog Frog Parkour
5038030.short_description: Take control of a frog in a fast-paced arcade parkour game. Charge each jump, launch yourself across challenging courses, collect coins, and race against your own ghost to beat your best times. Easy to start, difficult to master.

2818700.name: Marked For Mayhem
2818700.short_description: Enter a shattered world where dimensions collide in this competitive 4-player action dungeon runner. Defeat and leverage diverse bosses, win chaotic challenges, master your build around unique weapons, and sabotage your rivals to take the top spot. The mission is shared. The glory isn’t.

4578540.name: Fame Or Folly Demo
4578540.short_description: The outrageous traveling troupe roguelike deckbuilder. Put on shows across the kingdom, push your luck at the risk of upsetting the crowd. Pivot your deck using a variety of cards, banners, and props. Become the king of the festival either solo or in ranked multiplayer!

5090120.name: NICO DRAW
5090120.short_description:
Play with friends, and you're guaranteed to smile.
Draw a character and watch it come to life! Combine the unique abilities of Humans, Cats, Birds, and Slimes as you throw, grab, and cling your way through obstacle-filled stages in this hand-drawn online co-op action game for up to 4 players.

4134790.name: Guildmaster’s Quest
4134790.short_description: A turn-based guild management strategy game. Summoned to another world by a goddess, you found a guild, send adventurers into dungeons and win over or blackmail the courts of seven great kingdoms, while every death in the world brings the Demon Lord closer.

5470270.name: Love in the Med Pit Demo
5470270.short_description: Sort surgical trays, stock supply drawers and fall for Dr. Shack Abassy, a gruff ER veteran with a soft spot for his emerald-eyed cat. Love in the Med Pit is a cozy medical sorting romance drawn like a 1950s hospital manual. No timers, no rush. Everything has its place.

3503810.name: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】
3503810.short_description: 「TERROR」type:【A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.】is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. explosions. Craft potions and bombs to sabotage a tyrannical regime. Master forbidden alchemy, navigate a vertically-layered city in stealth, and ignite a revolution.

5352960.name: 喵在江湖 Demo
5352960.short_description: Meowxia: Idle Wuxia is a desktop-pet idle RPG set in a wuxia world of cats. Train Inner Arts, advance through realms, learn skills, collect gear, unlock meridians, and mix different builds to raise your own feline martial arts hero.

5121310.name: Lust of the Dead Demo
5121310.short_description: Experience the demo of the first chapter of Lust of the Dead, a first-person survival horror set in St. Erebus Hospital, where desire bacame infection. Explore its abandoned halls, uncover the secrets of Eros-9, solve puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive the horrors within.

5385370.name: Chunk DAW Demo
5385370.short_description: Build music out of blocks! Place, pitch, and sequence sounds in a 3D world, solo or with friends in real time. Jam over built-in voice chat, shape terrain and scenery around your songs, then publish your creations for the world to browse, remix, and play.

4996430.name: Pyramid Wars
4996430.short_description: Pyramid Wars is a fast, top-down pixel-art RTS. Fight massive RTS battles against an overwhelming enemy. Cast abilities and automate your base. Buy boosterpacks to get legendary units and increase your army even further.

5424330.name: Catch Me If You Seoul
5424330.short_description: One real bag. A frantic chase through Seoul! Check whether your bag is real, tackle minigames to earn items, and snatch bags from your rivals. Turn the tables right up until the escape routes open in this competitive party game for up to 8 players.

4763870.name: Slutty Hotel
4763870.short_description: You’re the new owner of Slutty Hotel, and your first girl is already waiting at the door 😏🔑 With every room, the scenes get MORE EXPLICIT and the line between work and pleasure fades away 🔥 Find out right now who will become much more than just an employee. FREE TO PLAY 🥵

5113850.name: 岁巡社 01：最后一个顾客 Demo

4712430.name: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game
4712430.short_description: Roll the dice and conquer the magical board! Upgrade monster lairs, unleash unique character abilities, and bankrupt your friends in this chaotic multiplayer party game.

3266730.name: No Alibi
3266730.short_description: Rob banks, collect bounties, and gamble it all away in No Alibi. Up to 4 players work together to lead their criminal empire to success. Use your customized guns and equipment to take hostages and steal everything you can. Just make sure the boss gets paid.

3897900.name: Our Great Leader
3897900.short_description: Who better than you to be at the heart of power, for the good of your nation? All decisions are yours to make. It's not about feeding your ego, no, it's just common sense.

4725890.name: 永眠之匣雪上之樱
4725890.short_description: A story-driven visual novel set in a funeral home! Join Xue Hao & his odd, gentle family—his "sister" Elsa & a 25cm mascot (me!). A tale of farewell & companionship. 250k words, fully voiced, EX episodes & meta story. Happy end for all!(´▽`ʃ♡ƪ)

4944870.name: Fuse Beads Simulator
4944870.short_description: A simple and tense fuse bead challenge game.

3864280.name: Mr. Prepper - Mountaineer DLC
3864280.short_description: A cold new adventure awaits! Climb 10 levels of a mysterious mountain, survive freezing temperatures, uncover Agency secrets, and follow a mysterious climber's messages through a one-way walkie-talkie. Bring new technology and useful equipment back to your bunker.

4446580.name: Hunter's Hand Demo
4446580.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelike deckbuilder set in a cursed world. Build your deck, escalate Threat, and face a powerful Ancient in this playable opening chapter of Hunter’s Hand.

3864310.name: Mr. Prepper - Uranium Project DLC
3864310.short_description: Gain access to a long-abandoned nuclear power plant, manage unstable uranium to craft powerful tools and weapons, advance through a new storyline, and decorate your bunker in a whole new way!

5093820.name: Rechained Demo
5093820.short_description: A demo covering the opening of RE:CHAINED. A grid tactical RPG with deckbuilding: choose where to stand, choose what to play. In this demo you cross the threshold of the Abyss and take three Revenants as allies.

1882510.name: Mr. Prepper - Animal Farm DLC
1882510.short_description: Take care of the animals, repair the farm’s facilities, learn fishing, explore the new areas, adopt a dog, get to the bottom of the Agency’s special interest in the farm and discover the mystery lurking from above! Use what you learn on the farm in your shelter and breed your own animals!

5400320.name: HAZPIT Demo
5400320.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

5342350.name: Marschwerk: Tug of War Strategy
5342350.short_description: A tug-of-war strategy game for up to six players. Build works that train your army on their own, send it down the lanes and push the front to the enemy keep. Upgrade your works, capture crossings for new units and cast spells from your tower.

3226830.name: Canvas City
3226830.short_description: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG where movement is core to the strategy. Grind rails, launch off ramps, and use every part of the map to your advantage as you outsmart rival crews and take back the city.

5401870.name: Hot Loads
5401870.short_description: Load one, load them all. Launch your game and all your companion apps will hot-load automatically, close when you exit, and keep your system tray clean. Features also include game-specific primary monitor management and pre-and-post-launch batch script execution.

5161460.name: Carom Crashers Demo
5161460.short_description:
Bank shots beat direct hits — ×1.5 off one wall, ×2 off two. A 4-player party shooter where you read
angles like billiards. Couch party: plug in a pad, press A; friends join free via Remote Play Together.
Full bot matches, online quick match, 12 weapons, 6 arenas, mutators.

5315280.name: Tiles of the Nadirat Demo
5315280.short_description: A traditional roguelike where every step changes your build. Collect permanent stats, trigger item combos with movement patterns. Master 6 classes, that change how you value tiles, and uncover origin of the Nadirat creator through koan based riddles.

4315680.name: Suixun 01: The Last Customer
4315680.short_description: A linear paranormal mystery visual novel driven by dynamic text presentation. As timid but earnest rookie Mao-Rabbit, explore a mall after closing, rescue a customer the night guard cannot see, and uncover the anomaly rules already at work. No branches or bad endings.

5397180.name: HAZPIT
5397180.short_description: A top-down survival game where you work your way down zombie-infested high-rises, floor by floor from the roof. Lower floors mean more radiation and zombies, but better loot. Stay undetected when you can, and use what you bring back to repair your bunker and recruit survivors. Single-player only.

4159290.name: The Rusted
4159290.short_description: The world belongs to machines now. Join a loyal robot dog on a journey through a haunting post-apocalyptic world in search of its lost human family. THE RUSTED is a hand-drawn 2D action-puzzle platformer.

5295020.name: The Ink Tower
5295020.short_description: A perfect parry freezes the fight. You get one stroke of ink, and the stroke is your attack. A line cuts straight through. A loop hits everyone inside it. You unlock a spiral that pulls enemies in and a figure eight that bursts where it crosses. Fifteen floors, one life. Eight bosses.

5412460.name: RIVER OF DEAD
5412460.short_description: Play as a lone warrior dog defending a vital river from relentless crocodiles in a fast-paced 2D arcade survival game. Master your harpoon, unlock the Power Harpoon, survive the Final Rush, and defeat the River King with 8 direct hits.

4525650.name: Weaponized
4525650.short_description:
Weaponized is a fast, violent vector shooter where you play as an asteroid miner who stole a spaceship to go mine hell. Take on mining contracts, use your machine gun to carve ore out of asteroids, and scavenge for abandoned tech.

Inspired by indies like Luftrausers, Ape Out , Duskers, and Dredge.

4148910.name: PGP003
4148910.short_description:
Every day, a new corpse turns up in this quiet town.
Every day, a new suspect emerges.
And every day, that cave looms larger, more ominously.
Amidst gory crime scenes and suffocating interrogations, only one thing will lead you to the truth: wasabi.

5086610.name: 三线牌斗 Demo
5086610.short_description: Duelike is a roguelike deckbuilding card game featuring poker-inspired mechanics and online PvP battles. Build unique decks, make strategic decisions, and compete in ever-changing card battles. Experience the core gameplay in this demo version.

5357170.name: We Are The Horde
5357170.short_description: In We Are The Horde you play the zombies. Your horde grows through five pixel-art cities, you take district after district and decide for every survivor whether to devour or infect them. Each city fights back in its own way, from a citizen militia to a military base.

5096780.name: Tailor Hotel
5096780.short_description: Tailor Hotel is a management simulation game where you build and run your very own one-of-a-kind hotel.

3918800.name: Battleship Blitz
3918800.short_description: A modern take on the classic Battleship game - now in 3D! Place your wooden fleet, take aim, and sink enemy ships in singleplayer or PvP multiplayer. Simple, nostalgic, and addictive.

2845380.name: Colony Break
2845380.short_description:
Colony Break is a sci-fi colony sim where your people are the power, and the problem. 
Build, manage, and defend humanity's future on a hostile planet. 
The greatest danger is not what hunts you, but what changes you. 
Will your colony survive, or will it break itself apart?

2780700.name: Hidden Cats in Spooky Carnival
2780700.short_description: A mysterious carnival has appeared outside Spooky Town! Explore its spooky attractions, find Hidden Cats, meet unusual characters, unlock bonus levels, and uncover the strange secret hiding behind the fun.

4881890.name: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss Demo
4881890.short_description: Run your very own cat cafe! Lead your cats on adventures into a magical city, gather ingredients to cook scrumptious dishes, customize your dream cafe, and bring bliss to your loyal customers in this cozy management lifesim. 🐱

5091050.name: Aquanaut
5091050.short_description: Delve into the depths of an accursed ocean in this top-down bullet hell roguelike. Battle impossible odds, amass hoards of treasure, and become incredibly powerful - or drown trying.

5224120.name: AnomalyVault Demo
5224120.short_description: Anomaly Vault is an industrial sci-fi horror simulation in which you become an employee of APC, the last corporation remaining in a dystopian world. Analyze unidentified anomalies, construct automated processing facilities, and survive incidents that spiral beyond control.

5153910.name: DashBreaker Demo
5153910.short_description: From breaking asteroids to piercing massive warships, grow your small craft into a force to be reckoned with. DashBreaker is an active incremental game: dash through enemies, gather resources, and buy permanent upgrades. Unlock new abilities and wipe out more enemies with every dash.

4439360.name: Chain of Command
4439360.short_description: Chain of Command is a top-down arena shooter roguelike, where you control a snake-like chain of fighters that attack automatically. Choose your Commander and build your party to create high-synergy builds to crush the invading demon armies.

5196990.name: The Super Seven
5196990.short_description:
The Super Seven is a mixed media visual novel in the style in the style of 80s and 90s sitcom television shows.
The Super Seven follows Cheng, a new student who has recently moved to Sydney to begin university. He is quickly swept into an eccentric group of seven students.

4119440.name: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
4119440.short_description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

3830020.name: Stone the Crows
3830020.short_description: Stone the Crows is a couch/online fighting game where you take control of medieval history's strangest doodles and battle it out using Earth Magic and Enhanced Movement.

5213730.name: TsundereSQL Demo
5213730.short_description: Play all of Module 1 of TsundereSQL: 18 SQL questions on a practice database, checked against hidden test data, ending in a boss. Tsumugi marks your work, texts you as you solve, and gives you one free outfit pull. Plus 24 optional drills and a look at what the full game adds.

5193710.name: Roguestorm Beats Demo
5193710.short_description: A bullet hell where the enemy is silence and your weapon is the jam you write. The music rests muted the music and left the notes to turn wild; capture their energy and apply it to your beat. Then use it to attack the silence and bring back the beat.

5424080.name: Spatial Awareness
5424080.short_description: A co-op sci-fi building game where you and your friends build spaceships part by part, connect power to your machines, and fly with physics-based thrusters. Take off from your planetoid, fly through the atmosphere and out into space, and explore the galaxy together.

3334170.name: Tales of Tuscany
3334170.short_description: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

5145030.name: Pig Up Demo
5145030.short_description: Pig Up is a third-person 3D platform adventure game. Control the piglet to climb floating platforms, travel through fantastic worlds to find lost companions and uncover the truth hidden behind the temporal chaos.

4509200.name: Grease Trap '99
4509200.short_description:
Mystery Horror / Comedic Takeaway Simulator. Deep-fry pizzas and live the Scottish dream.

Voice-acted in Scottish Gaelic; subtitles in English or Gaelic.

5398950.name: Poly Magic
5398950.short_description: A fast fantasy survivors-like where magic becomes a weapon of mass destruction. Choose a hero, build a deadly set of spells, and survive 12 minutes of enemy waves — alone or in online co-op for two.

2415210.name: Okey Online
2415210.short_description: Okey Online is a Free-to-Play take on the beloved Turkish tile game. Play online with friends or bots in cozy 3D rooms, seated as your own avatar behind a custom ıstaka. Chat by voice, fire off emotes, slap a rival who stalls, and earn titles as you level up.

5358580.name: Give Us Back Gravity
5358580.short_description: A zero-gravity push-your-luck roguelite about salvaging a derelict space station. There are no brakes: thrusters burn oxygen, so you stop by kicking off walls or throwing cargo the other way. Take all you can carry, but it only pays if you get it back to the airlock. Online co-op for up to 4.

5375250.name: 徹底清掃
5375250.short_description: Clean the facility thoroughly with up to 9 players. Pick up, sort, wash, and carry. What counts as trash? Where does it belong? How clean is clean enough? Don't expect everything to be explained from the start.

3592940.name: Flesh & Wire
3592940.short_description: Delve into the psychological roots of the POSTAL series in Flesh & Wire, a horror first person shooter that ventures into the twisted reality of a hapless victim seeking enshrouded answers and grisly vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

5046790.name: Rally Point
5046790.short_description: A strategy roguelite set in a galaxy that fights back. Draft 90+ heroes, mechs, and support cards. Campaign solo or co-op — between your missions, enemy factions reinforce, counterattack, and contest your ground. In solo, pause to replan.

5417370.name: 东方自走棋
5417370.short_description: Touhou Auto Chess is a single-player roguelite auto battler based on the Touhou Project. Recruit companions from Gensokyo and build diverse team compositions by combining equipment, treasures, and synergies. Discover fresh combos with your favorite characters!

4776120.name: Just One More Sheet
4776120.short_description: An office incremental game where you grab paperwork and toss it into the shredder. Shred until clock-out, spend your budget on upgrades and new hires, and climb from intern to group chairman. But what exactly are you destroying every day? Three endings, shaped by what you choose to know.

5410820.name: FOURSAVENT Demo
5410820.short_description: Two Modes, CHAOS or Story Mode. Explore different universes and time eras, from cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, each with its own story and gameplay mechanics—or jump into CHAOS Mode for fast-paced fun with friends and climb the ranks.

3416890.name: GROWTH EXPERIMENT Demo
3416890.short_description:
"In a certain apartment room, 'I' began a life with 'Chloe,' who had lost intelligence and memory. 
By navigating between the present and the past, it becomes clear what happened to the deteriorated 'Chloe.' Whether you interpret the ending as a happy one is entirely up to you."

3402380.name: ApesCape
3402380.short_description: In a deep-sea station lost at the bottom of the ocean, the pressure is rising and water is flooding the facility. In this cooperative FPS, every second counts. Work together to find the exit before everything is swallowed by the depths.

5299520.name: Star Replica
5299520.short_description: Mine, build, and replicate. Pilot a modular spacecraft through an unexplored universe, then put your replicas to work with autonomous mining and crafting. Transfer your consciousness between ships, grow your fleet, and follow mysterious signals into deep space.

5279710.name: Glitch Front
5279710.short_description: Glitch Front is a tactical cyberpunk card battler where team chemistry matters as much as the cards you draw. Build your crew, combine powerful faction synergies, master separate Play and Combat decks, and fight for control of a shared Warzone.

5331780.name: The Friendship Protocol
5331780.short_description: An island in southern Chile that doesn't appear on any map. A community that vanished. Machines that still guard it. Explore, recover what you find and make it out alive before you lose it all. A single-player third-person shooter inspired by a real Chilean legend.

3724300.name: Toto's Journey
3724300.short_description: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.

2153760.name: Stronghold 4
2153760.short_description: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

4277450.name: Anicards
4277450.short_description: Balanced 4-player card strategy with 25-minute matches. No Pay-to-Win. No Powercreep. Skill over Random.

4572860.name: Taverntasia Demo
4572860.short_description: Bir büyücü olarak kendi tavernanı yönet! Çeşitli ırklardan misafirleri ağırla. İksirler ve otlarla sihirli içecekler demle, lezzetli yemekler sun. Hızlı ve kaliteli hizmetle müşterilerini mutlu et. İtibarını inşa et, para kazan ve tavernanı zirveye taşı!

4277590.name: Soul Hunter
4277590.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op psychological horror where your camera lens is your only charm. Exorcise evil spirits, dispel illusions, and seal cursed souls onto film before they claim yours.

4236880.name: Witch’s Atelier Demo
4236880.short_description: A cozy pixel-art adventure! Play as a young witch & apothecary in a heartwarming town. Secretly guard the peace: battle monsters, brew potions, farm, cook, and fish. Build bonds with villagers. Blending healing vibes with action, start your witchy life!

4881370.name: Rift Raiders
4881370.short_description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

5204960.name: Highschool Heroes
5204960.short_description: Join Mike, Kyle, Littleboss, and Serena on an adventure against the bullies of Emerith. Each of them has their own fighting style.

4948830.name: StowStow
4948830.short_description: StowStow puts you in a physics-driven warehouse where every box has weight and consequence. Scan cargo, dodge explosions, draft upgrade cards, and build conveyor lines until the chaos runs itself.

4701760.name: Broadside Bets Demo
4701760.short_description: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

683390.name: 8 More Lives
683390.short_description: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG. Lead a mercenary company of outcast cats through a gritty procedural open world. Take contracts, count coin, bury the dead. Battle rival warbands and night horrors. You have 8 more lives - try not to waste them all.

3016710.name: Heavy Cargo - The Truck Simulator Demo

5153480.name: Pyramid Wars Demo
5153480.short_description: Pyramid Wars is a fast, top-down pixel-art RTS. Fight massive RTS battles against an overwhelming enemy. Cast abilities and automate your base. Buy boosterpacks to get legendary units and increase your army even further.

5114970.name: Tidy Up The Backrooms
5114970.short_description: Co-optional Horror Tidy Up. Every tape is an article from the official fandom wiki pages, cited in credits, voiced by a tape player while you tidy. Learn about the backrooms whilst tidying the backrooms. Transform a chaotic mess into a neatly organized archive. But be careful - you are not alone!

5348370.name: Rift Raiders Demo
5348370.short_description: Tear open the rifts, raid them for everything, and haul your spoils home to rebuild. Grid combat, push-your-luck runs, and a kingdom that grows stronger every time you fall.

4617170.name: Broadside Bets
4617170.short_description: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

4958650.name: Wheel of Death
4958650.short_description: Spin the wheel... or die. Wheel of Death is a dangerously addictive deck-builder where you'll spin Death's wheel, changing your fate with powerful Tarot card combos, rule-breaking chips, illegal contraband, and a wheel where the numbers go up!

5006020.name: Generation Ship Demo
5006020.short_description: You will each be in charge of expanding your spaceship by constructing different Sector cards and building several Tech and Expedition cards on top. Generate and spend Supplies effectively to optimize your sectors and bid on exciting expeditions to obtain the most victory points and win.

4724920.name: Generation Ship
4724920.short_description: You will each be in charge of expanding your spaceship by constructing different Sector cards and building several Tech and Expedition cards on top. Generate and spend Supplies effectively to optimize your sectors and bid on exciting expeditions to obtain the most victory points and win.

4547240.name: D6scend
4547240.short_description: D6SCEND is a single-player 3D puzzle game centered around manipulating a six-sided die. Roll across tile-based, multi-level mazes to reach a goal tile with a specific face value oriented upward. Master spatial reasoning and orientation tracking in a minimalist sci-fi world.

5434290.name: He's Kevin
5434290.short_description: He's Kevin is a chaotic online arena brawler for up to 4 players. Drop bombs, knock them back with a bat, pull them with a magnet and teleport out of trouble. Bring your friends. Kevin needs someone to blame.

3121410.name: BackStreet
3121410.short_description: BackStreet is a 3D action roguelite game that combines dynamic combo-based combat with deep strategic elements, all with simple controls. Stand against the tyranny of the corrupted city management AI, 3COS, in a world abandoned by humans due to environmental devastation.

4707700.name: Gold Mining Simulator - Definitive Edition
4707700.short_description: Gold Mining Simulator: Definitive Edition is the ultimate version of the game, featuring all previously released expansions plus new content, gameplay enhancements, visual improvements, and numerous quality of life upgrades for the most complete gold mining experience.

4236760.name: 2 Cooks 1 Mess Demo
4236760.short_description: 2 Cooks 1 Mess is a chaotic online cooking game where you manage a team of chefs, servers and cleaners with unique skills. Cook, clean, serve and survive wild kitchen events as you climb from rookie to restaurant master.

910800.name: Citywars Savage
910800.short_description: Citywars Savage is a fast paced Couch MMO Tower Defense featuring split screen, crafting and classless combat system. Go on adventures to complete quests, level up your gear and fight savage PvE battles with your friends. Establish and decorate your city with your most valuable riches.

1220860.name: Citywars Savage Demo
1220860.short_description: Citywars Savage is a fast paced Couch MMORPG featuring split screen, crafting and classless combat system. Go on adventures to complete quests, level up your gear and fight savage PvE battles with your friends. Establish and decorate your city with your most valuable riches.

4248190.name: Sunborn
4248190.short_description: Start as a tiny spark. Drag cosmic fuel into your star and grow it through every stage of stellar life. Stack 158 upgrades, automate the feeding, and watch your numbers climb from single digits into the billions.

4581260.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Playtest

2127980.name: Project: Orc
2127980.short_description: Enter a brutal open-world survival RPG as an Orc and rise from a lowly warrior to War-Chief. Gather resources, craft gear, build clan strongholds, raid enemies, and conquer a savage tribal world shaped by war, survival, and power.

5337720.name: Mewtations: Dogma Demo
5337720.short_description: Build a cat colony on a cluttered board of cards. Craft, farm and gear up your crew, send them on roguelite expeditions with automatic battles, and stand up to Boss Huohuo's dog mafia, before the next tax note comes due.

5445490.name: She's a Hot Mess
5445490.short_description: Your co-op partner is an AI, and she has opinions. Yell at her to row. She rows... her way. Then blames you. Dodge lava, ice and one very rude sea monster in a fun and chaotic experience where communication is the main obstacle.

5397680.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Space Explorer
5397680.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Space Explorer style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

5187220.name: S T A R E Playtest

5274090.name: 诡地煞星 Demo
5274090.short_description: The ELDRITCH SLAYER Demo is now available! Experience three levels of introductory combat in this retro FPS filled with bloodshed and dark humor!

5397670.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Squishy Bunny
5397670.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Squishy Bunny style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

5103920.name: Fangjie:Shattered Altars Demo
5103920.short_description: Become an adventurer set on restoring order in a shattered voxel world. This demo covers the opening hours: procedural exploration, class and skill trees, action combat, up to a boss fight against the Stone Guardian.

5397660.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Flower Garden Fairy
5397660.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Flower Garden Fairy style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

383190.name: SUMICO - The Numbers Game
383190.short_description: Sumico is a very original number puzzle game. It challenges you with fun but deep gameplay. The game features 84 handmade levels and an Endless Mode which you can style to your liking. Enjoy!

5006850.name: MECCHA HORROR
5006850.short_description: Two games in one! Relax and paint your way through a colorful roguelite, or battle your “friends” in PvP. █A█R█G█ Descend into a co-op horror roguelite where painting means survival. Paint to hide! Run to survive! Uncover the truth!

4862000.name: COLONY 2
4862000.short_description: Giri's search for his lost cricket ball opened a world of horror. He escaped that day but part of him never left. Eight years later, investigate the British colonial era asylum that broke him. But why does he keep coming back? What's his connection? Discover what's never meant to be discovered.

3265900.name: Electronics Repair Shop
3265900.short_description: Open your own electronics repair shop! Take devices apart, diagnose faults, and replace broken components. Buy and sell used electronics, invest your earnings in new equipment, and grow your small shop.

5397650.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Ice Kingdom
5397650.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Ice Kingdom style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

5397640.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Bubble Pop Star
5397640.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Bubble Pop Star style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

4776100.name: Dust Front RTS Demo
4776100.short_description: Dust Front is a classic RTS with 4X/grand strategy elements. In this demo, you will try out the RTS side: lead a triumphant siege of an industrial city. Command strike groups and crush one of two enemy factions.

5397630.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Dreamland Pajamas
5397630.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Dreamland Pajamas style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

4720170.name: Panspermia - El eco de los antiguos
4720170.short_description: A narrative adventure where your words matter. Explore, decide, and uncover the secrets of the Panspermia universe in an experience inspired by classic text parser adventures.

5264830.name: Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan
5264830.short_description: Run a fledgling automaker in a volatile fictional economy. Set prices, manage investment, outmaneuver rivals, react to crises, and live with the consequences as your business decisions reshape a branching story.

4744620.name: BUNSIK
4744620.short_description: BUNSIK is a first-person psychological horror game about working the night shift at a Korean snack bar. Take orders, cook food, clean the shop, and make your way through an old neighborhood to your rooftop home. With each passing day, the familiar routine becomes increasingly unsettling.

3602270.name: Whisk
3602270.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

4984210.name: ASCII Dungeon Crawl
4984210.short_description: A party-based roguelite dungeon crawler drawn in ASCII. Turn-based combat, permadeath, and over a hundred passives to unlock across runs. Push through two full dungeons with your own party of heroes. Every run ends. Every unlock stays.

4778470.name: BUNSIK Demo
4778470.short_description: Experience the opening of BUNSIK in this first-person psychological horror demo. Take orders, cook food, clean the Korean snack bar, then walk through an old neighborhood to your rooftop home. An ordinary night shift gradually becomes unsettling.

5397620.name: Pop! Jelly PangPang - Undersea Fairy
5397620.short_description: 6 themed cosmetics to dress up your jelly in the Undersea Fairy style. One-time purchase, no random items. Requires Pop! Jelly PangPang.

4765730.name: Golf-Like Demo
4765730.short_description: Free demo of a golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves.

5169100.name: Xenon Protocol
5169100.short_description: Xenon Protocol is an online co-op roguelite card game (2-6 players) based on synchronization and trust. Travel to real-world nuclear sites, coordinate card plays through a decaying temporal signal, defeat bosses and try to undo an apocalypse. Without saying a word.

4217360.name: Magic Fruit World
4217360.short_description: Magic Fruit World is an intense platforming adventure combining deep exploration and tactical combat. Master the power of Magic Fruits to face relentless enemies, uncover secrets in expansive worlds, and perfect your skills in levels built for high replayability.

5212170.name: 代理人 Demo
5212170.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

4716640.name: Rejoin
4716640.short_description: The Night Parade has come to your museum! In this cozy, narrative organizing game, sort and reassemble centuries-old Japanese folding screens, cleanse traces left by visiting spirits, guide the parade through the galleries, and acquire tools and upgrades for the next night's festivities.

3654630.name: Dragon Riddler Demo
3654630.short_description: This is not a word game. It’s a heroic fantasy adventure powered by dynamic word‑based systems that blend the adventurer’s abilities with the player’s skill.

3871520.name: Vega Chronicle Demo
3871520.short_description: Lead your civilization to galactic glory in this bite-sized 4X strategy game. Build, colonize, trade, and, by tact or might, overcome all who oppose you.

5098990.name: HOMUNCAT Demo
5098990.short_description: HomunCat: and the Blind Mansion is a co-op horror game where you play as plush cats and try to escape a mysterious mansion. Shout voice commands like “MEOW!” and “KICK!” to play, but beware of monsters that react to sound. Collect mana and work together to escape!

4353180.name: Quantris
4353180.short_description: A falling-block puzzle game with real quantum mechanics. Put pieces in superposition, entangle them across your tower, then observe and watch them collapse. Play solo, against a bot, with a friend on the couch, or online.

4804280.name: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
4804280.short_description: A fantasy card game where a deck-building roguelike meets a TCG. Draft a deck, explore branching dungeon maps, collect relics and defeat hero bosses, or build your collection and duel with a 30-card deck.

3058500.name: Cucumber
3058500.short_description: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.

3292300.name: Golf-Like
3292300.short_description: A golf roguelike where the ball never stops. Tee off onto a road over the sea that sinks behind you, steer through the air, shoot down the spiked escorts hunting you and face the Kraken. Pick your route through portals, sports arenas and hidden caves. New road, new deck, every run.

5009390.name: BOB LOGISTICS
5009390.short_description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.

4864900.name: Dyson Sphere: Desktop Factory
4864900.short_description:
Automated Production Lines + Roguelike Modifiers + Tower Defense Combat + Desktop Wallpaper
Ignite your base on Tpler and forge your Dyson Sphere industrial wonder. Build automated desktop lines, deploy drone logistics, launch units to orbit. Draw tech perks for your build and boost output.

4595980.name: Ship or Burn! Сoop express
4595980.short_description:
Someone's order is on fire? At least the train keeps going!
Load up the parcels, toss everything into the furnace, and off we go!
Zombie consumers after your cargo? Into the furnace!
Online co-op for 1–4 players about delivery, chaos and greed.

5411180.name: Sort Memes Together Demo
5411180.short_description: A meme store has exploded! Grab, stack and throw 80 meme products with up to 3 friends in online co-op, sort every cat loaf, stonks bust and pet rock onto the right shelf, and turn total brainrot chaos into the tidiest meme shop on the internet.

3929800.name: Valdrin
3929800.short_description: A low-fantasy kingdom sim where you never command a single subject. Shape laws, set priorities, and watch an autonomous society build, trade, worship, and fight under your rule.

4111300.name: MegaGum
4111300.short_description: Play as Uja, an orphan searching for answers in this 3D action adventure platformer. Harness the properties of Gum to stick to walls, inflate, and make your way through the MegaGum factory. Face Mister Gum and his mysterious creations to uncover the secrets hidden behind its colorful facade.

4953430.name: Sudokuma
4953430.short_description: Control Kuma, a little panda who has just moved into a new home and must solve Sudoku puzzles to unlock various items and decorate his place however he likes!

5009950.name: 十三州·汉刃
5009950.short_description: Build a Three Kingdoms deck in this turn-based strategy card game. Battle AI, invite friends or find opponents through room matchmaking. Share the field and Strategy Points in 2v2, adapt to the seasons, and collect cards, cosmetics and stories of allies fighting side by side.

5064170.name: Go Next!
5064170.short_description: Your weapons fire on their own. Your job is to keep moving. Wall-run, dash and bunny-hop through hordes of monsters across 10 worlds, and turn 46 weapons and 111 items into an unstoppable build. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

5005160.name: Risewards
5005160.short_description: Solve tons of puzzles using logic, physics and (why not) by tricking the game itself. Sometimes the solution may be obvious to you, other times you'll need to think outside the box to progress, or maybe hack your own way to skip a puzzle. Just don't fall into the void... unless you should? ;)

5029660.name: Swordeye Demo
5029660.short_description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons. Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks. Master your sword or die trying. The demo includes 2 of the 4 Tower Dungeons and a large open world.

4675280.name: SELF//FORK
4675280.short_description:
A physics-driven cyberpunk incremental. Fork yourself into data packets,
bounce through a hostile mainframe's defense matrix, and reunite the
fragments to break free.

3676680.name: Temple of Glyphs
3676680.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only pure logic. Decipher an ancient language of enigmatic glyphs, fulfill unspoken rules, and watch your solutions reshape the temple around you.

4460460.name: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons-
4460460.short_description:
An escape room adventure set in a handcrafted miniature world.
Can you find your way back home?

1015370.name: eXpanSIM
1015370.short_description: eXpanSIM is a universal vehicle simulator supporting VR. It offers realistic physics simulation of cars, trucks, forklifts, excavators, and military vehicles. Improve your (eco-)driving skills in a city, on a track, or off the road.

5340420.name: Next Station is... Demo
5340420.short_description: You operate the final subway train of the night. Inspect each platform, watch the passengers, and decide whether to open the doors or leave the station behind. Make the wrong choice, and something may board with them.

5045040.name: Traymon World: Taskbar Monster RPG
5045040.short_description: The smallest monster idle RPG, right on your taskbar. Collect and manage monsters, each with unique skills and personality. Exploration runs on its own, so don't stop until you've assembled the ultimate party!

4398170.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16 Demo
4398170.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

3010270.name: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate – Deathwatch
3010270.short_description: Command the Imperium’s most elite alien-hunters in a brutal, turn-based tactical RPG. As an Inquisitor of the Deathwatch, every squad you build and every decision you make shapes the fate of a sector under siege from Genestealer Hivecults, Orks, T’au, and the forces of Chaos.

5369680.name: Eruin Demo
5369680.short_description: Wake without a name in a town stripped of its memories. In this demo of Eruin, speak naturally with its inhabitants, talk your way past a guarded gate, and face a witch’s riddles. Your words can open doors.

3587380.name: KAISERPUNK - Supporter Pack
3587380.short_description: Support Kaiserpunk and enhance your experience with a variety of exclusive visual additions! This DLC offers a collection of unique cosmetic enhancements that personalize your game without altering gameplay.

3615340.name: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
3615340.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

4107960.name: .curator
4107960.short_description: In a world imagined by acclaimed SF writer Richard K. Morgan, you are The .Curator. Use C.R.I.S.S.I. to glimpse the future — and rewrite it! In this episode-based detective adventure, choose your path, decide who lives or dies, and turn enemies into stepping stones toward saving the world.

5415230.name: Magical Girl Demo
5415230.short_description: Try a pixel-art magical-girl action adventure. Experience the opening chapter, three fighting styles and four combat areas. Between battles, attend school, talk with classmates and join activities. Choose how to spend each day in the city.

5070940.name: Dice Tiny Town Demo
5070940.short_description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

4429710.name: Spellogger
4429710.short_description:
A slow-paced, cozy fantasy RPG where you play as a Wizard Lumberjack.

Take on daily tasks and upgrade your character in a relaxing work cycle similar to Stardew Valley, while setting out on Elder Scrolls-style quests and exploration.

3563400.name: Hell Clock Demo
3563400.short_description: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

3424800.name: Code of Shadows
3424800.short_description: Code of Shadows is a fast-paced roguelite where you don't just deploy drones, you command them. Switch modes mid-fight, fuse drones into stronger ones, and cut through rift-spawned hordes across collapsing dimensions.

5183430.name: Artifact Tracer
5183430.short_description: Every artifact is a mystery left by history. Artifact Tracer is a visual deduction game about Chinese artifacts. Study shapes, patterns, and craftsmanship, trace their origins on a map and timeline, challenge 1,000+ real artifacts, unlock archives, and compete in daily rankings.

4851080.name: STATO
4851080.short_description: Shape a nation in a procedural grand strategy sandbox where geography, industry, diplomacy, and war drive emergent history. Build your state, secure resources, manage instability, and survive a world of rival powers.

4424680.name: Colonus
4424680.short_description: A medieval village-building game about shaping a charming settlement, cultivating the land, and watching a small community flourish.

5244350.name: Brewhaven
5244350.short_description: Brew magic combat beers that power up your village. Discover hundreds of recipes, run the tavern each night to keep your villagers juiced and happy, then have them work in the village and defend the town from enemy raids, if they can still walk.

4057270.name: Truck Simulator 2026 : USA
4057270.short_description: Step into the driver’s seat in Truck Simulator 2026: USA! 🚚 Haul cargo across iconic American highways, drive trucks, customize your rig, and build your own transport empire from coast to coast! 🌎

5065070.name: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done? Demo
5065070.short_description:
One ball. One slot machine. Seven elements. Build your chaos.
Fire the core ball, break elemental orbs, and fill the reels. Hit the right lines, push your score—before time's up.
With 40+ relics and 40+ skills to combine, your way. Just remember—the more you risk, the wilder the spin.

4911950.name: Pinballoid Crush
4911950.short_description: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

3106270.name: HELLCARD II
3106270.short_description: Hellcard II is a unique co-op deck-builder roguelike game. Descend into the paper dungeons on your own or invite friends to fast-paced tactical card battles against hordes of evil and dragons. Lots of dragons!

4575950.name: PAPER STRIKE Demo
4575950.short_description: Discover Arin in this solo demo of Paper Strike. Face waves of enemies, draw runes with your mouse to cast spells and find the right moment to finish your drawing. The full 3v3 party arena game is in development.

4511720.name: The Incentive Program Demo
4511720.short_description: A dopamine-fuelled match-3 roguelite. Rig the odds, exploit the system, and unleash impossible combos to escape a surreal corporate nightmare.

5385620.name: The Beaten Track
5385620.short_description: Off-road across an endless, procedurally generated land in an old 4x4. No roads and no markers: just meadows, forests, deserts, jungles, snow and sea. Find hidden campsites, name them and claim them, in one shared world where every tire leaves a mark and many drivers make a track.

4322380.name: IthielAI
4322380.short_description: IthielAI is a private, local-first AI workspace that runs on your own hardware. Chat with local AI, manage projects, organize memory and knowledge, and keep your data on your machine. No cloud dependency. No subscription required. Optional AI core loader .

2090210.name: Threads of Time
2090210.short_description: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

5217470.name: Archival Security
5217470.short_description: A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the projected slides, word for word. Follow the rules. Do not respond if the text asks you a question. ACCURACY IS OUR HIGHEST PRIORITY.

4801820.name: Anomaly Sector Demo
4801820.short_description: Anomaly Sector is a psychological observation game set in eerie PoolRooms. Carefully inspect each room and decide whether an anomaly is present. If you find one, turn back. If everything looks normal, move forward. Every decision matters.

4996220.name: Dunjin
4996220.short_description:
Dunjin is a roguelike dungeon-crawling deckbuilder where poker hands fuel your attacks and a d20 decides your fate. 

Discover unique heroes, endless runs, and 150+ game-warping relics on your journey to the bottom.

2708040.name: Keelblade
2708040.short_description: Sail across a fantasy world in your own pirate ship. Master souls-like combat and powerful magic to hunt deadly bosses. Discover new islands and loot them for hidden treasures to craft upgrades for both you and your ship. (1-6 Players)

5226430.name: Wyrdtide
5226430.short_description: Wyrdtide is a viking CO-OP & singleplayer survival roguelite where you don't wade into the horde, you sail your longship straight into it.
