There's no hero to level and no dodging on foot only a hull, a crew at their posts, and a raid that grows hungrier the longer you last.

5232430.name: Things Left Unsaid Demo
5232430.short_description: A free vertical slice of Things Left Unsaid. Spend three quiet days restoring five antiques with all five hand tools, then haggle with collectors at the counter — including two rounds of the Showdown Gathering — a taste of the full ritual, with the rest of the story still locked away.

4991230.name: Steel Maiden Demo
4991230.short_description: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous, fluid visuals.

2265230.name: Yet Another Zombie Survivors Demo
2265230.short_description: The Horde is coming but you're ready to fight it! Assemble your team and decide upon their enhancements to find the most efficient synergies against thousands of the undead. Survive. Then evolve. Then break all the limits in this deceivingly simple but addictive reverse bullet hell.

3605510.name: No Prospects
3605510.short_description: Build railways deep into monster-infested caves in this online co-op horror game. Work together to mine valuable ore, fill your minecart, and upgrade your equipment as you venture into increasingly dangerous depths.

5345040.name: Stick A Fork
5345040.short_description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, make jam, Ascend and Transcend, and watch the table get wilder every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

5428280.name: Beards & Blades
5428280.short_description: Run a dwarven smithy at the mouth of a dungeon. Heat, hammer, quench and sharpen gear by hand for the frog knights, boar barbarians and other odd heroes heading below, then wait at the counter to see who comes back. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 smiths.

4960750.name: Things Left Unsaid
4960750.short_description: A cozy ASMR antique restoration shop sim. Clean dust and rust, mend cracks with gold lacquer, and reassemble broken treasures across five hand-crafted tools. Then haggle with quirky collectors at your counter — every restored heirloom holds a story left unsaid.

5213690.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria Playtest

5354440.name: Swaplines
5354440.short_description: A simple, easy puzzle game: gather each color of ball onto its matching LINE. The more you play, the more the tricks click. Endless, randomly generated puzzles, and a cute little town in the background that grows with every puzzle you solve.

1246800.name: Small Fry
1246800.short_description: Cook any meal you can imagine! Invent your own recipes, respond to your customer’s tastes, discover the intricacies of your ingredients, and get into the flow of cooking without missing an order. Unlock new ingredients, flavors, and kitchen gadgets to cook up even more perfect culinary creations.

5079160.name: Remedy of Balance Demo
5079160.short_description: A farming sim with a potion-crafting twist. Craft and treat patients in Palmia. Climb the ranks to become Guildmaster of the Alchemist Guild. Along with other activities like farming, animal handling, building relationships, and more.

2303272.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - Magicians DLC
2303272.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to the Magicians!

4531450.name: MISSING PLAY - Missing Texture
4531450.short_description: Asymmetric multiplayer game in which players must complete objectives and escape whilst another player chases them and tries to eliminate them.

4922860.name: PingPongDart
4922860.short_description: PingPongDart is a Game between PingPong and Dart.  Hit the rotating Dartboard using a navigator for precise hits from any 3D space. Play alone or with friends or family up to 4 players.  It is particularly well-suited for teens, as the game is based on physics rather than shootouts and explosions.

4928080.name: Seikyu Let’s Go!
4928080.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op campervan trip through the yokai-filled wilderness. Snap photos of elusive creatures, decorate your van together, and help the locals you meet along the way. Camp, cook, and clamber across diverse biomes, from misty swamps to snowy mountains. Adventure awaits, so Let’s Go!

4413450.name: Sheriff Park Ranger
4413450.short_description: Patrol a vast national park as a ranger. Drive your truck, stop offenders, respond to fires and accidents, rescue wildlife, and enforce the law in an open-world wilderness with dynamic weather and day-night cycles.

3613300.name: Rymdval
3613300.short_description: Haul Cargo in Space! Manage placement of modules and make builds for fighting pirates. Explore and finish missions to uncover the secrets and mysteries of this universe.

4682930.name: Draftula Demo
4682930.short_description: Build up your castle in this roguelike twist on the block-dropping puzzler! Place your rooms strategically to reach greater heights. Will you be able to build a fortress to stand the test of time, or will that pesky hero send your work crumbling to the ground?

5246170.name: Sherlock Mysteries: Victorian Investigations
5246170.short_description: Book-style murder investigation game set in Victorian London. Logic, Deduction and Attention to Details - use this to solve game mysteries. Unfold story chapters, investigate clues, visit London historical locations - and help to get murder into jail.

3175550.name: Idle Archery
3175550.short_description: In Idle Archery, destroy targets to earn money, hire archers and stack upgrades to multiply your income.

5302070.name: MiniHero: Wonderbound
5302070.short_description: A whimsical pixel‑fantasy card adventure. Every step holds hidden risk — make your choices between opportunity and peril.

4676820.name: Trigger Range
4676820.short_description:
A fast-paced, competitive shooting range game where speed and precision are everything.
It's like Track Mania with guns.

5110300.name: リサイクルショップ回向
5110300.short_description:
3-Match Puzzle × Human Observation × Horror Novel

Recycle Shop ECO is a binary art style 3-match puzzle and horror novel game.

Fulfill customers' requests, gather information about them, and explore a hidden world of horror.

5064860.name: Rescue Ops Demo
5064860.short_description: Become a wildland firefighter and battle raging wildfires around the world. Play solo or in co-op to rescue civilians, operate specialized vehicles, and outsmart fast-spreading, dynamic fires.

4999960.name: IRREVERENCE
4999960.short_description: IRREVERENCE is a fast paced top down shooter. Run, shoot, and dive into intense combat with a variety of strange foes in this quirky hotline miami like.

5111970.name: Skeleton Crew: Castle Heist
5111970.short_description: Skeleton Crew: Castle Heist is a 1–4 player co-op game where small skeletons raid dangerous medieval castles, complete objectives, avoid guards, lose limbs, interact with physics-based objects, and work together to escape. 💀🏰

2987600.name: What Goes Up
2987600.short_description: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out

3274530.name: Epitome
3274530.short_description:
Welcome to the system of Epitome. Explore a world woven from the threads of reality.
Here, us, the Archons, my creations, rule over their unique realms, shaping and disorting them according to their desires.
This is no mere adventure - enter Epitome and strive to become an Archon.

4993180.name: Idle Archery Demo
4993180.short_description: In Idle Archery, destroy targets to earn money, hire archers and stack upgrades to multiply your income.

4457360.name: Escape the Backrooms Bodycam
4457360.short_description: Face pure fear inside the endless backrooms. Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM throws you into a hyper-realistic bodycam horror experience where every step, shot, and shadow could mean death.

5065900.name: Train Trek Demo
5065900.short_description: Tower defense on rails. Wake the last war-train in a steampunk world that needs you: build your armored consist car by car, bristle it with turrets, and harvest fuel on the move as you hold the line across a vibrant frontier. Capture towns, upgrade your train, and follow a lone survivor onward.

4830760.name: Escape the Backrooms Bodycam Demo
4830760.short_description: Face pure fear inside the endless backrooms. Escape the Backrooms BODYCAM Demo throws you into a hyper-realistic bodycam horror experience where every step, shot, and shadow could mean death in this Demo.

4694760.name: Legendum Demo
4694760.short_description: Start as a nobody and become a legend before old age claims you in this incremental RPG. Fight hordes in idle combat, plan your days, and train your skills. Grow your soul and unravel a dark plot across generations. Every life reshapes the world, and one will finish what the rest began.

5359340.name: Knockstep
5359340.short_description: Knock on anything! A cozy little rhythm game where you knock real stuff around you—mugs, desks, even your belly. Your mic listens to every beat while the town animals get to work. Drop in your own songs and they become brand-new stages.

5225980.name: Fish It Out
5225980.short_description:
Fish It Out is a relaxing first-person tidy-up, collecting and sorting game: 
Vacuum up loose fish, match each species and pattern to its tank, and restore a flooded aquarium. 
Explore a multi-level facility, earn upgrade points, and unlock new efficient ways to collect and sort

5366180.name: Endless Survival World
5366180.short_description: Survive a massive 20,000 × 20,000 tile world on a live online server. Gather, craft and upgrade your base from a shabby cabin to a fortress, tame and ride wild beasts, and fight monsters, the elements and other players. Nobody is safe.

4797230.name: Blood & Chaos Demo
4797230.short_description: Experience the first act of Blood & Chaos, a party-based roguelike RPG inspired by classic ’80s RPGs. Build your fellowship, explore Greyhaven, uncover quests and descend into your first deadly dungeon.

5461240.name: Reticle Range
5461240.short_description: Reticle Range is an offline aim trainer with six modes for practicing accuracy, tracking, target switching, and reaction speed. Build training routines, review your results, and track your progress over time. Warm up before playing or focus on beating your personal best.

5221770.name: Dino Dome: Tidy Up!
5221770.short_description: Dino Dome: Tidy Up! is a cozy first-person organization game about restoring a giant indoor toy dome. Pick up thousands of colorful dinosaurs, match each one to its proper cupboard, and turn a wonderfully messy floor into a calm, complete collection.

4942660.name: The Proxy
4942660.short_description: The Proxy is a narrative political simulation game set in a fictional nation, Leviah. The president is dead, and the office is yours. Sign papers that decide the fate of your nation, trade on secrets only you know, and juggle the ones who all want something. Protect the country, or protect yourself?

5360610.name: MOVETOON
5360610.short_description: Move farther or paint more nearby? MOVETOON is a turn-based territory game where longer moves leave less room for ink. Repaint rival territory and explore unpainted squares across 7 maps with 20 characters. Play against the CPU, locally, or online through Steam.

2255310.name: Px2d
2255310.short_description: [px2d] is an editor that specializes in making 2d pixel character animation. Currently, you can generate up to 4-direction roles. Support user-defined action templates. User defined material import is supported.

5352620.name: SPLACHESS
5352620.short_description: Every chess move paints the board. SplaChess combines chess with ink-based territory control: win by checkmate or claim more squares when the board is fully painted. Choose from 20 characters and play against the CPU, locally with a friend, or online through Steam.

3321740.name: Echo Seekers
3321740.short_description: Echo Seekers is a ruthless turn-based dungeon crawler where every decision counts. Master layers of tactics, learn your enemies, and find combinations strong enough to break the odds. But you’re not alone - other Seekers are fighting their way to the top. Can you outsmart them?

4392360.name: Cloud Harvester
4392360.short_description:
Restore the ancient network.
Harvest valuable crystals, collect loot, upgrade your ship
and explore a mysterious world of floating islands.
A handcrafted indie game by a solo developer

4656740.name: Real Car Market Simulator Together Demo

5294600.name: 将棋トゥーン
5294600.short_description: Checkmate the king or paint your way to victory! SHOGITOON combines shogi with a colorful battle for territory. Face 20 CPU characters with distinct play styles, or challenge a friend locally or online. In-game text is available in Japanese only.

5318970.name: Brain Bomb - Prologue
5318970.short_description: Concepts are bombs. Association is death. An cult-like anti-utopian psychological horror puzzle game. The subject has a concept bomb implanted in brain. If a subject thinks of the [Fuse Word], their head detonates. You, as the "cognitive bomb defuser", dismantling the deadly "brain bomb".

4656730.name: Real Car Market Simulator Together
4656730.short_description: Start from nothing and build your own car trading empire in Real Car Market Simulator Together. Buy, inspect, negotiate, repair, and sell vehicles solo or with up to 4 players. Every deal is a risk, and only smart teamwork leads to profit.

4348350.name: Drive With Friends Demo
4348350.short_description: Friendslop Drive is a chaotic co‑op driving game where one car is shared by multiple players. As one of the top friendslop games, teamwork and rivalry collide on a mysterious island. Can your crew reach the PEAK of madness and escape together? Only the best bros survive the ride!

5264930.name: 归墟行：人界篇
5264930.short_description: An ink-wash, single-player xianxia RPG. You spend years in seclusion seeking a clear Dao heart, while old friends break through or pass away. Pick your techniques, build your own style and fight hands-on from Qi Refining to Spirit Transformation. Join a sect, find a Dao companion, settle old debts.

4133320.name: Spaceborn Awakening Demo
4133320.short_description: Spaceborn: Awakening is a narrative-driven roguelite bullet-heaven where you step into the role of a legendary space crew, answering a mysterious distress signal. Eliminate hordes of the Voss Praetor’s corrupted army, awaken your true potential, become a Spaceborn - decide the fate of the universe.

5315090.name: Portal way Demo
5315090.short_description: Portal way is a spatial puzzle about finding a path through portals.

3967230.name: Alchemortis
3967230.short_description:
Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies.
Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

3574570.name: Roots Of Ruin
3574570.short_description: Build your defenses, fight beside them, and reclaim your kingdom from the corruption. Expand your land, command powerful towers, and take direct control of one of four unique heroes to defend against relentless enemy waves and devastating bosses.

4941160.name: A Sector Darkly
4941160.short_description: Experience an epic story in this open-world space exploration rpg. Stranded far from home in a region torn apart by war, you must scavenge, research, and craft what you need to survive as you chart a course through dangerous sectors, uncover rival alien agendas, and search for a way home.

4974580.name: Alchemortis Demo
4974580.short_description:
Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies.
Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

4413420.name: SHIP SIMULATOR OCEAN FISHING
4413420.short_description: Start with an old boat and build your fishing empire. Catch fish and rare seafood, trade at dynamic ports, upgrade your fleet, and survive realistic weather, fuel management, and true-to-life ship handling ⚓

4348060.name: Drive With Friends
4348060.short_description: One car. Too many drivers. Drive With Friends is a chaotic online co-op driving game for 1-4 players: split one car's controls - gas, brake, left, right - and try to reach the summit past saws, hammers, mines and each other.

4833960.name: The Ninth Cycle
4833960.short_description: This is an incredibly smooth 3D roguelike. If you're looking for fast-paced, satisfying roguelike gameplay, this game is well worth a try.

1872800.name: EVE Vanguard
1872800.short_description: EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set on the ruthless planets of New Eden. Raid crash sites, assault forward bases and seize exotic tech before colossal Nemesis Drones hunt you down. Every mission is a race against time. Every extraction shapes a larger war. This is only the beginning.

4249010.name: Know Your Anima
4249010.short_description: A cozy farming sim with a mystical, introspective soul. Tend your inner garden over a 12-day cycle, make choices and bond with the spirit animals who visit you. Everything you do, and everything you don't, reveals your personality through your dominant Ánimas. Do you dare to know yourself?

4635090.name: Titanic Survival Simulator Demo
4635090.short_description: Survive the final hours of the Titanic Survival Simulator Demo. Escape the sinking ship, navigate flooding corridors, manage cold and stamina, and make life-or-death choices as you race for a place on the last lifeboats in this Demo.

5412710.name: Tetria's Tower
5412710.short_description: Explore a strange, unsettling tower in this unique 3D narrative puzzle game. Solve the mysteries by finding the many hidden keys and discover new friends and even more puzzles along the way. Who is the witch who lives here? And why has she dragged you to her ever changing tower?

4729770.name: KASHTA
4729770.short_description: Join your friends on an unforgettable kashta adventure filled with challenges and mystery. Explore deserts, forests, and dangerous roads, face wildlife and unexpected events, and work together to survive and uncover hidden secrets along the journey.

4529950.name: Titanic Survival Simulator
4529950.short_description: Survive the final hours of the Titanic Survival Simulator. Escape the sinking ship, navigate flooding corridors, manage cold and stamina, and make life-or-death choices as you race for a place on the last lifeboats.

5257360.name: 沙雕赌神 Demo
5257360.short_description: In this post-apocalyptic survival challenge, your goal is to earn money on a slot machine to stay alive and rescue more refugees. Every winning streak lets you save one extra refugee. While scavenging for supplies, beware of the mutant zombies lurking in the city.

5071520.name: Xenobiome Command
5071520.short_description: Build a colony on a fungal alien world and keep it alive. Explore the fog, expand across the map, exploit the land, and exterminate the alien packs before they reach your people. Xenobiome Command goes hard - from planetfall to last stand.

5336600.name: Repair Guru
5336600.short_description: A 1970s electronics repair shop, genuinely simulated. Nothing is scripted — every fault is a real component misbehaving, and the only way to find it is to switch the machine on, let it warm through, and measure. Halve the chain, then halve what is left. Fix it, hand it back, hope it stays fixed.

5065020.name: Co-op Chaos in Berlin Demo
5065020.short_description: 4-player co-op bullet-heaven Survivor-like set in robot-overrun Berlin: auto-fire ridiculous weapons and choice-of-3 your way to broken builds. Solo works. Friends recommended.

1167820.name: Airport Contraband
1167820.short_description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

5332150.name: Of Dice and Minions Demo
5332150.short_description: Roll five dice and turn them into an army. Hold, reroll, chase a poker hand, then watch your minions fight on their own. Free demo: the tutorial and the first 20 dungeon floors, two bosses included.

5354030.name: Worst Class Ever Demo
5354030.short_description: This is a fun 1-6 player asymmetric party game! Five player are mischievous troublemakers，hide among dozens of NPC students to sneak snacks, pass secret notes, and use phones secretly in class. One player acts as a strict teacher, track down all hidden troublemakers in the crowd.

5363350.name: Mortuus Demo
5363350.short_description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

5401090.name: just volleyball Demo
5401090.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in this limited time demo in 2v2s, 4v4s, and 6v6!

5402280.name: Wipe Them Out! Demo
5402280.short_description: Wipe them out is a hand-drawn incremental zombie-blasting game. Shoot zombies, collect scrap, and upgrade your weapons and defenses. Face increasingly powerful horde as you grow stronger with every upgrade. Protect your wall and enjoy the satisfaction of tearing through countless zombies.

5111950.name: Outcast Tales Demo
5111950.short_description: Assemble a squad of characters with robust personalities and abilities, and their relationships unfold. Engage in deep tactical battles, make tough decisions, and choose your own adventures - write an Outcast Tale that’s unique to you!

4698640.name: Resurface Demo
4698640.short_description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore as your strength grows to crazy proportions, but don’t run out of oxygen!

4716990.name: Beyond The Plastic Wall Demo
4716990.short_description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

5018690.name: Warlapse Demo
5018690.short_description: War isn't heroism, it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

5021700.name: Midnight Souls Demo
5021700.short_description: Dive into the secrets of the quiet hamlet of Camomile Peaks! A romantic trip to meet your online crush spirals into a mystical adventure: epic battles, bizarre allies, and dark humor. Win her heart, solve the mysteries, and protect your cat, Charlie!

4412690.name: Street Fighter™ 6 - Year 4 Ultimate Pass
4412690.short_description:
Year 4 Ultimate Pass
- 4 additional characters
- 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10
- 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 2 (including colors 1-10)
- 4 additional characters' costume: Outfit 3 (including colors 1-10)
- Bonus: 5,800 Drive Tickets

4508040.name: 天坑追匪 Demo
4508040.short_description: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on
developers: 杭州天阙采样文化传媒游戏公司

4613270.name: Catch Meow If You Can Demo
4613270.short_description:
An online co-op survival game for up to 4 players.
Play as a famous, award-winning cat. While the owner is away, different types of burglars invade the mansion. Explore dark rooms, solve puzzles, outsmart intruders, fight back, and escape without getting caught.

4621970.name: Loop Dungeon - Incremental
4621970.short_description: A short incremental dungeon RPG with a finite campaign. Unlock heroes, gather resources, upgrade your party, and reset progress for prestige rewards. Heroes fight automatically, but skills and upgrades need your input—not a fully hands-off idle game.

4013190.name: Sani Yang's Laboratory - Secret Plus
4013190.short_description: Expand the narrative with new revelations in Sani Yang’s Laboratory, an additional detail that sheds light on the mysteries.

4042110.name: 隐梦交织 Demo
4042110.short_description: 《Interwoven Dream》 is a Victorian-era visual novel with multiple POVs. In 1884 London, four friends reunite after a string of disappearances, each with their own motives. Together, they dive into the city's darkest secrets, where dreams and reality blur.

4193560.name: Futa Slug EX Demo
4193560.short_description: NSFW roguelike with male/female player character creation, meta-progression, 55 collectible girls, and 9 epic boss battles! Step into the shoes of the Captain and dominate your lustful rivals. Supports all genitalia variations: hermaphrodite, male genitalia only, and female genitalia only.

4240980.name: Machick 2 - Journey East
4240980.short_description: Machick 2: Journey East brings Wuchick's journey through Chinese mythology, facing a wide variety of enemies and bosses. 4 Maps to explore, 4 Bosses and Mini-Bosses, 8 Enemies, 30 Accessories with unique functions, 10 Thematic Chickens with unique passive abilities.

3682840.name: Patient Zero: Plague Idle Demo
3682840.short_description: In the demo version of Patient Zero: Plague Idle, you can start with any of the four pathogen types and evolve it to challenge humanity. Four pathogens, global map, and strategic choices - the epidemic begins here.

3699010.name: Europa Universalis V: Fate of the Phoenix
3699010.short_description: Relive or revive the fading glories of the Eastern Roman Empire in Fate of the Phoenix, an Immersion Pack for Europa Universalis V. This DLC adds new historical flavor and content to the Byzantine Empire, with unique mechanics, historical options and alternative historical paths to pursue.

3725310.name: Rift of the NecroDancer: Everhood - "Powers of Destruction"
3725310.short_description: Try your hand at the official Rhythm Rift for "Powers of Destruction" by Cazok (free song!) This track is part of the Everhood Music Pack.

3805810.name: Last Look along Woodward Boulevard Demo
3805810.short_description: An esotreric horror puzzle adventure, where your thoughts and mood affect the environment around you.

3589670.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Boris Todbringer – Lords of the End Times
3589670.short_description: Command Boris Todbringer, Elector Count of Middenland in Total War: WARHAMMER III. Beloved by the wolf-god Ulric, Boris seeks to defend the Empire from destruction, and slay his nemesis, the Beastlord Khazrak One-Eye.

3593230.name: Prince of Suburbia - Knock Me Up Again!
3593230.short_description: In the "Knock Me Up Again!" DLC, escape to a desert oasis with a harem of BOOBalicious beauties in skimpy outfits, ready to turn your vacation into a lust-filled breeding frenzy. No longer pregnant and hornier than ever before, they have one shameless demand: "Knock Me Up Again!"

3640210.name: Thank You For Your Application Demo
3640210.short_description: Thank you for your application. After 15 rounds of interviews, you do not match our requirements for the position. You are transferred as a Junior Interviewer to review the candidate's resume according to the company's requirements and send appropriate thanks letters.

1872970.name: Food Truck Empire
1872970.short_description: Order up! Food Truck Empire is a management game where you build your own food truck business. Unlock new recipes, automate production, customize your trucks and compete against rival businesses. The world of flavor is yours to conquer!

5170680.name: Federal Cadet Demo
5170680.short_description: Federal Cadet is a single-player police simulation and investigation game. Start as a cadet in Pinewood, patrol the town, question witnesses and suspects, analyze evidence, and rise through the department ranks.

2483700.name: HARMA
2483700.short_description: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

3227860.name: Super Cloud Fight Demo
3227860.short_description: Super Cloud Fight allows you to experience a unique way of aerial combat with customizable planes, special combat maneuvers, and powerup$. This demo lets you battle against AI pilots, while the full game expands the experience with friends and competitors.

1390800.name: Artificial Selection Demo
1390800.short_description: Fourteen supposed criminals are forced to take part in an anti-death game: To avoid the death penalty, they must prove they can get along — even if their own lives are on the line. Discover the motives of the other participants and help them avoid killing each other.

1397381.name: Hunt: Showdown - The Trick Shooter
1397381.short_description: This DLC contains one Hunter, two Weapons, and one Avatar:Carter (Hunter), Bear's Leg (Vandal 73C Bullseye), Carter's Quickshot (Specter 1882 Shorty), Carter (Avatar)

4213930.name: Salty Dogs
4213930.short_description: Salty Dogs is a co-op 2D physics-based action game about a squad of badass dogs who arm up and dive into a corrupted ocean. Blast mutated sea life, haul loot back to your submarine, upgrade it between runs, and fight your way down through the dark toward dreadful Cat-o-Cthulhu.

880470.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2019
880470.short_description: Take on the role of coach of your own team with Pro Basketball Manager 2019. Start your career as head of the team of your choice and lead your players to victory!

4592050.name: Watch and Whisper
4592050.short_description: A microphone-based surveillance game. Monitor a magical ball for paranormal anomalies. Draw precise sigils and whisper incantations to banish them. You must keep the cursed mirror sealed until the ritual is complete to finally defeat the lurking demon!

478960.name: Clickteam Fusion 2.5 Free Edition
478960.short_description: Game and software creation has never been easier or quicker than with Clickteam Fusion 2.5! Discover the tool used by so many multimedia professionals, game creators, and creative people from all walks of life.

3886530.name: Westlanders
3886530.short_description: Survive a wild-west open world alone or with friends. Travel the land with your wagon, build settlements, fend off foes, and weave a powerful economic network across the wilderness. Forge your legacy in the Westlands.

351390.name: Sentinels of the Multiverse - Rook City
351390.short_description: Dark streets, vile sewers, and twisting alleys; all home to the terrible criminals that control this city. Welcome to Rook City, where evil never sleeps. Includes Expatriette, Mr. Fixer, The Chairman, The Matriarch, Plague Rat, Spite, Pike Industrial Complex, and Rook City.

5073290.name: Vlad Voievod Dracula The Crusaders Tomb
5073290.short_description: An NES inspired Classicvania (linear metroidvania) where you play as Vlad Tepes Dracula, the medieval warlord of Wallachia fighting through a Genoese castle to free a warrior held in The Crusaders Tomb. A new entry to the Vlad Voievod Dracula series recruiting a knight playable in Episode 1 Manhunt

3137410.name: Greed Forest Demo
3137410.short_description:
A real-time roguelite tower defense game about extracting the riches of the forest.
Lure creatures to your emitter and mow them down with towers and spells. Build freely, shape your maze, and choose spells that transform how you play.

912000.name: Mike goes on hike
912000.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

5324980.name: RAID VR Demo
5324980.short_description: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 2-player co-op action (4 players planned in full release).

3398010.name: Moonrite
3398010.short_description: A survival crafting game where you craft spirit companions with different materials to fight, work, and survive. Build your spiritual village and explore a beautiful anime-inspired world to defy ancient gods that rule the material and spiritual.

4409550.name: Cards On The Table
4409550.short_description: Climb the ranks at the wizard poker tournament with an enchanted deck of cards where every suit has powers. Put down huge poker hands, create absurd combos, and fuse, repaint and stitch your cards together, as you stack your opponents and prepare to bring down the house!

5432190.name: Web Scaping
5432190.short_description: You are a cursor loose on WikiNet, a living encyclopedia. Crawler bots are hunting you. Click from article to article to reach your target before the swarm indexes you.

5354420.name: Milk Powder Universe
5354420.short_description: Grow powerful enough to destroy planets, stars and galaxies in a single-player sci-fi sandbox. Fight with melee and energy weapons, challenge galaxy-scale nebula golems, and explore a voxel cosmos. Gather, craft and build camps between battles. Traditional Chinese interface.

4973160.name: Dirty Deal
4973160.short_description: A card battle RPG with enchanting heroines 🔥 Rise through the arena, dungeons, and campaign, building your deck and your strength. Then get to know the girls fighting beside you — flirt, talk, and grow closer through real dates!

3551090.name: Charlatan
3551090.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilder, but you don't trust luck, you CHEAT it. Rig a haunted slot machine and snowball numbers into a nice dopamine Jackpot!

4852570.name: Pidgeon Pocket
4852570.short_description: A flock of adorable pigeons. A park full of clueless picnickers. You can see where this is going. Pidgeon Pocket is a kawaii, chill heist incremental: snatch shiny things, upgrade your flock, and watch the loot pile up. Now every pigeon has its own superpower. Steal, upgrade, repeat.

5267290.name: Rulehouse Demo
5267290.short_description: Think you know chess? Want to play a demo? Rulehouse Demo is a pawn chess narrative adventure where every stage rewrites the game. Travel the globe and beyond, master an ever-changing board where new pieces, twisted variants, and cunning opponents keep you guessing from first move to last.

4982130.name: 日本地図 都市パズル Demo
4982130.short_description: A massive geography puzzle with every prefecture, city, ward, town and village in Japan—over 1,700 areas, nearly 1,900 pieces! Learn towns nationwide through Puzzle, Quiz, Study, Silhouette, Mountains & Rivers and Town Fortune mo des. Full controller support, with furigana & read-aloud for all ages.

5285090.name: Ruinhand
5285090.short_description: Turn the room into your weapon in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Ignite oil, chain lightning and shove guards into mines. Climb ten Ruin levels per hero, race the world on the Daily Ruin, command two heroes as a Duo, or bring a friend in co-op.

4943380.name: Dead Pulse
4943380.short_description: Dead Pulse is an atmospheric, adrenaline-fueled zombie survival FPS set in a red-tinted post-apocalyptic wasteland. Face endless waves of the undead, unlock powerful weapons and roguelite skills, and fight to survive the crimson night in a dark, gritty world.

2194380.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - MMA DLC
2194380.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to the MMA Fighters!

3389360.name: Haphazard Angel Demo
3389360.short_description: Grab a wing and join the chaos! In this co-op multiplayer madness, each player controls an Angel's wing. Collect orbs, outsmart your friends, and keep the balance—or don't. Who needs teamwork when you’ve got wings and questionable decisions?

5400450.name: Tornado Rampage
5400450.short_description: Tornado Rampage is a disaster game where you pilot a tornado, flatten buildings, launch livestock, chase civilians, and get the highest possible score. Collect bonuses, grow your storm, and steer clear of the enemy tornadoes that can bring your run to an end.

4578680.name: 红色史诗：抗战
4578680.short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

4970310.name: Tides of Empires
4970310.short_description: Two empires, one sea. Tides of Empires is the tower defense roguelite game you can finally play competitively. Command warships, aircraft and submarines in ranked 1v1 & 2v2 duels with real MMR matchmaking, in a challenging campaign and endless Survival. Rule the tides.

5188650.name: The Utsuro Hotel
5188650.short_description: A retro first-person horror roguelite where the building decides where you go. Twelve doors, twelve floors, and no door says where it leads until the lock turns behind you. Find the key or gamble on the elevator. Reach the roof. You cannot fight anything here. You can only be somewhere else.

4881100.name: GLADIATOR: The Rising Tide of Glory Playtest

4861070.name: Sweep Protocol
4861070.short_description: Operate a remote military radar station while struggling to keep your family alive as an escalating invasion pushes your nation to the brink. Track incoming threats and manage scarce resources while balancing the needs of your loved ones. Every sweep matters. Every decision counts.

3031890.name: Acts of Blood
3031890.short_description: Master the art of hand-to-hand combat in Acts of Blood, a gritty and fast-paced third-person brawler with brutal combo chains and blood-soaked revenge.

3469910.name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
3469910.short_description: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

4349650.name: WREKD
4349650.short_description: WREKD is a chaotic multiplayer bumper car party game where you smash, boost, and launch your friends across wild modes like Deathmatch, Racing, and Car Football. Easy to play, hard to survive.

3331850.name: Brush duel
3331850.short_description: Real-time 1v1 art battles: two players get the same painting and five minutes to recreate it, and the game decides whose work is closer to the original. Masterpieces and memes, duels with friends and solo practice.

5384870.name: 诸神阵法
5384870.short_description:
Build a team of three mythic heroes in an inventory-management auto-battler. 
Arrange weapons and beasts, craft powerful gear, and combine elemental and adjacency effects. 
Refine your formation between rounds and face saved player teams in asynchronous battles.

3716120.name: Truth Beneath the Shadows
3716120.short_description: Truth Beneath the Shadows – A detective game where players unravel hidden mysteries by connecting clues to expose a secret organization. Every piece of evidence brings you closer to the dark truth lurking in the shadows.

4199050.name: Slop Simulator
4199050.short_description: Collect trash, turn it into slop and serve it to customers! A chaotic multiplayer "fast food" "simulator" with barely any safeguards where you use only "local and fresh" ingredients. Made without generative AI!

5300980.name: Webbound
5300980.short_description: Dive into a minimalist incremental game where you weave luminous webs with tactile string-vibration mechanics. Spare glowing fireflies to enhance your silk, close geometric regions for high-scoring chains, and evolve your modular spider across successive tiers into an apex predator.

5300790.name: Tabletop TD Demo
5300790.short_description: A random tower defense around a tavern table, where everyone guards their own board. Draw towers with gold, from Spearman to Railgun, and set them by hand beside the rail. Merge three of a kind to grow stronger; it never fails. One lucky draw can turn the board around. Hold out solo or with friends.

4535750.name: Dragon Eggs: Survivors
4535750.short_description: Bullets that spawn more bullets! Collect dragons to fight with you. Level up and merge them. Create unique builds to survive hordes of enemies in this 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game!

5075560.name: Crease
5075560.short_description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

4625180.name: Space Gnomes
4625180.short_description: Space Gnomes is a wacky multiplayer co-op game where a team of space gnomes is trying to escape an invading empire of space-faring garden moles focused on enslaving the known universe.

5021950.name: 2 Etoiles sont nées Demo
5021950.short_description: Discover the demo of 2 Étoiles sont nées : explore three levels shaped by emotions, either solo or in local co-op. Solve puzzles, battle strange machines, and reverse gravity. Add the game to your wishlist to follow its development.

5321800.name: Blockade Run
5321800.short_description: A single player side scrolling arcade shooter. Guide your ship through 16 levels of increasing mayhem and face off against 20 enemy types and 16 unique bosses.  Use quicksilver reactions, or thoughtful planning to get through obstacles and opponents.

4132210.name: Zombie Hamsters
4132210.short_description: An online co-op game for up to 4 players. Play as hamsters trapped in a huge scientific laboratory. Explore the lab, solve puzzles, and fight off enemies. Find a way out and unleash a true hamster apocalypse!

4057670.name: The Midnighters
4057670.short_description: A co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Hunt buried treasure with your detector, sell your loot, and explore a cursed village. As sanity falls, hallucinations blur what is real. Solve ritual puzzles and face the creatures lurking in the dark.

4312860.name: BOOTH BUTCHER
4312860.short_description: No weapons. No backup. Just you, a meat cleaver, and the closing shift from hell in this retro slasher horror experience. Uncover the theater's dark secrets and survive the night, or become the BOOTH BUTCHER'S next attraction.

3398480.name: XenoFields: Frontier
3398480.short_description: Cultivate the Unknown in XenoFields: Frontier; a farming RPG situated on an alien planet. After crashlanding, you must brave unique biomes to discover new life forms, craft materials to build a habitable farm, and ultimately terraform the planet! Play with friends and uncover the mysteries together!

3665700.name: Myrridon
3665700.short_description: The land of Myrridon awaits: a living, text-driven fantasy world inside a modern graphical client. Set out from castle Steepmarch into human-voiced quests, RNG dungeons, raids, and a sprawling Mastery Tree. Fully playable by screen reader. Read the world, type your intent, and go deeper.

5128610.name: WarHarvest RTS
5128610.short_description: Hex-battlefield RTS that keeps the foundations of traditional RTS — gather, build, expand, train — but real growth happens in battle: every deed your forces accomplish charges your next card pick, changing your playstyle and turning the tide of battle. Four factions, solo vs AI, PvP up to 8.

4881080.name: Koryos : Sons Of Mars
4881080.short_description: Shift seamlessly between overhead RTS command and brutal first-person action in the Gallic Wars. Conquer territories, build vital fortifications, and wage WAR. Your Roman troops aren't just fodder, every soldier has a name, earning ranks and a legacy as they survive the front lines.

4575350.name: 姑苏恋语
4575350.short_description: 《Suzhou Love words》is a distinctive visual novel that skillfully blends romance and comedy. Set in Suzhou, the game offers players a uniquely local love story inspired by the city’s culture, scenery, and atmosphere.

5451040.name: Band of Fortune
5451040.short_description: Lead a band of fortune born from the roll of the dice. Every saga brings a new frontier region on a hex map and three threats to break. Trade, gear up and fight hard turn-based battles where every roll counts and the fallen never come back.

2353050.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
2353050.short_description: Multiplayer Anime Movement FPS. Wall-run, slide, pilot your mech, and run the map in PvP and PvE. Win matches, earn loot, build your Mother Base. Customize your guns and squad of anime operators. No sweats, just vibes.

4508290.name: Lucky Punk
4508290.short_description: Push your luck and beat the odds in this roguelike deckbuilder. *Draw* another card or *Stop*. 1% chance. 100% choice. Survive and thrive in a vibrant eco-dystopia… or don’t. ¯_(ツ)_/¯ Gather supplies and grow your community in the post-apocalypse. Do you feel lucky, Punk? 💀

4996050.name: Island Raiders
4996050.short_description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

3040020.name: N PLUS INFINITY TIMES TWO
3040020.short_description: 5 fresh flavors of world-class online mayhem, from Friendship-Testing™ Co-op to Friendship-Ending™ Competitive, plus classic singleplayer. Run around with friends, lure enemies into opponents, make the ultimate sacrifice for teammates, and hunt each other with rockets. Couch-ready/Tournament-worthy.

2561460.name: Burning Sword Death Sun
2561460.short_description: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th century China. Play as Zhang Yixiang, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, roguelite progression, and an arena built for high scores.

1120230.name: Chosen by Odin
1120230.short_description: Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.

3878760.name: Migration
3878760.short_description: Survive as a crow through lands bound to cycles of warmth and frost. Endure hunger, thirst, and fatigue while paying attention to predators. Find allies among other animals, share resources, and decide when to leave before survival grows harsher.

5375720.name: Galactic Rummi LAN Party
5375720.short_description: Multiplayer Rummi board game ideal for LAN parties, family game night, long flights, camping trips and areas where an Internet connection is not available. All playing devices are required to be connected over the same LAN (Local Area Network), or the Wi-Fi network or Hotspot.

4957180.name: 驱邪师 Demo
4957180.short_description: Exorcist is a first-person horror role-playing game where players step into the shoes of an exorcist, visit haunted locations, follow clues, and gradually uncover the truth behind the haunting

2747660.name: Zombie Assault: Resurgence
2747660.short_description: Zombie Assault: Resurgence is an intense, action packed top-down shooter, featuring deep RPG elements. Customise your loadout with unique upgradeable weapons as you gear up to take on hordes of enemies. Play solo or team up in co-op with up to 4 players.

3710120.name: Potion-making: Path of the Alchemist
3710120.short_description: Brew potions, compete with fellow alchemists, and save the magical world from destruction in the digital adaptation of the beloved board game.

4348420.name: PIERCING
4348420.short_description: PIERCING is a rhythm-action game where you smash every panel to the beat. Fail, and the Contract forces you to give your childhood friend a piercing.

5262190.name: Blind Katana: The Ember Keeper
5262190.short_description: Samurai action roguelike as a blind swordsman who sees by sound. In the [Eternal Night], enemy footsteps become waves of light that reveal them. Read the dark, slash, guard, roll and execute foes. Pick a card each stage to build your swordplay, and face the [Darkest Hour], who stole the [Ember].

4729570.name: Dragon Eggs: Survivors Demo
4729570.short_description: Bullets that spawn more bullets! Collect dragons to fight with you. Level up and merge them. Create unique builds to survive hordes of enemies in this 3D roguelike bullet hell survival game!

2962320.name: Artificial Detective
2962320.short_description: Artificial Detective is an action-adventure where you step into the shoes of a robodetective in a dystopian city overrun by rogue robots. Lead your underdog team of a military robodog and a human girl as you fight, hack, and outsmart your enemies to uncover why humans are gone.

3809360.name: Pirate Skulls and Sails Online
3809360.short_description: Grab your crew and sail into chaos! Man the cannons, patch the hull and survive the Ghost Ship's volleys in a wild 1-4 player pirate co-op. Host with one click, friends join through Steam. No servers. No accounts.

5086730.name: Holon
5086730.short_description:
Build factories inside factories. Extract shapes, automate production, and deliver increasingly complex designs to the Hub. Enter a Nest to build its machinery, reuse it as a single building, then fit smaller Nests inside larger ones to take your factory further.
About this game

2329870.name: Electrician Simulator - Smart Devices
2329870.short_description: Electrician Simulator goes Smart! Complete new "wireless" missions and take your service to the next level. Fix plenty of new smart devices that needs repair and satisfy your clients!

2109740.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - Kawaii DLC
2109740.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to Kawaii customers!

1373530.name: Militsioner
1373530.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

4792700.name: Inukari 3D - Shattered World
4792700.short_description:
“Inukari 3D - Shattered World” tells the story of the guardian goddess Inukari.
Join her on her journey through a colorful retro 3D platformer featuring a total of three open worlds and plenty of characters and quests.

4475270.name: Wyldheart Demo
4475270.short_description: Embark on bite-sized campaigns in this co-op action RPG set in a rustic fantasy world. Start from nothing, and freely build your character as you investigate rumors, explore strange ruins, and survive the dangers threatening the fallen Kingdom of Caerwyn.

5052630.name: Kazfall
5052630.short_description:
Kazfall is a single-player roguelite dungeon crawler built on 25-minute runs. 
Fight with stamina and timed blocks, discover NPCs who sell upgrades and gear, and reach the boss before time runs out. 
Even failed runs make you stronger for the next descent.

4711490.name: 4:AM Demo
4711490.short_description: Hide. Solve. Run. Survive. In this vertical slice of 4:AM's near-future dystopia, Aila must rely on observation and ingenuity to escape a world where light is lethal. Duplicate objects from the environment and adapt under pressure in this dark cinematic stealth adventure demo.

5445770.name: Tom the Postgirl - Artbook
5445770.short_description:
This artbook explores the creation of the world of Tom the Postgirl and its inhabitants.
Dive into the heart of Tom's world, from the first sketches to the final in-game illustrations!

5072220.name: HolEvade
5072220.short_description: HolEvade is a challenging, physics-based 3D platformer where precision is everything. Tilt and control the platforms high above the clouds to guide your ball, navigate tight paths, and test your reflexes in a vibrant, stylized world!

2669070.name: HARMA Demo
2669070.short_description: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

4545470.name: The Totemist
4545470.short_description: Craft uncanny totems. Aid troubled townsfolk. Uncover the darkness below. The Totemist is a narrative-driven occult shop sim set in a quietly strange town, where you craft charms inspired by real witchcraft, aid troubled townspeople, and uncover the ancient force festering beneath them.

5077950.name: Space Gnomes Demo
5077950.short_description: Space Gnomes is a wacky multiplayer co-op game where a team of space gnomes is trying to escape an invading empire of space-faring garden moles focused on enslaving the known universe.

2487190.name: Main Sequence
2487190.short_description: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

3655040.name: ESCAPE Protocol
3655040.short_description: In this co-op horror game, escape an unknown realm where reality is shattered and dimensions collide. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly entities, and uncover the hidden saboteur.

5400350.name: Debounce: Double Click & Key Chatter Fix
5400350.short_description: Debounce filters repeated mouse clicks and keyboard inputs to prevent unwanted duplicate actions. It monitors your mouse and keyboard, helping identify keys that exhibit faults or repeated activations.

4051290.name: Tape Man
4051290.short_description: Tape Man is a puzzle platformer full of hidden mechanics. Throw your tape measure and set off into a vast maze built out of puzzles. Your tape is both your platform and your obstacle — and it can do a lot more than that. You'll just have to find out.

3864850.name: ESCAPE PROTOCOL: Online (Demo)
3864850.short_description: In this co-op horror game, escape an unknown realm where reality is shattered and dimensions collide. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly entities, and uncover the hidden saboteur.

2843060.name: Into the Wind
2843060.short_description: Drive, fly, and run deliveries together with your sentient motorcycle-plane, Ermes. Make friends, battle rowdy air pirates, upgrade your bike, decorate your home, explore the islands of Santa Rosa, and solve the mystery of your uncle's disappearance.

2409660.name: Wardens of Avalon
2409660.short_description: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

3220700.name: Timebound
3220700.short_description: An exploration puzzle adventure in mystical ruins. Explore a world filled with puzzles, uncover the magic left behind, discover what's hidden in plain sight, learn the rules and break them.

5342360.name: Arcforge
5342360.short_description: Arcforge is a co-op Action RPG built around fast-paced magical combat. Master different schools of magic, combine abilities, explore a dangerous world, collect powerful loot, and fight hordes of enemies and mighty bosses with your friends.

5104100.name: Lifespan.exe
5104100.short_description: Ever wonder what another life would be like? In Lifespan.exe there is no undo. Shape your destiny in a retro terminal with stylish ASCII art: Be a musician, athlete, surgeon, or mobster; pick your spouse and career. Marry, fall into debt, go to jail, or explore the world. Enjoy your chosen life!

2028270.name: Super Vecter Elite Turbo
2028270.short_description: You're the pilot in a scouting ship sent ahead of the mothership to ensure the area is clean and safe for its passage. You have to hunt down, at insane high speeds, all the enemies that might get in your way and clear a path for the home that's racing behind you.

3110510.name: Lost Dream Chronicle
3110510.short_description: "Lost Dream Chronicle" is a 3D action RPG that merges campus life simulation with 3D diorama-style Metroidvania, rooted in dream psychology. Nan, a young rookie chemistry teacher,  finds herself trapped in a dangerous dream world. Fight through the dream, uncover secrets, and save the world!

5181060.name: Memorology
5181060.short_description: A memory roguelike deckbuilder. Rewrite the rules of memory with intuitive combos, defining upgrades, energetic synergies, and endless strategies.

5133500.name: Kuroi Pen
5133500.short_description: A struggling manga artist inherits a mysterious black pen that brings the women he draws to life. Build relationships, uncover buried memories, and decide their fate in a choice-driven adult romantic fantasy visual novel with multiple endings.

5411160.name: Floaterra
5411160.short_description: Build and expand a floating settlement in Floaterra, a single-player farming and automation game. Grow crops, craft machines, organize production, and put robot helpers to work, with your RoboPet at your side.

4815270.name: KRUSHPIT
4815270.short_description: KRUSHPIT is a Real-Time Indirect PvP roguelike survival set among brutal concrete blocks and rusty garages. Obliterate mutants, evolve skills, spin slots, and create OP builds! Survive the chaos or join the PvP ladder to crush everyone and dominate the leaderboard!

5403820.name: My Snake Likes Apples Demo
5403820.short_description: A short, minimalist incremental game about raising a foolish snake and helping it go the distance.

4324770.name: BattleSpinners
4324770.short_description: A fast-paced, spinning-tops versus game. Build your spinner, launch it into the arena, and defeat your opponents by knocking them out of the ring, or by tearing them apart. Brawl against or alongside your friends, use your skills and unleash powerful abilities to dominate the arena (1-4 players)

3003430.name: TINY METAL 2
3003430.short_description: The TINY METAL series reaches its full potential in this land, sea, and air tactical battle simulation game! Produce your favorite units, capture territory, and fight for victory. 100+ Campaign and Skirmish mode maps. 15+ commanders. Report for duty, soldier!

3649210.name: Gagged Love: Bondage Studio
3649210.short_description: A short, NSFW management-style clicker game. You run a brand-new bondage studio, and some beautiful young women are very interested in working with you. What luck! Customize, tie, gag, and fuck these new models to make enough money to really put your studio on the map.

4996240.name: Bone to Pick: Forensic Case Files
4996240.short_description: From a single bone to a name — and the truth. A visual novel mystery set in a forensic anthropology lab. Read the bones, search the scenes with your colleagues, run the experiments, and close in on the killer. Seven names waiting, 18 forensic tasks turned into play, and one very good dog.

4953480.name: Rhodian Exodus
4953480.short_description: Design your own tanks and buildings, build your supply network, and lead your armoured forces against relentless arachnid hordes in a post-apocalyptic RTS. Reclaim the world, one battlefield at a time.

5210470.name: Hexograph Demo
5210470.short_description: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

5129280.name: Hospital Rhapsody
5129280.short_description: Build your hospital and form special bonds. From daily management to private moments, discover their stories amid the bustle of work. As trust and affection grow, uncover another side beneath the white coat…

2338890.name: Starship Colony
2338890.short_description: A deep starship colony sim. Build your starship, manage air, water, food, fuel, energy, temperature and psychology to keep your crew alive across vast distances. Closed-loop system in space. Mining, wiring, plumbing, in-ship factory, (alien?) radio signals & translation, diplomacy, combat, and more.

4764890.name: PROTECTUS
4764890.short_description: 🧲 A minimalist first‑person puzzle game where you have to escape from a ruined lunar complex using an experimental magnetic cannon and uncover the secrets of the ECHO project together with the drone Kruitni.

5095440.name: The Corrupted Witches
5095440.short_description: As the new Substitute Alchemist in a secluded fortress, take control of your desk hub to manage, evaluate, and corrupt elite mages. Gather rare ingredients, navigate multi-stage quests, and watch the women dynamically adapt to your influence in this adult sandbox visual novel.

3712150.name: TCG Card Collection: Tidy Up
3712150.short_description: Organize and restore a special collection of 3,200 TCG cards. Clean each card and reveal their true glory. Match and sort them to sixteen themed sets. Turn a room full of chaos back to a collector's gallery.

3295000.name: Revamp
3295000.short_description: A Tower Defensevania where you rule as Dracula. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

2563090.name: Hume Index
2563090.short_description: As a special agent who specializes in dealing with unstable reality, you need to use your firearms, blades, and elemental reactions to eliminate mutants in an abandoned cosmo, control the source, and escape if possible. Can be played as a single player or with 2-4 players in Co-Op mode.

4729050.name: Vibe Train
4729050.short_description: A cozy train-themed idle game. Build your own train at the bottom of your screen, trade goods, carry passengers, and grow crops as you enjoy a relaxing journey through a beautiful pixel-art world.

3967580.name: Hexograph
3967580.short_description: Hexograph is a hexagonal twist on nonogram puzzles. Use logic to solve handcrafted multi-color grids, read clues across three directions, untangle special hint rules, and reveal colorful hidden pictures.

5294650.name: Bone to Pick: Forensic Case Files Demo

5083380.name: Xenobiome Command Demo
5083380.short_description: Build a colony on a fungal alien world and keep it alive. Explore the fog, expand across the map, exploit the land, and exterminate the alien packs before they reach your people. Xenobiome Command goes hard - from planetfall to last stand.

3377340.name: Delivery Guy Simulator
3377340.short_description: Welcome to Delivery Guy Simulator, where you take on the streets of a vibrant city as a determined delivery guy! Navigate bustling city blocks, deliver all kinds of packages and rise to the top of the delivery business.

3846710.name: The Wake
3846710.short_description: Set sail on the dark waters of a forgotten archipelago. Catch mutated monsters with customizable gear, master eldritch magic, and fight for survival. Take up arms to fend off sea beasts in an unforgiving Lovecraftian world.

4560000.name: Battle Nap
4560000.short_description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

2791980.name: Delivery Driver Service: Prologue
2791980.short_description: Start your first journey to rebuild the state after the recent hurricane in Prologue by loading up your truck! Get ready to explore the game world and become the ultimate Delivery Driver!

4903090.name: Squimo Demo
4903090.short_description: The Squimo have taken over this planet. Grab your weapons, fight your way through endless hordes of Squimo, and face the Squimo King to reclaim the planet!

5316020.name: Apples Everywhere! Let's Tidy Up
5316020.short_description: The orchard is overflowing, and there are Apples Everywhere! Clean up the grounds in this cozy Tidy-Up-lite, a tidy-up game with only two item types: good apples for the market crate, wormy ones for the food bin. Earn money, buy powerful upgrades, and unlock animal helpers. Let's tidy up!

5315240.name: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion
5315240.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's  stories. Explore the Hundred Acre Wood, unravel secrets and make decisions that can change the course of events.

5062930.name: Fate Startrail Demo
5062930.short_description: Fate Startrail is a single-player roguelite strategy RPG demo. Launch your character through a field of dice, plan ricochets, roll results, and trigger familiar attacks, healing, and control effects.
developers: 沈阳北境星火科技有限公司
publishers: 沈阳北境星火科技有限公司

5088880.name: Arctic Shop Simulator Demo
5088880.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

4487060.name: Northgard Battlegrounds
4487060.short_description: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

5044940.name: Aqua Factory Simulator
5044940.short_description: Harvest and farm aquatic commodities, build and automate your factory, and turn the commodities into valuable products. Run the store automatically, expand your operation, optimize your production, and team up with friends in co-op to build and manage your growing aquatic business.

4980870.name: 光芽岛
4980870.short_description: Lumsprout Isle is a 2D top-down pixel farming game.  The world is veiled in a pale grey mist and the sea routes are sealed.  Take up your hoe, fishing rod, and weapons, sail through the mining lands, the snowy isle, and the lava isle, and bring the sleeping world back to life.

5088770.name: Arctic Shop Simulator
5088770.short_description: Run a small shop at the edge of the Arctic wilderness. Ride your snowmobile into frozen regions, track and sedate wildlife, fish, survive brutal weather, and return home to sell your finds. Negotiate with customers, expand your shop, and build a thriving business in the far north.

5299720.name: Wild Oath
5299720.short_description: Wild Oath is a dark fantasy 2D metroidvania where you gain abilities from different animals that help you explore, fight, and discover new paths. Explore a corrupted forest, face different creatures and powerful bosses, and uncover the secrets hidden within this world.

5153710.name: STELLAR WING
5153710.short_description: A space fighter shooter about taking a carrier apart. Fly as a flight of four, burn down the turrets, crack the shield generators, then kill the core. Rebuild your fighter from 200 parts across 12 campaign missions and 30 hunts against 10 machine leviathans.

5399520.name: Mom! I'm gonna be a black hole when I grow up! Demo

4626750.name: Deep Diving Adventures 2
4626750.short_description: Dive deeper than ever before! Search for Atlantis across 8 unique global locations. Manage your oxygen, breach the surface to plan your next move, and use dynamite or underwater robots to carve your path. Discover over 50 marine species in this immersive diving adventure.

5114940.name: Dead Keys
5114940.short_description: Dead Keys is a fast-paced typing action roguelite set in a pixel-art zombie apocalypse. Type to shoot, survive escalating hordes, build powerful chaotic runs, chase WPM records in Endless, and fight alongside, or against your friends online.

5168960.name: Aldmark Calls for Aid
5168960.short_description: A medieval siege-defence strategy game where a rival crown comes for your city. Command your troops on the walls and in the field, and between rounds light beacons to choose which allies will march to your aid. Win or lose, every battle earns renown to make Aldmark stronger.

5093250.name: Nine Thrones
5093250.short_description: An open-world fantasy RPG inspired by classic tabletop adventures. Create your character, gather companions, explore dangerous dungeons, and choose your own path as a hero, merchant, outlaw, commander, or ruler in a living world of rival kingdoms and war.

5358240.name: Dukkha Overflow
5358240.short_description: Dukkha Overflow is an intense top-down PvPvE shooter set in a supernatural coliseum. You are a soul trapped in an eternal simulation: the Samsara. Master elemental weapons, forge alliances, betray, and harvest the Ego of your rivals to break the cycle or become the new Custodian.

5216720.name: Submind Demo
5216720.short_description: Dive into broken minds, with up to 3 friends, in order to stabilize them. Pick the correct path, solve puzzles, pay attention to your surroundings, all while making sure the patient's mind doesn't go to the point of no return, because if does, you'll be facing their worse traumas and nightmares.

2316420.name: Track Day: From Street to Circuit
2316420.short_description: Track Day is a realistic racing game built around a deep career. Buy a used car, turn it into a track machine part by part, compete in grassroots events, earn your licenses, and work your way into professional motorsport.

4962420.name: Cosmic Crumbs: Bakery Simulator Demo
4962420.short_description: Run a futuristic bakery alone or with up to 4 players. Bake, brew, serve customers, buy equipment and hire a robotic assistant in this gameplay-packed demo.

5168400.name: GRAVE SLIDE
5168400.short_description: GRAVE SLIDE is a dark-fantasy puzzle roguelike. You have died more times than you can count, and beyond the gates at the top of the Tower you can finally die for good. Slide through rooms built from five ages of the dead, plan every route, and meet the legends who never found their way out.

3156680.name: Rules: Motel Horizon
3156680.short_description: Work the night shift at a remote motel where monsters wear human faces. Check in suspicious guests, uncover hidden rules, and survive 14 nights where every decision could be your last.

3672660.name: Caramel Creek
3672660.short_description: ☕ Turn a run-down house by the river into a cozy cafe of your own design. Grow and brew your coffee, paint and furnish the place, meet three neighbours with lives of their own - and keep Ostin the cat company. Early Access.

5447550.name: Rip It Together
5447550.short_description: Bid on mystery packages, then rip, pop, squish and smash through ridiculous layers of wrapping with up to 3 friends. Gift paper, slime, balloons, chains, giant eggs… and inside? A supercar. Or a poo. A silly co-op unwrapping party.

2632070.name: Zegelon: Hardcore Arena
2632070.short_description: Zegelon: Hardcore Arena is a multiplayer first-person hardcore persistant survival action & extraction RPG with battle royale pressure built around a Dynasty system with fast progression and permanent losses.

4892830.name: The Pond Demo
4892830.short_description: Lovecraft horror merging puzzle game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

3904880.name: DIY Store Simulator (Demo)
3904880.short_description: Run your own hardware store in this free demo. Stock the shelves, set your prices, and serve customers at the checkout. Order new stock, restock, and reinvest your profits to grow the shop, one sale at a time.

4776260.name: 守城录：六阵 — 三国卡牌构筑塔防 Demo
4776260.short_description: Hex-grid tower defense set in the Three Kingdoms. Build your deck, summon legendary heroes, and hold the last stronghold through 20 waves of endless night.

5457920.name: ColorCraft
5457920.short_description: Recolor sprites and entire asset folders with multiple palettes. Preview changes, preserve selected colors, adjust shading and dithering, and export variations for your game or art workflow. Includes palette tools and command-line batch processing.

2885380.name: Gold Mining Simulator 2
2885380.short_description: Become a gold miner. Work hard, dig deep, explore the world and become the richest person in Alaska. Use a variety of specialized machines, and before all, cooperate with others in Multiplayer mode!

4968160.name: Kleromancy
4968160.short_description: What if Slay the Spire used dice instead of cards? Build your own 3D dice, customize their faces, and roll them with real physics in this turn-based roguelike. Create powerful combos, manipulate your rolls, and fight your way through 7 corrupted biomes.

4794830.name: Crime Simulator - Ashen Creek DLC
4794830.short_description: Explore a brand-new neighborhood map with over 9 new spots to break into and loot. Steal new cars, avoid traps like pressure floors, and hit places like jewelry stores or pharmacies. Ashen Creek could be your biggest payday yet.

4894000.name: Ghostlock
4894000.short_description: Survive a round and it comes back as a ghost that replays your exact moves. Touch your past and you die. GHOSTLOCK is a 1-bit arcade dodger: every round adds a ghost, every fifth round they assemble into a boss, and the only way forward is through everything you have done.

4699150.name: Astro beasts
4699150.short_description: Astro Beasts is a co-op roguelite arena shooter where every hero has unique abilities! Upgrade your weapons, build defenses, deploy turrets and mines, create crazy combinations, and survive alongside your friends!

3868750.name: TerraScape Ancient Egypt
3868750.short_description: Expand your kingdom-building adventure in TerraScape Ancient Egypt! Master the sands by crafting irrigation systems to nourish the land, then raise mighty monuments under the desert sun. Discover new resources and mechanics as you lead your settlement to pharaonic glory. Will your legacy endure?

4115520.name: Really Illegal Golf
4115520.short_description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your membership ban and wreak havoc with friends in co-op, or tee off for a high score. Evade security, defend yourself with a customizable arsenal and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

4172570.name: Chess & Chapter
4172570.short_description: "Chess & Chapters" is a 2D turn-based tactical strategy   a fictional sci-fi setting, players take on the role of Pan, a commander of the Messenger Foundation. You command your field team via the Board OS and plunge into conflicts rooted in the past and war.

4437800.name: Cannon Keep Demo
4437800.short_description: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

4926710.name: Metal Detecting Days
4926710.short_description: A relaxing metal detecting simulator where you manually sweep your detector, interpret realistic signals, and explore beautiful locations at your own pace. Dig up historical coins, relics, and forgotten curiosities, upgrade your gear, and build a personal collection.

2303270.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - Demons DLC
2303270.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to the Demons!

4984750.name: CoreVore
4984750.short_description: CoreVore is a first-person voxel mining sandbox. Explore a persistent atlas of destructible planets, scan for rare ore, shape tunnels, deploy machines, and evacuate your cargo before instability turns your route into a trap. Return later—the planet remembers what you changed.

5335580.name: Unmess Co.: Rewind the Wreck Demo
5335580.short_description: Inspect the wrecked room, work out what's blocking what, and restore everything in the right order. Activate Rewind, piece broken things back together, and send every object home — preferably without another incident.

2922150.name: Crime Simulator (DEMO)
2922150.short_description: You’re out of jail, but the debt isn’t gone. Sneak, steal, and break into houses solo or in 2-player co-op. Will you pay back what you owe, or lose everything?

5380070.name: Last Evac
5380070.short_description: The last evac helicopter drops you over a ruined city. Loot, craft and pick a role, then outlast 60 players as the zone closes in. Win, and the helicopter comes back for you. A top-down pixel-art battle royale where walls block your sight. Solo or in a squad of four.

4328450.name: Discovery Islands
4328450.short_description: Discovery Islands puts a twist on the classic 2D hidden-object games and reimagines the genre in 3D! Each level is a small handcrafted island that is filled with interactable objects, puzzle elements, and cleverly hidden items waiting to be discovered by rotating and tilting the camera.

5459820.name: BlackOut!
5459820.short_description: How long can you brain survive the Black Out!

2161710.name: NO LAW
2161710.short_description: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

2104280.name: TIKTOKI: RACING
2104280.short_description: A focused precision driving challenge. One car. One island track. One objective: beat your own time.

2948120.name: Cursed Profit
2948120.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 5 players where stealing more loot makes the world deadlier. Meet your quota, manage your greed, and escape before the curse takes you.

2204770.name: Language Adventure
2204770.short_description: Learn English in a hand-made, stop-motion town! An alien has crash-landed in your garden. Click on anything to hear what it is in spoken English, narrated by Adam Buxton, with subtitles in French, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. A point-and-click adventure for all ages.

4982050.name: CURSECADE: Pachinko Roguelite
4982050.short_description: Build explosive chain reactions with balls, pegs, and cards inside a cursed arcade machine. Place and upgrade special pegs, master physics-driven bounces, and survive stages and bosses that keep rewriting the rules.

3586780.name: Construction Crew (Demo)
3586780.short_description: From the roar of engines to the rumble of rollers! Take charge of excavators, dozers, dump trucks, and rollers as you and your team transform an empty lot into a finished road. Play solo or build together in online co-op for up to 4 players in Construction Crew (Demo).

5301630.name: HOT DOG AI Translator
