5301630.short_description: HOT DOG translates Windows screen text with OCR and adjustable overlays. Translate offline after setup, work with text, images, documents and replies, or use cloud services with your own API key.

5399230.name: Spin Realm: The Sovereign's Doom Demo
5399230.short_description: An exploration roguelite where everything is decided on a wheel. Chase gear that bends your luck, take the fights you think you can win, and end the Sovereign's tyranny. Die and the city takes you back. Play alone or with friends.

1415230.name: For The Stars
1415230.short_description: For the Stars invites you to explore and settle a vast universe of diverse planets, each with its own unique wonders and mysteries to uncover. Conquer the challenges of hostile biomes, forge alliances, and build a legacy that spans the galaxy.

4873890.name: Robots Haven
4873890.short_description: Robots Haven is a cozy job simulator about repairing robots and exploring a forgotten world. Explore a lush abandoned environment, repair adorable robots, craft and upgrade your tools and discover the joy of a simple, satisfying daily routine.

5270750.name: Island Raiders Demo
5270750.short_description: Raid islands for resources, then head home to grow a Viking settlement that makes every future raid stronger. Island Raiders is an incremental base-builder where going out to explore and staying home both matter. Go raid. Come home. Build. Go raid again.

208300.name: Train Simulator: European Loco & Asset Pack
208300.short_description: The European Community Asset Pack is aimed at users creating and using independently developed content.

5177210.name: Desktop Fighter Demo
5177210.short_description: Turn your desktop into a living battleground! In this free-to-play idle RPG, your stickman fighter battles while you work. Collect loot and chests, merge items into stronger gear, improve your build, and hunt for rare tradable items.

4372380.name: Void Reaver Demo
4372380.short_description: Inventory management meets bullet heaven. In this sci-fi roguelite, your backpack determines your fate. Master the art of item layout to create game-breaking synergies and turn a humble arsenal into a screen-clearing storm of destruction.

4878710.name: 知夏
4878710.short_description: 你将扮演一个被AI淘汰的程序员，回到那个停滞的小县城，与那个等了你十二年的女孩一起去寻找，从所有人记忆里消失的发小和尘封的往事，你们追查的不仅仅是真相，还是被AI一起困住的那个夏天、那座小城、那段永远不会结束的等待。

4864680.name: Desktop Companion
4864680.short_description: The most powerful AI companion on your desktop: it sees your screen, searches the live web, writes your files, opens your apps, reads and replies to your Twitch chat, and remembers every conversation. Runs entirely on your PC: no account, no key, no subscription. Windows only.

4216120.name: 我的美味丈夫 My Tasty Husband Demo

3796990.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Iceland
3796990.short_description: Explore the Land of Fire and Ice! Iceland stands apart as one of the most extraordinary countries on Earth, an incredibly unique landscape with completely unmatched rugged nature. Now, you have the chance to experience it all from a truly unique perspective - behind the wheel of your truck.

5453590.name: THROWAWAY
5453590.short_description: Five people posted about their night shifts on an anonymous forum. Every one of them stopped posting at 3:17 AM. Work their shifts yourself in this PS1-style horror anthology and keep to the rules they left behind. Then someone starts a thread about you.

2919170.name: The Mystery Mist
2919170.short_description: The Mystery Mist is a hand-drawn adventure RPG by Wolf Smoke Studio. To awaken your sister from her mist-induced slumber, you become an apprentice in insect medicine in prosperous yet unwelcoming Yin Town. As deep tension brews beneath the calm surface, will you save the town... or your kin?

3356920.name: The voodoo soldier
3356920.short_description:
In The Voodoo Soldier, your weapons consume your life. Miss your shots, waste your life. Kill enemies to make them drop what keeps you alive. Aggression fuels survival, and high health unlocks your deadliest weapons.
Shoot. Heal. Survive.

4403830.name: Cinema Owner: Prologue
4403830.short_description: Cinema Owner is a management simulation where you inherit a run-down cinema in a strange, unfamiliar country under an oppressive government. Screen movies, sell popcorn and drinks, manage your inventory, and keep your business and yourself out of trouble.

2180860.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - Cyber Warriors DLC
2180860.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to the Cyber Warriors!

5067350.name: MusiCo:3 | Code for Music
5067350.short_description: Write a beat. Press RUN. Make it yours. A free Strudel music studio with a retro terminal look, beginner lessons, a piano roll, snippet previews and mouse-shaped sound controls. Customize your workspace and export WAV or lossless FLAC. Full release coming soon.

4296610.name: Sinesperia
4296610.short_description: Someone lived a life here. You just can't remember it yet. Explore the dreams buried deep inside your mind to find out who you were.

3843030.name: Mining Merchant Demo
3843030.short_description: Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life! Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant!

5472480.name: Retro Coder 2000 Demo
5472480.short_description: March 1991. Your brother is gone, leaving his room and a 90s PC that still dials in. Play the opening chapter: get online, take coding jobs, answer the mail and upgrade the machine, in VR or on desktop. Your demo career carries over to the full game.

3415640.name: Acornia: Mirror Worlds
3415640.short_description: Acornia: Mirror Worlds is a bake-and-brawl management adventure game! Run your shop in one dimension, fight angry spirits in the other. Your special skill? Stuffing your bottomless cheek pouches with treats - to plate up or shoot up enemies!

4192070.name: Cinema Owner
4192070.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance! Build your cinema by selling tickets, snacks, and drinks, and customizing it. Hire a team and shape your theater to reflect your vision, making it a thriving business. Remember each city has rules as you grow. Have fun creating your dream cinema!

4272370.name: Coal Duty
4272370.short_description: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners have reportedly escaped. The state does not confirm this.

3369910.name: Drunk Golf
3369910.short_description: Drunk Golf is a chaotic 1–6 player online golf game where drinking boosts shot power and cart speed, but makes you wobblier. Master the physics-based swings, drift across multiple courses, customize your character & ball and mess with friends on the way to the lowest score.

4349320.name: Pre-Warp Age
4349320.short_description: A turn-based economic strategy game about settling space, from the first flight to the invention of the warp drive. Plan the development of your colonies, assign workers, research technologies and mine resources in randomly generated star systems.

5329660.name: Case Opened
5329660.short_description: Roguelike-style game that opens up with your own collection. Open cases, roll wears for all weapons, get their unique skin, and beat the appraisal value in 24 levels. Collect Adhesives to use in your Master Key and have and retain all weapons that you collect through the game. No cash transactions.

3235700.name: Starball Pachinko
3235700.short_description: A pachinko roguelike in a back-alley izakaya run by a fox-masked bartender. Build your board, win him prizes, chase the grand prize. Why won't he let you leave?

5165820.name: Soulmask - Bone Bash
5165820.short_description: Welcome to the fiesta of Bone Bash – yes, you're dead, but that's not the end. You and your tribesmen have simply taken on a far more entertaining form!

3175120.name: A Tale of Sand and Bone Demo
3175120.short_description: A roguelike action platformer set in an Egyptian fantasy world. Slash, wall jump and dash through new layouts every run, mix weapons and items into a build, gamble your gold, and fight your way to the first boss.

5016840.name: DICEBONE Demo
5016840.short_description:
You will not Die Today.

You will Dice !

Control the Chaos, 

Escape the Ossuary, 

Or be part of the Bones...

Forever.

3432980.name: Ballistic.exe
3432980.short_description: A despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Dozens of weapons, 200+ cartridges, 1000+ attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural.

4287140.name: Bunker Hill
4287140.short_description: Bunker Hill is a WW2 roguelike zombie shooter for 1-4 players. Fight through waves of undead that still haven't forgotten how to wield weapons.

4049210.name: DICEBONE
4049210.short_description: A die is unstable. A bone is sure. A roguelike dice builder where your score is a fractal tree of dice: GROW it ring by ring, drop a die on it and a whole branch regrows. Between rounds, forge the faces until a die stops rolling. 8 rounds, then endless. Control the chaos.

3367830.name: Cemetery Simulator: Demo
3367830.short_description: A DEMO coffin means the cheapest pine one! Grow your own forest cemetery alone or with friends. First, tidy up the place, then grab a shovel, dig your first grave, and organize a funeral. See who among you is the best at shoveling and tombstone care!

5065630.name: Pawville
5065630.short_description: Build a cozy village with adorable animal companions. Assign them jobs, craft items, optimize your production, and watch your little community grow.

5134560.name: DON'T SWITCH
5134560.short_description: Co-op horror for 2-3 friends. Ransack a haunted mansion for cursed tapes, wake the spectres and blast them back to hell with a holy cross. Keep your energy up: the thing in the walls can possess you, and then YOU are the one hunting your friends.

5174500.name: 颂声·市井小神仙 Demo
publishers: 合肥乱码飞映信息科技有限责任公司

3086590.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
3086590.short_description: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

3779800.name: EONA
3779800.short_description:
Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers and Melusine, the evil fairy who rules over it for she has waited so long for a soul to torment.
Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

5419810.name: Electronics Repair Shop Demo
5419810.short_description: Open your own electronics repair shop! Take devices apart, diagnose faults, and replace broken components. Buy and sell used electronics, invest your earnings in new equipment, and grow your small shop.

5345580.name: JANO ADVENTURE
5345580.short_description: This ever-changing world is not for the faint of heart. Craft weapons and armor, master a variety of abilities, and combine them. Only by using everything at your disposal wisely will you achieve victory and uncover the secrets behind these changes.

5045950.name: Dungeon Sookuma
5045950.short_description: Steal the Dream Crystal from the bottom of an ever-changing dream dungeon. Play as baby bear Sookuma in a pixel art turn-based roguelike. Bargain with 19 gods for powers. When the dungeon wakes, fight your way back up. Free demo on Steam now for Windows and macOS.

4902340.name: Noyan: Club Chairman Demo
4902340.short_description: In Noyan: Club Chairman, you’re the president, not the manager. Leave tactics to the coach; your job is to manage finances, lock down sponsors, and win over the fans. Remember: matches are played on the pitch, but the club’s future is won in the presidential office!

4664240.name: Hard Worker
4664240.short_description: An online simulator about the life of working folk in a vast open world. Work side-by-side as a long-haul trucker, farmer, or builder. Climb the career ladder, find loyal companions, and spend quiet evenings by the campfire with a guitar in good company.

5368050.name: Daycare Simulator
5368050.short_description: Daycare Simulator is a cozy story-based daycare sim where happy children mean a thriving business. Care for babies and toddlers, chat with their parents, order and build furniture, decorate, grow crops, buy real-estate, and climb the town leaderboard, solo or in two-player online co-op.

4123930.name: Soverain: An Eternal Legend
4123930.short_description: Eternal Legend is a turn-based tactical RPG that blends political drama and family destiny. Build your army, forge bonds, and wage epic pixel art battles in a world torn apart.

5232470.name: Cog Railway Simulator
5232470.short_description: Operate a historic Austrian cog railway: clean and prepare your steam locomotive, light the fire and tackle steep mountain routes. Play solo or work together as driver and fireman, mastering steam, water, fire and brakes.

5418530.name: Retro Coder 2000
5418530.short_description: March 1991. Your brother Levan is gone, but his PC still boots and his mailbox still gets work. Fix code for clients, break into servers on a hidden network, write and share your own games on a programmable 90s PC, and follow what he left behind. Desktop or VR.

5053940.name: Amusement Factory
5053940.short_description: Build the theme park of your dreams. Lay the roads, place the rides, open the shops and keep every guest smiling from the gate to the last bus home. A bright, cozy park builder with a ten-location campaign, free play with no limits, and a front-seat view of every ride you put down.

4762750.name: Fathom
4762750.short_description: A short horror game where you row a small boat through endless fog.

4345880.name: 弹丸棋盘 Demo
4345880.short_description: Free demo of Shoot & Jump. Every shot moves you: each bullet's recoil knocks you back across the board. Pick from 4 guns, build with common cards plus the Poison, Burn and Ramming archetypes, and survive 3 waves ending with The Checkmate.

4988440.name: GUGUGAGA:PEEKABOO
4988440.short_description: GUGUGAGA! Sudoku! Minesweeper! Combined gameplay!! Plus, you can play online with friends!!!

4335630.name: Legatus
4335630.short_description: LEGATUS is a Roman legion simulator focused on the harsh reality of military life. Recruit and train legionaries, construct fortified marching camps, and manage vital supplies. Lead your men through hostile territories, crush tribal resistance, and secure the frontiers for the glory of Rome.

5247220.name: Ballseye
5247220.short_description: A Goofy 2D Nubby-like featuring Monsters, Shooting, Explosions. There are a total of 8 different areas and their contents are procedurally generated each time they are played. The game can be played Solo, but it also supports Multiplayer PVP, Co-op, Level building and sharing.

4238990.name: Rombykon
4238990.short_description: Become Romby, a tiny crystal lost in space! Survive and defend the crystal against dark waves by upgrading crazy weapons, planting strange flowers, and using tarot cards. Explore constellations, defeat bosses, and unlock over 100 unique skills.

502570.name: Houdini Indie
502570.short_description: Houdini Indie's procedural node-based workflow offers a smarter way to create high quality game art. Houdini technology is used by AAA studios to take their games to the next level and now this procedural power is also available to indie game devs around the world.

3301510.name: Tomo: Endless Blue
3301510.short_description:
Tomo: Endless Blue, a Monster-Taming ARPG set in a Voxel Open World. Set sail through the Endless Blue, an ocean realm home to mysterious creatures called Tomo. 
Team up to fight, build homes with friends, or craft wild vehicles to explore procedurally generated islands, villages and tales.

4546860.name: Lights Out Chapter 2 The Unseen Reckoning
4546860.short_description: Alone again and abandoned in the house, this time even darker than usual. You return as Jack and set out to search for your missing Friend.

5200720.name: Overwrite Conflict Demo
5200720.short_description: Shape placement meets turn-based roguelike deckbuilding. Rotate and deploy protocols to contest cells and limit rivals. Chain effects within limited turns to raise your tactical score and turn a lead into damage. Collect protocols, components and supplies on random routes to build around your mech.

2553750.name: 弹丸棋盘
2553750.short_description: Every shot moves you. Each bullet's recoil knocks you back across a tiny chessboard surrounded by conveyor belts. Dodge, ram and chain shots with two guns, survive 5–10 boss waves, and build your run from 398 cards across 20 archetypes.

4575640.name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
4575640.short_description: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

3499790.name: Ashes of the Singularity II
3499790.short_description: In this massive RTS game, command vast armies fighting for control of entire worlds. Control the forces of Earth, the mechanical AI Substrate, or the enigmatic Post-Human Coalition as you battle across the solar system in single player, cooperative multiplayer, or competitive multiplayer.

4379520.name: Catnip Cosmos
4379520.short_description: Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs in this space shooter. Combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons and improve exponentially.

5135140.name: Frostward Demo
5135140.short_description: Frostward is a turn-based 4X survival strategy game set on a frozen hex world, where you plan districts, work toward monumental Wonders, command armies in battle, and decide whether humanity will endure, escape, or restore warmth to the world.

3883800.name: Car Wash Simulator (Demo)
3883800.short_description: FOAM! RINSE! SHINE! Jump into the car washing business and take a high-pressure look at this official demo! Blast road grime with rich active foam, master core cleaning mechanics from windows to tires on 3 unique cars, and test-drive vehicles in the parking lot!

2109741.name: Blacksmith Weapon Merchant - Blood Gods DLC
2109741.short_description: Support the game by opening the doors to the Blood Gods!

3491980.name: Lost Liminal Demo
3491980.short_description: "Descend into liminal space—evade lurking horrors, solve cryptic puzzles, and use your camera to preserve the memories you leave behind in this eerie world. Switch to night vision to uncover hidden clues and trace what's amiss. This first-person indie horror will keep you guessing at every turn."

5128390.name: Project Legend Demo
5128390.short_description: Create a young prospect and shape one footballer’s career across three complete seasons. Develop your player, experience simulation-driven matches and live highlights, navigate contracts and transfers, and make decisions that shape your future in Project Legend.

3512190.name: Sock Dating Simulator
3512190.short_description: Sock Dating Simulator is a quirky visual novel where you turn into a sock and seduce other socks! Find your matching pair and reopen the portal in your washing machine to go back home! Customize your sock, go on dates, get married (divorced?), and more in the "woolderful" world of Sockhalla!

5337660.name: Pick & Roll Manager
5337660.short_description: Create your coach and run a basketball club in 26 leagues across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, with their own rules and continental cups. Possession-by-possession matches on a 2D court, transfers, a youth academy, a board to answer to and an editor to build any league you like.

5118130.name: Stellar Nursery Demo
5118130.short_description: A dead sun, nine empty worlds, and the caretaker who waited a hundred thousand years for someone to come back. Light the star, bring Earth back to life, reignite once, and stay until she asks you to name the first city. It keeps going while you are away. Best with a mouse.

5335950.name: Fantasy Guild Manager
5335950.short_description: The fantasy guild management sim. Price the jobs clients bring you, hire adventurers who choose their own work, and watch the valley change with every job you take or turn away.

5284200.name: Revenant Reclamation
5284200.short_description:
It’s 1985, and you’ve been promoted to software tester, a highly sought after job. The work seems simple enough: test a series of new simulations.

But the longer you spend testing, the harder it becomes to ignore the feeling that something about these simulations is very, very wrong.

4316290.name: Woke Busters: Unleashed
4316290.short_description: The world has gone mad and the only man who can fix it skipped leg day. WokeBuster is a satirical cartoon adventure through the culture war: puzzles, minigames, Buzzlings to catch and a cast with permanently unhinged faces. If one joke offends you, it's working.

4550260.name: Beat For Speed Demo
4550260.short_description: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb leaderboards, create custom levels in the level editor, and explore endless community levels in the Steam Workshop.

5129520.name: Dusted
5129520.short_description: Experience the exciting and skilled sport of Clay Pigeon Shooting through your VR headset. Leverage the power of your PC to immerse yourself in vibrant and dynamic locations, with high fidelity ballistics and aerodynamics.

5135440.name: DPS: Desktop Pension Squad
5135440.short_description: A tiny idle RPG that keeps running in a corner of your desktop while you work. Rally the monsters everyone wrote off as has-beens, and take back the dungeon Cores — and the glory days — the humans stole!

2364460.name: Captain Moviestar 3D
2364460.short_description: An FPS starring your favorite platformer character Captain Moviestar… now in full three-dimensions. Early 90’s 2.5D-raycaster-style shooter for the proto-boomer set.

5462620.name: What the Puck?!
5462620.short_description: Arcade Ice Hockey gets out of hand. Dodge UFOs, survive a tilting rink and score with every puck in play. Compete solo, with up to four players in local split screen, or with up to six online. Pick your events, boost past trouble and rescue your frozen teammates to score the winning slapshot!

1851810.name: The Holdouts
1851810.short_description: Smash, grab, and grow in this 3rd person, session-based shooter— solo or coop. Bash through small town locales and turn lawn tools, kitchen appliances, 8-track toys or French horns into the most unhinged and deadly weapons ever. Fight back, hold out, and build a home in a warped new reality.

4563590.name: Pig King
4563590.short_description: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.

3417550.name: POLDERS: A Dutch City Builder
3417550.short_description:
POLDERS is a relaxing Dutch-themed sandbox city builder where you take back land from the sea.
Reclaim the seabed and create a crooked, bustling town in a world shaped by water.

4051320.name: Cap 'n Barr's Adventure
4051320.short_description: Cap 'n Barr's Adventure is a retro 2D platform action game packed with gameplay—cute capybaras, chip-tune music, and challenging levels, with solo or local two-player co-op. If you love platformers, humor, and hidden stages—give it a try!

4735110.name: Your Painting, Sir Demo
4735110.short_description: A puzzle game about forging paintings using newspaper cutouts. Fool your legally blind boss or lose your job!

4968650.name: Little Knight's Last Night
4968650.short_description: You are a QA tester for a game company working late at night. Your job is to look out for anomalies and glitches in their upcoming top-down adventure game. Will you play the game, or will the game play you?

4409320.name: 床下有罐钱
4409320.short_description:
You complained to a strange roadside statue about being broke—and the next day, a jar of money appeared under your bed.

How do you plan to spend this windfall? Of course, you’re free to squander every cent... as long as you can survive until tomorrow.

5259260.name: Horiforge
5259260.short_description: A game about exploration, where you travel across infinite worlds, where all the content is procedurally generated.

5142140.name: DEADLINE: Afterlife Processing
5142140.short_description: The dead wait in line. You run the press. Read each soul, judge it, seal it and get paid for it. Tired of doing it yourself? The catalog has machines that'll do the work for you. Management recommends it. Management appreciates your cooperation.

4899750.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族
4899750.short_description: Build your own cozy desktop aquarium. Collect dozens of charming fish, shrimp and snails, decorate with plants, rocks, lighting and substrate, and watch your little creatures swim, forage and grow. Unlock rare, dreamlike fish — or set them free to drift across your desktop.

5252190.name: Sunset Painter Demo
5252190.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

5282750.name: We'll Meet Again
5282750.short_description: When someone takes their own life, the pain doesn't end with them. It passes to those left behind. A short story about the guilt, anger and unanswered questions of the people who stay.

4286780.name: This Is the Peace Demo
4286780.short_description: One shift. Seven seats. Far too many egos. Try the first day of this satirical dispatch strategy: build your team, handle 15 calls, open diplomatic talks, and discover why the President's phone is everyone's problem.

2758910.name: Chef's Adventure
2758910.short_description: Tomorrow is Harry's birthday. The Chef only wants to bake a simple cake, but the chickens have broken out and cleared out the whole pantry. Chase them through 5 worlds and 10 levels, learn new moves along the way and get the cake on the table.

5048730.name: InFlood
5048730.short_description: Raise your sails and set forth across an endless ocean, vast and perilous, filled with submerged mysteries and unexpected adventures. Fight your way through danger, upgrade your ship, recruit a crew, explore the world, and decide which coalitions to support—and what will be built upon the ruins.

4674820.name: Disaster Crew
4674820.short_description: Disaster Crew is a co-op action-adventure for up to four players. Take on unusual contracts, explore locations packed with traps and obstacles, and share an adventure filled with unexpected dangers and spectacular events..

4985820.name: Sunset Painter
4985820.short_description: Have you ever wanted to spray an entire can of whipped cream into the sky and watch the sun's golden rays dance through your masterpiece as day melts into dusk? Craft the perfect sky - spray, sculpt, and swirl volumetric clouds with delightfully tactile tools. No pressure, just you and the sky.

1066110.name: Room Planner - Design Home 3D
1066110.short_description: If you just bought a house or an apartment or want to decorate your existing property, we can help you do it easier, with less hustle and achieve better results in less time for the little fraction of total expense.

4947350.name: Juggernaut
4947350.short_description: Looks retro. Plays retro. Because it is retro.Jump back to the ’90s and blast those demons straight back to hell in this fast-paced, old-school FPS!And the carnage doesn’t stop there—load up maps created by other players and dive into even more action-packed adventures.

4409620.name: ARCS
4409620.short_description: A stage‑based shooter where you build optimal strategies and wipe out over a thousand enemies.

3002130.name: Theos: Cities Of Myth
3002130.short_description: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens’ needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

3296990.name: Fearwoods
3296990.short_description: Fearwoods is a 4 co-op survival horror where light and silence are your only weapons. Explore the cursed forest, uncover Aveline’s story, evade a relentless demon, and fight for escape before the darkness consumes you.

5383020.name: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia
5383020.short_description: CHAPA CHAPA Munchkin Mafia is a third-person fighting game centered on the mafia, in which you must build up your own gang and defeat all your enemies.

5404010.name: Cinderwake
5404010.short_description: A dark action RPG with click-to-move combat, deep loot and five classes with their own skill trees. Fight through four acts of random maps alone or with up to 8 players online. Three world levels and the endless Pyre. Loot, die, return.

3645410.name: Midgardr
3645410.short_description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

5110540.name: Escape from Doomstown Demo
5110540.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game where you lead a squad of survivors into a zombie-infested town. Scavenge for supplies, take down dangerous foes, and get out before the horde closes in. Build your base, recruit survivors, strengthen your squad, and fight your way out of this doomed city!

4985720.name: Pocket Aquarium 方寸水族 Demo

4657760.name: River Drift Demo
4657760.short_description: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

1731290.name: SPINE
1731290.short_description:
SPINE is a single-player action game about close-quarters gunfights with aesthetics of Gun Fu movies.
Step into the stunning cyberpunk world with rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant Spine as they defy the autocratic AI regime in search of Redline's captured brother.

4920680.name: Warlapse
4920680.short_description: War isn't heroism — it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

5351640.name: STOREBOT: Tidy Up PC Parts
5351640.short_description: Organize thousands of PC parts, complete shelves, unlock powerful upgrades, and work together with friends to tidy up a chaotic computer store. Carry, throw, and sort boxes across two unique maps while building your perfect store.

4958840.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE: A Roguelike on the Night Shift Demo
4958840.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Try a free week of outrageous combos, plugins and performance reviews. Open ZONE.EXE for NERTZ RUSH and SPIT with Steam friends or bots. TRAINING.EXE limits the content, never your playtime. Your trial shift starts here.

4413570.name: Voxel Playground Demo
4413570.short_description: Voxel Playground is a physics-driven voxel sandbox VR game built for VR. In this fully destructible voxel physics world, you can build, craft and shoot against enemies with limitless possibilities.

5286590.name: Samhan: Where Korea Began
5286590.short_description: Silla's thousand-year reign is crumbling, and Gyeon Hwon, Gung Ye and Wang Geon rise to claim the peninsula. Command 500+ historical figures across a 3D Korea in this turn-based grand strategy of statecraft, diplomacy and war—and reunite the Three Han.

4485570.name: Punch Upon a Time
4485570.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

5383890.name: NO SUNRISE
5383890.short_description: Survive the night in NO SUNRISE, a 2.5D zombie survival shooter for solo play and co-op with up to 8 players. Barricade windows, open new routes, upgrade your weapons and rescue your team as each wave turns up the pressure.

5397320.name: 未春节 Festival of Unborn Spring Demo
5397320.short_description: In Kunming, Yunnan, during her first winter break after entering high school, a fifteen-year-old artistic girl is melancholy with longing, but unexpectedly gets drawn into a wondrous adventure born of myth—behind it all lie her forgotten memories and a wager.

4952090.name: SOLITAIRE.EXE
4952090.short_description: Remember Windows Solitaire? Build outrageous combos in a solitaire roguelike, then open ZONE.EXE and destroy your friends in real-time card mayhem. Install plugins, beat the quota and survive the performance reviews. Your night shift starts here.

4676950.name: Blademash
4676950.short_description: An ultra fast-paced 2D arena brawler for 1–4 players with a roguelike twist, made for couch multiplayer fun or competitive online matches. Pick a race and a class, each with its own playstyle, then draft items between battles to build a unique fighter. New races and classes unlock as you play.

4414620.name: Book Nook
4414620.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

5389390.name: GayTeA VI
5389390.short_description: A cozy, very gay idle clicker about keeping one cup of tea hot. Click it to heat it, hold to pet it, fill a whole kitchen with things that talk back, pour out the pot for tea leaves, and keep the brew going while you are away. Cozy, silly, a little cheeky.

5189820.name: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy Demo
5189820.short_description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

4126780.name: Mind Vessel Demo
4126780.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

5151940.name: WILD DECK
5151940.short_description: Wild Deck is a fast-paced asymmetric hide-and-seek action game where a group of players transform into animals, choosing their form from random cards, while a single armed hunter tries to track them all down and eliminate them.

3168520.name: BloomTale
3168520.short_description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

5165930.name: Two & Two: Agents
5165930.short_description: Play as two secret agents investigating a scientist’s mysterious experiment. Communicate, exchange clues and solve cooperative puzzles where one agent has a piece and the other knows where it fits.

3811500.name: Rahasya: The Curse of Ooty
3811500.short_description: You drove her from the city to Ooty. Something followed her into the car. Now she is possessed, and an aghori in the hills will only help if you bring him what he asks for. First-person Indian folk horror.

5009290.name: NARNOK: Feed Grommy Candy
5009290.short_description:
A push-your-luck roguelike sackbuilder where you feed candy to a worm called Grommy.
Draw candies from your sack, chain their effects, and feed Gromintler BUT NOT TOO SWEET!

5150970.name: Me and You Demo
5150970.short_description:
Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. 
Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

2189320.name: Summoner's Tale Demo
2189320.short_description:
Summoner’s Tale is an Action-Platformer monster collecting game in a new way!
Collect Monsters, discover their unique abilities, build your dream squad and fight your way to save the world!

2392970.name: Mind Vessel
2392970.short_description: An autobattler roguelike in which you are a Vessel formed by the unification of dead people's spirits. Dismember and graft them to customize their abilities, as you use them to find a way out of the void.

4683040.name: Estancia Protocol Zero Demo
4683040.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

4262460.name: ROB RUN
4262460.short_description: ROB RUN is a brutal crime sandbox featuring thousands of players. Rise above everyone through the grit, the grime, and the struggle. Break free and take yourself from squalor by any means.

3506830.name: Out of the Shadows
3506830.short_description: Out of the Shadows is a 2–4 player online co-op horror escape game. Explore unsettling locations, uncover their stories, solve cooperative and asymmetric puzzles, and survive the hostile inhabitants of places your team was never meant to enter.

1799840.name: Queen's Domain
1799840.short_description: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

4783760.name: puzzlez - a shapez game
4783760.short_description: puzzlez - a shapez game is an easy to learn, hard to master puzzle game about building shapes in compact 3D spaces. Solve handcrafted puzzles with multiple solutions, from simple production chains to complex logistical problems. Design, share, and play custom puzzles with an ever-growing community.

4507990.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
4507990.short_description:
Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends.
In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

3108460.name: Speed Golf Royale Demo
3108460.short_description: Play Quick Match online or over LAN with up to 20 players (bots fill empty spots) across all 8 current courses. It includes the tutorial, power-ups and character customisation. The Level Editor, extra game modes and Steam stats and achievements are only in the full game.

5045420.name: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院 Demo
5045420.short_description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

4176740.name: Tiny Desk Pot
4176740.short_description: Grow and nourish your own vegetables in a tiny desk pot! Let your leafy companion grow idle in a corner of your desktop while you do your things. Discover new soils, unlock new types of vegetables, and customize your pot with cute stickers. Relaxing music included!

4878480.name: BordQ
4878480.short_description: Soundboard, AI voice changer, live browser audio, and phone remote — one Windows app, one payment. Works with Discord, OBS, Zoom, and any game. No subscription.

4870080.name: Lazare's Sacrifice
4870080.short_description: The guillotine awaits. Your only escape? A deck of cards. Play for your life against legends of the French Revolution in this gripping narrative deckbuilder. Solve puzzles in the depths of prison to uncover the truth of your captivity. Cards, health, sanity... What will you sacrifice to survive?

5220940.name: World Of Arena
5220940.short_description: This game is an Open World RPG, where you venture into a world to find combat portals and platformers, to get stronger and fight the final boss!!v

4169630.name: 20th Century Warfare
4169630.short_description: 20th Century Warfare is a large-scale World War II wargame spanning land, sea, and air. Command forces across massive battlefields, lead bombing raids and armored assaults, and fight through official and user-made scenarios set across the defining conflicts of the era.

4897060.name: Oreship Stellar Frontier Demo
4897060.short_description: Baue Rohstoffe im All ab, erweitere dein Frachtschiff und errichte Produktionsketten, Stationen und Handelsrouten. In Oreship Stellar Frontier wächst dein Weltraumimperium Schritt für Schritt über mehrere Sternensysteme hinweg.

3673490.name: Eldramoor: Haven in the Mist
3673490.short_description: Gather your friends, or make new ones, as you forge your destiny in Eldramoor, a bold new VR MMO. Master your crafting abilities, level up your combat skills, explore five unique regions, or just socialize at the local tavern. Whatever you bring to the community, you have a home in Eldramoor.

4912680.name: Omanah Demo
4912680.short_description: Myst-Like 3D free exploration game. This demo allows you to play the first part of the game, which features 8 additional worlds in the full version.

3982310.name: ARK: Valguero Ascended
3982310.short_description: Explore Valguero, a land where medieval legend and ancient memory entwine. Journey across ten deadly biomes, from tundra to shadowed trenches, and face predators like the swift Deinonychus and the terrifying Megaraptor. Both beautiful and brutal, Valguero will test your survival like never before.

2784180.name: Seleka-san who Exposes unnoticed with Naked Coat
2784180.short_description:
Experience humanity’s greatest dilemma: “I want to expose more!” vs. “The more daring the exposure, the easier it is to get caught!”
Watch where people are and where they’re looking, push things right to the limit, and complete exposure missions in this fresh 3D stealth exhibitionism action game.

2294250.name: Speed Golf Royale
2294250.short_description: Ready, set, swing! Whack the ball and dash through chaotic courses. Scored on shots taken and how fast you reach the flag. Outplay your rivals in a fast-paced, fun scramble to victory!

5345990.name: The Little Stomping Girl Demo
5345990.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

5338650.name: Breakneck Transmission
5338650.short_description: A fast-paced, time trial package delivery racing game. Using mind bending warps to the laws of physics, deliver packages to their destinations quickly and prove that recklessness can be improved to regain a spot on a top racing team.

3971850.name: Crystant Demo
3971850.short_description:
Crystant is a strategy survival game that combines board game-style exploration, turn-based tactical combat, and Roguelite progression.
Explore the floors, manage resources, strengthen your team, and fight against mutated creatures.

5187540.name: Inearth Demo
5187540.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

3742700.name: TheDowsing / ダウジング
3742700.short_description: You have entered a sealed gold mine, dreaming of a fortune. All you can rely on is your dowsing rod. Is it gold that lies beyond your reaction, or is it......?

5423940.name: Rubber Messiah: 18+ Lust Bunker Simulator
5423940.short_description: Clock in for a logistical nightmare. Deliver cargo to an underground cult obsessed with 18+ absurdity. Dodge industrial sex hazards, find the Supreme Mother Womb, and get your invoice signed. Maintain your deadpan sanity. Just get the signature and leave!

4492480.name: 抽号小队
4492480.short_description: A strategy game blending deckbuilding, auto-battler, and roguelike elements. Recruit and upgrade units to build your squad. Draw random numbers to activate matching units’ skills on the board, earn points, and defeat the boss. Test your strategy and arrangement — with a little luck.

5323810.name: JackParts
5323810.short_description: When the signal sounds, be the fastest! JackParts is an online party battle game for up to 4 players. Win gun parts with quick reflexes, assemble your weapon, and turn the tables with battle items. Even death isn’t the end—the Death Roulette can change your final score.

4277090.name: Conjoined
4277090.short_description: Step into a relaxing world where you stack and merge magical ingredients. Toss herbs, crystals, and curious finds into a bubbling cauldron to gain essence, travel through the portal to discover new cards and mechanics, enjoy a cozy, stress free magical experience.

5413300.name: 1000 MONTHS
5413300.short_description: Live one life across 1,000 months. Make choices, watch time accumulate, and see how work, relationships, routines, and unexpected moments shape where your lifetime goes.

2587620.name: Dinolords
2587620.short_description: Dinolords combines real-time strategy, city-building and action RPG combat in the genre hybrid Hack’n’Strat. Build your stronghold, command human and dinosaur armies and fight as the lord shaping a new age of warfare.

5422140.name: The Peasants Are Coming!
5422140.short_description: You are the nobility. They are everyone else. Tens of thousands of furious peasants pour down the roads at your granary, your treasury and your gate. Hire the watch, raise a circus, hang a few, and break their leaders before they reach your throne.

4225090.name: Inearth
4225090.short_description: A tactical turn-based roguelite with environmental interactions, spellcrafting, and deckbuilding. Descend into the Hollow Earth. As above, so below.

5137810.name: Scraplings
5137810.short_description: A 2D side-view recycling and automation game set above an infinite trash sea. Salvage waste left behind from the Lost Century, process it through advanced production lines, and grow your factory to keep it afloat in this harsh ecosystem while paying your rent on time.

5201690.name: Liberators Inc.
5201690.short_description: Governments are gone. The goddamn bugs are everywhere. And somebody has to get rid of them! Enter the Liberators: mercenary crews that survivors of the bugapolypse hire to exterminate the vile Swarm. Grab your weapons, get yourself a vehicle, team up with your friends, and get rich or die trying!

4558470.name: ARK: Genesis Ascended Part 1
4558470.short_description: Awaken in a fractured virtual simulation. Alongside your companion HLN-A, overcome rigorous tests across lethal biomes. Dive into a massive new ocean with dynamic water physics, master missions, and tame beasts like the Palaeoctopus!

5035400.name: Rites of Accord Demo
5035400.short_description:
Outsmart your rival and win a full wargame in 30 minutes. Or attempt survival against (nearly) endless hordes.

Command six factions that play nothing alike: turn your enemy's dead into ghosts that hunt them, spread living terrain across the map, or form choirs to share damage with allies.

5418970.name: Lucremachine
5418970.short_description: An oddly satisfying incremental roguelike: flip coins to earn money, invest it all back into skills, upgrades, coins, and more as your fortune snowballs into the trillions! Hoard relics from encounters, get rich by midnight to get game-breaking boons, and whatever you do... do NOT anger Gregory.

5456460.name: GAEKGWI
5456460.short_description: A first-person Korean folk horror game set in a fog-bound old village that weaves itself anew every time you enter. You cannot fight. Stay low, listen closely and save your lantern oil as you slip past ghosts from Korean folklore and search for the way home.

4523390.name: Fool's Metal
4523390.short_description: Fool's Metal is a destruction-fueled platformer where every jump breaks the ground, and every environment is fully destructible. Mine, body-slam, and explode your way through handcrafted levels that are begging to be destroyed.

5295390.name: Endless Valkyrie
5295390.short_description: Endless Valkyrie is a 2D pixel idle RPG inspired by Nordic mythology. Guide a Valkyrie through automatic exploration and combat, configure skills and gear, cross three regions, challenge Bosses, forge equipment, claim Offline Rewards, and Rebirth to preserve permanent growth.

2141160.name: Alien Deathstorm
2141160.short_description: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in a desperate fight to survive.

5013020.name: The Little Stomping Girl
5013020.short_description: Tiny stomps. Explosive combos! Mine ore before your match burns out in this incremental mining game. Fit gear into limited equipment slots, collect unique items, and combine skills to turn a little girl's stomps into powerful chain reactions. Light another match, grow stronger, and dig deeper!

3485810.name: Kena: Scars of Kosmora
3485810.short_description: Kena’s journey to cure her affliction leads to the island of Kosmora, plagued by its own mysterious corruption. To protect Kosmora, she must master the elements with the aid of spirit companions and dynamic combat in this action-packed yet heartfelt adventure.

1559720.name: We Harvest Shadows
1559720.short_description: A single-player, first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

4350620.name: Voxel Playground
4350620.short_description: A highly moddable destructible physics sandbox. Built for VR and non-VR.

5173630.name: Rock Band Simulator Demo
5173630.short_description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

5174900.name: KittenRush
5174900.short_description: A nonstop rush of bite-sized mini-games with an adorable pixel kitten! Run breathless and chase every trophy!

4268970.name: Drill Deep
4268970.short_description: Drill Deep is a coalpunk idle clicker about digging the world's deepest hole. You start with a cozy incremental loop, descend into madness of haunted mine and end somewhere you shouldn't have gone

4838710.name: Makina
4838710.short_description: In a world where Emotion is energy, a vengeful pilot boards a dangerous, desire-fueled Makina and descends into the emotion-addicted city. Defy the twisted rulers—a scientist, architect, K-pop idol, and director—to tear down their grand plan. A hybrid adventure of mech action and stealth: [MAKINA].

3583650.name: ARK: Lost Colony
3583650.short_description: Plunge through the icy heart of darkness in ASA's first massive canonical expansion. Discover a new narratively-driven world, unlock powerful skill trees, befriend exotic tames, wear "Cursed" gear tiers, master new building systems, and build & command an army as you seek to dethrone The Lost King!

4149010.name: Doubtbound
4149010.short_description: A turn-based RPG of hidden betrayal. Battle through branching encounters, uncover the traitor within your party, and overthrow the Mad Monarch in multiplayer or solo investigation mode.

3351220.name: The Rotting Chronicles
3351220.short_description: The Rotting Chronicles is a survival action game set in a zombie-ravaged city where you must fight, scavenge, craft, and rebuild to survive. Run solo or with up to 3 friends as you grow your survival skills and find the best strategy to survive.

5009820.name: Juggernaut Asset Maker Pro
5009820.short_description:
This is downloadable content for the retro FPS "Juggernaut".
With this tool, you can create your own original stages and bring your ideas to life.

4139580.name: Where the Seeds Fall
4139580.short_description: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

3907830.name: Car Crime Simulator
3907830.short_description: Steal cars, set up secret stashes, sell vehicles for big profits on demand, or strip them for parts. Build your criminal empire solo or team up with others in co-op mode.

3322630.name: Culdcept BEGINS
3322630.short_description: A hidden classic that fuses board and card games, Culdcept features a unique, innovative system that has captivated fans since its debut. Players become Cepters, wielding cards in intense battles where luck and strategy collide. After ten years, a brand-new story begins once again.

5434600.name: Strip Bubbles: Maidens of the Castle of Lust
5434600.short_description: Enter the Castle of Lust in this sensual dark fantasy arcade bubble shooter! Defeat 4 captivating maidens, strip them sphere by sphere, and unlock interactive private chambers featuring high-definition videos and intense, explicit climaxes.

3224920.name: Skyward Masters
3224920.short_description: SKYWARD MASTERS is an ARENA FPS with Bedwars-style strategy, where 16 players split across 4 teams fight on floating islands. Set across changing biomes you outlast your opponents to be the last team standing in a format where chaos reigns and teamwork rules.

3551140.name: Hoarder
3551140.short_description: Clean. Possess. Control. Hoarder begins as a mundane cleaning simulator that spirals into a distant nightmare. Scavenge the hoarders’ house, recover what should be forgotten, and if you go far enough, you might reach the top of the pyramid or the bottom of the abyss.

5102310.name: DISK-Y Demo
5102310.short_description: Show transfer student Yuu around the school in a short psychological horror visual novel with a dreamlike, disjointed story. An experimental retro game originally made for a single 3.5-inch floppy disk, now on Steam.

2587210.name: SHUNYA
2587210.short_description: One moves, one draws—you control both at once. In this pixel-art puzzle game, draw Earth, Water, Fire, and Wind magic cubes to reshape the environment. Bound by a magical chain, a girl and a floating cat must escape the mysterious Otherworld and find their way home.

3280240.name: Nailcrown
3280240.short_description: Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter packed with high-velocity gunplay, brutal melee action, and a dynamic gore system. Explore the dark environments and wield a deadly arsenal, while taking down a horde of accursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school.

5197690.name: Endless FPV
5197690.short_description: Fly fast, react on the fly, and master an endless FPV course that changes every run. Mix course segments from themed decks, build your own custom deck, and customize your drone to match your flying style.

5166680.name: 7 Bullets
5166680.short_description:
Fight animal outlaws off in strategic gunfight duels.
Collect their bounties to buy yourself the deadliest 7 bullets combos, and bring back Wolf Town to its former glory.

5178960.name: A Red Specter Haunts the World – Free Sample
5178960.short_description: Build a highly organized Communist Party with iron discipline; seize power through armed struggle; liberate all oppressed people; and march toward the fulfillment and realization of the Party’s highest goals and ultimate ideals

1754880.name: 侠不义·昙花一线
1754880.short_description: A wuxia roguelike deckbuilder with loot and extraction. Turn martial arts into card tactics: strikes beat feints, feints beat guards, and guards beat strikes. Outsmart your foes, refine your deck, and steadily build a powerful band of heroes. Victory rewards strategy, not reflexes!

4938170.name: Ostfriesland Games
4938170.short_description: Ostfriesland Games turns road bowling, ditch vaulting, mudflat sled racing, shrimp peeling and tea serving into a retro arcade game. With real places in pixel art, local and worldwide high scores, and East Frisian humour. Even making tea can get hectic.

5386060.name: Keep on Digging!
5386060.short_description: Dig up chests, collect loot, and spend your gold on new skills and gear in Keep on Digging.

4116260.name: In-Security
4116260.short_description: Hack into cameras, watch your hotwife, and use temptation as a tool to expose the truth behind a corporate heist. NTS/NTR unavoidable!

4542970.name: Come to my party! Demo
4542970.short_description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming of age story where every choice carries weight.

1963680.name: GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT
1963680.short_description: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

5296340.name: Maria IV: A Cozy Botanical Sim Demo
5296340.short_description: What would life look like as a florist on Pont Notre-Dame in late 15th-century Paris? Personalize your home and shop, carry on your legacy, and grow flowers using real cultivation principles. The final page of the Guide Book may just be the first page of your real-life botanical journey.

5338730.name: Crownmarked Demo
5338730.short_description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, raise citizens into adventurers and fight beside powerful companions in Crownmarked, a kingdom-building action RPG set in a fractured fantasy world trapped in an endless cycle of destruction and rebirth.

2858120.name: Clown House: Lunacy
2858120.short_description:
A narrative horror experience where violence is a trap.

Unravel the secrets of a derelict mansion and its uncanny clown residents. Solve puzzles. Observe the clowns, deduct their needs and what angers them to survive.

And never harm the residents of the Clown House. It has eyes.

5246270.name: Idle Purrates Clicker
5246270.short_description: Build a fearless feline crew, plunder treasure-filled shores, flip mysterious coins and upgrade your way to fortune! Conquer each beach, blast enemy ships and become the richest purrate captain the seven seas have ever seen.

5091250.name: Slasher Manager
5091250.short_description: Become the slasher in a darkly comic horror clicker set inside a killer’s hand-drawn notebook. Turn Screams into ridiculous upgrades, chain combos, and automate the hunt—then take on bosses that change the rules. Nine locations. One very questionable career.

4888670.name: SPEED OF LIGHT
4888670.short_description: Start with a fragile ship drifting through deep space and evolve into a physics-defying machine. Upgrade thrusters, harvest particles, vaporize enemies, and race toward the speed of light in this action space incremental game.

5466130.name: Minimal AI Build Shop 24-26
5466130.short_description: Run a tiny PC shop through the 2024–26 AI boom. Pick the GPU, parts and model that fit each customer's budget. A light, cozy pixel-art shop sim.

3093160.name: INTERSCAPE
3093160.short_description: A colossal black sphere has appeared on Earth, trapping humanity in endless dreams. Explore surreal dream worlds, uncover hidden secrets, and awaken those who sleep. In each distinct dream, awaken new abilities and experience unique worlds.

5444690.name: Become Emperor 2! My Trillion Beauties Universe Empire
5444690.short_description: This is an interactive video game set in a cosmic empire. Explore, make choices at key moments, and embark on your own cosmic adventure.
developers: 万亿美女星球工程设计研究院
publishers: 万亿美女星球工程设计研究院

4759950.name: Mushroom Man and the Problematic Pizza Parlour Playtest

4347770.name: Fiets-Together
4347770.short_description: Fiets-Together is a chaotic co-op bike game for 2-4 players where each of you controls one shoe on a pedal. Together, you control the bike's acceleration and steering. Agree on which path to ride, chase best times, customize your shoe and try to preserve your friendship.

3991790.name: Attack of the Astrals
3991790.short_description: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

1031010.name: Moving Castle Demo
1031010.short_description: Build a moving castle—or a vast mobile city—and explore a post-apocalyptic world. Live aboard your creation: gather, mine, explore and fight. Travel with your residents, face fearsome monsters, grow crops, cook meals, and share sunrises and sunsets.

5123900.name: Pack a Plush!
5123900.short_description: Pack a Plush! is a cozy collection game where you buy batches of adorable plushies, organize them into displays, and build valuable collections. Discover legendary plushies, fulfill requests, and create a collection that's uniquely yours.

2704900.name: Bohnice: Within The Mind
2704900.short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of Prague's Bohnice Asylum. As an investigative journalist, you must document forbidden experiments and chilling paranormal encounters. Collect photographic evidence and survive the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.

4733570.name: Another Card Game
4733570.short_description: Another Card Game is a unique PvP, PvE card game. Fight your friends, your parents, your dog, your self in means to dominate the Sacred Orb. Combine your cards into powerful spells to bring down your foes. Oh and by the way did you know that every 60 seconds one minute goes by?

4914680.name: 数织艺术
4914680.short_description: Classic & variant nonogram puzzles with a collectible twist: solve number puzzles, piece fragments together, and light up themed albums.

4553020.name: Pingo
4553020.short_description: Pingo is an AI desktop pet that chats, roasts, remembers, and helps with tasks. Connect local models, official cloud; customize personality, voice, and look; let it observe your screen, keep memory and diary notes, use Skills, knowledge bases, and MCP, and play games with you.

4701280.name: RAT CITY: Ratocracy
4701280.short_description: Build and Manage a Rat City. Run it into the ground. Literally. Keep your Rats happy and productive. Create for them a glorious colony in the dirt! The never ending demand for the production of products to consume is all consuming. Wait, is this real life? No, it's RAT CITY!

4530680.name: HODKA
4530680.short_description: Roam a wild map with your trusty metal detector to dig up scrap. Upgrade your van and tools for better loot but finish work before nightfall. For that is when the dark fog creeps in and will claim its due.

2946850.name: Streets of Fortuna
2946850.short_description: Survive in a giant simulated historical city. Grow from a street rat to a tradesman, a priest, a smuggler, an alchemist, a spy, or perhaps someday a leader to rival the Overlord. A free-roaming sandbox megasim RPG set in a fantasy Constantinople.

5085030.name: GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown Demo
5085030.short_description: Your first step into a living world. This free demo of GEKOKUJO: Vagrant Crown is being prepared around third-person exploration, village and forest encounters, and the beginning of a journey with a wolf companion.

3693220.name: Troublemaker 3
3693220.short_description: The Fight Comes from Anyone. Three years after Troublemaker 2, Jayakarta still stands under a long-standing political dynasty, but the people are starting to fight back. Citizens, stars, gangsters, and even those within the justice system unite in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game.

4038280.name: BULLETJUMP
4038280.short_description: Jump with one hand, shoot with the other. BULLETJUMP is a fast arcade score-chaser: weave through bullet storms, skim close calls to push your multiplier to x5, and chase the player one rank above you. Watch any run back, take on a new Daily Challenge every day, and climb the global leaderboards.

4996850.name: Beatlash: Survival
4996850.short_description: A horde survivor that plays your music. Thousands of enemies, all moving to the beat, and when the drop hits, so do you. Put on your favourite song and watch the whole screen come apart in time with it.

5430020.name: Elyrion - The Secret Book
5430020.short_description: Set in the world of Elyrion, this adventure takes place just before the events of the upcoming Rise of the Raven. Elyrion – The Secret Book is a 2D stylized RPG that offers not only main and side quests, but a wide range of challenges and discoveries for players to explore.

3602900.name: Spirit of Diwata
3602900.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

4632730.name: Breakaway
4632730.short_description: Soccer set in Space. Juggle, Curl, and Save the ball. Offline or Online, from 1v1 to 6v6.

5388060.name: VectorForce
5388060.short_description: Arm yourselves as ace agents and engage in high-octane light-gun action in this retro-inspired arcade rail shooter. Take on a ruthless criminal organisation shooting down waves of enemies and challenging bosses that will put your reflexes to the test while the city is on the brink of crisis.

1282380.name: Sheepdog Simulator
1282380.short_description: Learn to herd sheep the way real shepherds do: with a whistle and a faithful sheepdog. Send your dog wide around the flock, then ease them down the lane and through the gate. Push too hard and fear spreads until they bolt; hang back and they wander off to graze. Bring every last one home.

5289620.name: Strip Bubbles: Rich Ladies Club
5289620.short_description: Enter the exclusive Rich Ladies Club! Challenge four powerful, ultra-wealthy heiresses in addictive bubble-shooter matches: a strict lawyer with forbidden desires, a casino countess, an innocent noblewoman seeking sin, and an oil princess. Master the art of high-society seduction.

5430630.name: Dashvera HUD
5430630.short_description: Dashvera HUD is a customizable Windows 11 desktop utility for monitoring CPU, RAM, GPU, and storage information. Keep essential system readings in view, personalize your HUD, and access useful tools including a built-in clock and calculator.

5338510.name: Korsaros Online
5338510.short_description: Sail the Aegean Sea in a free-to-play 3D naval MMORPG inspired by Greek mythology. Explore an open Mediterranean world, build your ship, recruit a Captain and crew, battle pirates, fish, hunt treasure and trade with players. Brave PvP waters or sail together.

3791580.name: Spirit of Diwata Demo
3791580.short_description: Heal instead of fight. A cozy co-op JRPG for up to three, on one screen or online, set in an Asian fantasy world where you play elemental spirit instruments to calm the creatures you meet. Every creature is someone to bond with, and each friendship brings a little more hope to the world.

4181850.name: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons
4181850.short_description: LitGirls: Bookbound Dungeons is a dungeon-crawler RPG where classic literature meets anime Girls! Assemble a party inspired by legendary characters such as Alice, Juliet, Dante, and Raven, then lead them into treacherous dungeons crawling with monsters, traps, treasure, and otherworldly horrors.

4816570.name: Animals League Unite Demo
4816570.short_description: Play the whole first world: 10 Meadow levels for 2 to 8 players, on one screen or online. Stack up, shout, fall together, then make your own levels in the level editor.

2906990.name: MoonTraum
2906990.short_description: *MoonTraum* is a fishing game set in a mysterious dream world. Lost in a world where dreams take the form of fish, you meet Welt, a cat fisherman, and begin your fishing adventure. Catch uniquely designed fish and complete your collection!

3369460.name: Re:Connect Demo
3369460.short_description: Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure set in a digital world, where you connect code to change the rules! Become a Debug AI, solve electronic circuit puzzles, and set off on a grand adventure to repair the “Heart Bugs” of the AIs!

2527940.name: Little Cheese Works
2527940.short_description: [Co-op Action × Voice Chat] Work together to carry cheese without waking the cat! Use voice chat—but be careful, even small sounds can alert it. As overworked mice in a shady company, can you overcome traps and escape to a peaceful life?

4812070.name: 落仙泱 Demo
4812070.short_description:
No spiritual root – can you still ascend?
In Luoxian Yang, five elements, demonic, and heretic cultivators walk their own paths. Play as mortal or novice – grow, advance. Master arts, refine treasures, recruit Daoists. Witness the Nine Provinces' struggles – shape their endings.

271590.name: Grand Theft Auto V Legacy
271590.short_description: Grand Theft Auto V for PC offers players the option to explore the award-winning world of Los Santos and Blaine County in resolutions of up to 4k and beyond, as well as the chance to experience the game running at 60 frames per second.

3669200.name: Guildrun
3669200.short_description: A PvE roguelike autobattler with no timers, no queue and no PvP. Draft a guild, rank heroes from C to S and stack 300+ relics into builds that one-shot bosses. Climb 8 difficulties and the Endless leaderboards. Start small, become unstoppable.

3365290.name: 东隅荡寇志·朝鲜战争 Demo

3275650.name: Magtiles
3275650.short_description: Magtiles is a chill and relaxing puzzle game about moving tiles. There's no rush! Just play at your own pace, disable the move limit, skip levels, or come back later if you just want to relax. Listen to chill lo-fi and classical music and satisfying sounds. Simple is good.

3363910.name: You Have Been Deleted
3363910.short_description: You Have Been Deleted is a first-person survival horror inspired by the early internet and the 90s, all packaged in a surreal retro art style. Trapped within a corrupted virtual reality made by the company you work for, you must Uncover, Hack, and Survive if you ever wish to free yourself from hell.

4438670.name: NTR Tales - The Elf Next Stream
4438670.short_description: An adult RPG about love, streaming, and corruption. Help your elven girlfriend rebuild her lost memories, grow her audience, and repay your debt, one stream at a time.

4730780.name: Sturmjäger
4730780.short_description: Sturmjäger is a sci-fi shoot 'em up built for pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. Obliterate everything in sight, and master 10 unique missions solo or in local couch co-op. High-octane action, merciless boss fights await. Simple rules: If it moves, shoot it. If it doesn't... shoot it anyway!

4769780.name: Night Cart: The Immortal Plague
4769780.short_description: A first-person gothic adventure where you drive a horse-drawn cart through plague-ridden Transylvania alongside an immortal woman, exploring forgotten places, battling desperate foes, uncovering ancient secrets, and searching for the legendary Count Saint Germain.

5467640.name: Пока помню
5467640.short_description: An adventure game about an artist who has lost her sight and must learn to live in the unfamiliar, dark and frightening world that has become her reality

3550940.name: 叫魂JIAOHUN
3550940.short_description: Welcome to JIAOHUN. Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And a message from Fairy Town's end. Grab your pager and step into the strange night before the new millennium. Investigate the mysterious Fairy Town in Baishoi County. Explore deeper, uncover the townfolk's secrets, and find the dark truth.

2109770.name: Kingmakers
2109770.short_description: Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in this epic action/strategy sandbox. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.

3760770.name: Space Savory
3760770.short_description:
Not that far away, in a galaxy…

A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness.

Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here.

(Only within the observable part.)

3732880.name: Trailblazers: Into the March Demo
3732880.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

4713440.name: My Little Empire: Cyber Lounge
4713440.short_description: Build your own computer club from an empty lot: rows of gaming PCs, console and VR corners, a bar and a kitchen. Hire staff, keep gamers happy, deal with 21 city factions — and don't forget to pet Luna, the club cat.

4815810.name: The Aether Project TD Demo
4815810.short_description: The Aether Project TD is a classic 3D tower defense game built around tower placement, upgrades, varied enemy threats, active abilities, and different ways of surviving each level. Defend against structured waves or continuous attacks, adapt your defenses, and hold the line.

4094350.name: Online: 404
4094350.short_description: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

5372420.name: Ball Scratch Simulator - Scratch & Climb
5372420.short_description: Scratch, charge, jump. Turn an embarrassing itch into awkward altitude across 20 illustrated platforming stages. Pick your jump strength, steer past spikes and moving ledges, collect 60 trail charms, and race your own best ghost.

5289710.name: AltspaceVR
5289710.short_description: AltspaceVR is a social platform for virtual reality, a place where people meet inside shared 3D spaces instead of scrolling past each other.

2605970.name: Fairy Comedy: A Love Hard To Find
2605970.short_description: 只能复述别人话语的鹦鹉精灵，该怎样向喜欢的女孩表达心意？扮演不谙世事的李素武，收集语句卡牌，在约会中努力接上她的话，也可能一不小心说出令人啼笑皆非的怪话！在这段融入轻度卡牌互动的恋爱视觉小说中，与徐清茗从相识走向相恋，在欢笑、心动与成长中，寻找属于自己的幸福。

5326360.name: Stop Reading the Cards Demo
5326360.short_description: Build a deck. Let the cards do the work. Try the demo of this satirical roguelike card game, with automated combat, a guided tutorial, and keyboard & mouse controls. Camera-based gestures are optional. Management accepts no responsibility for your strategy.

5129980.name: Heirs of the Fountains
5129980.short_description: Heirs of the Fountains is a pixel-art action-platformer starring two siblings with unique powers. Explore the kingdom of Elarion, overcome dangerous levels, defeat fearsome creatures and legendary bosses, and rescue Lady Julia from the clutches of the witch Morwenna.

1857810.name: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3
1857810.short_description: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE 3 is a wholly-new Dragon Ball experience, where you decide the hero you want to be in an unexplored Dragon Ball world: AGE 1000.

2671300.name: Trailblazers: Into the March
2671300.short_description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in this roguelite colony-sim strategy game. Command your Landship in tactical battles, care for a crew composed of all sorts of characters, shape your home, manage resources, and lead expeditions into the March. Discover what lies at its heart... and in yours.

5323890.name: 桌面小搭档 Demo
5323890.short_description: This is a AI desktop companion that works and studies with you! You can choose your favorite companion to work or study with in any scenario. You can also find a favorite scenes to pause, enjoy the view. You can also decorate your desk in your favorite style and create your very own digital desk!

5062910.name: Life Is a Dungeon: Lean into It.
5062910.short_description: Choose one of four adventurers, each driven to clear dungeon floors in a different way. Set a destination or take direct control, then combine equipment with powerful—but sometimes troublesome—random skills to shape every expedition in this dungeon-crawling roguelite RPG.

5345540.name: Memory House Demo
5345540.short_description: Your first quiet evening in Memory House. Try illustrated Jigsaw puzzles, an introductory Atlas strategy scenario, five detective chapters, a complete fairy tale, and a small personal journal, with music and changing weather. Available in English and Russian.

1673030.name: NyanGO
1673030.short_description: A 4×4 "push-style Go" played with adorable cat pieces. Place, move, and push—surround your opponent's cats to win. Pushed cats get stunned, and a cat stunned 3 times shatters! Easy to learn, deep to master. Play online or challenge the CPU.

3299300.name: Magicians: The Devil's Deal
3299300.short_description: Magicians: The Devil’s Deal is a narrative driven FPS where stage magic becomes real. You play as Jacob Menteuro, a fallen illusionist bound by a pact with The Devil and cast into Hell. Master deadly tricks, steal the powers of rival magicians, and escape the infernal world of Theatreland.

5344440.name: Beamline
5344440.short_description: Bring curated CRT, LCD and VHS looks into supported games. Set up a game in Beamline, launch it as usual, and tune the picture from the in-game overlay.

4715160.name: Finals Week
4715160.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

5372410.name: Ball Scratch Simulator - Scratch & Slay
5372410.short_description: A superhero injection goes badly wrong. Fight viruses and microplastics in a ridiculous first-person dream with 10 wave arenas, six household weapons and four boss types. Dash, cool your Hover Minigun and scratch your way out of the lab.

5366980.name: 추 : 그날의 악몽
5366980.short_description: The nightmare every Korean veteran knows: years after your discharge, you wake up back in the barracks. By day, an absurdly ordinary army routine. After lights-out, search the base while avoiding “him”, who is still awake. A first-person comedy-horror adventure over three days in the Korean army.

4199230.name: Clean Memories
4199230.short_description: Clean, repair, and organize forgotten spaces. Uncover the memories hidden beneath the dirt in this relaxing first-person cleaning adventure.

2368320.name: Cold Salvage
2368320.short_description: A co-op horror investigation game. You're salvage engineers sent aboard derelict ships to find what's nesting in the dark and identify it before it finds you. Gather evidence, keep your crew calm, and get out alive. You can't kill it. You can only name it.

5179450.name: Shroom & Blade
5179450.short_description: Two players. One mushroom colony. One explores, fights ants, and hunts scouts before they summon stronger waves. The other builds, automates, and fortifies the colony. Survive escalating attacks together until the Ant Queen arrives in this asymmetric co-op base-defense game.

4915570.name: Tapis
4915570.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points.  To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

4004820.name: FreeStyle Football 2
4004820.short_description:
Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game.
Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team.
Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.
